name: Aberrant Tumor
benefit: Gain a tumor familiar.

name: Ability Focus
benefit: One of this creature’s special attacks is particularly difficult to resist.

name: Absorb Spirit
prerequisites: Con 13, died or possessed by an undead
benefit: Temporarily absorb a spirit to prevent rejuvenation

name: Abundant Revelations
benefit: Use a single revelation more times each day.

name: Accomplished Sneak Attacker
benefit: Your sneak attack damage increases by 1d6, up to half your level in dice (rounded up).

name: Accursed Hex
benefit: Target a creature with a hex a second time that day if it made its save the first time.

name: Acidic Splatter
prerequisites: Ability to cast 2nd-level spells, Elemental Focus (Earth).
benefit: As long as you have an elemental (earth) spell of 2nd level or higher in your known spells and have at least 2 MP in your MP pool, you can throw an orb of acid as a ranged touch attack. The attack has a range of 5 feet per level of the highest-level earth spell you can cast and deals 1d6 points of earth damage per level of that earth spell. As a secondary benefit, you gain a +1 competence bonus to your caster level when casting elemental (earth) spells.
text:
class="page-content">
You can channel magical energy into orbs of acid.
Prerequisite(s): Ability to cast 2nd-level spells, Elemental Focus (Earth).
BENEFIT
As long as you have an elemental (earth) spell of 2nd level or higher in your known spells and have at least 2 MP in your MP pool, you can throw an orb of acid as a ranged touch attack. The attack has a range of 5 feet per level of the highest-level earth spell you can cast and deals 1d6 points of earth damage per level of that earth spell. As a secondary benefit, you gain a +1 competence bonus to your caster level when casting elemental (earth) spells.

name: Acrobatic
benefit: +2 bonus on Acrobatics and Fly checks.

name: Acrobatic Spellcaster
benefit: Avoid attacks of opportunity from casting with Acrobatics

name: Acrobatic Steps
benefit: Ignore 20 feet of difficult terrain when you move.

name: Acute Shot
benefit: Whenever you gain a magic bonus on an attack roll with a ranged weapon, you can deduct any range penalties from your damage roll, instead of your attack roll. Additionally, when you gain a magic bonus on a ranged attack roll, you can deal sneak attack damage to a target that has concealment (but not total concealment) as long as the attack otherwise qualifies to deal sneak attack damage. The maximum number of sneak attack dice you can use in this way is equal to the value of your magic bonus on attack rolls.

name: Adamantine Body (Shindroid)
benefit: This plating is counted as a heavy armor. It grants a +8 armor bonus to Armor Class and a damage reduction bonus of 2/adamantine. The character also incurs a 35% chance for spell failure, a -5 armor check penalty, and a +1 maximum dexterity bonus. Plating is considered weightless for determining the shindroid's encumbrance. Plating may be enchanted as magic armor, though the shindroid must be present at all times during the process. This also replaces the composite plating racial trait.
text:
class="page-content">
Prerequisite(s): Shindroid, Composite Plating racial trait.
BENEFIT
This plating is counted as heavy armor and reduces movement speed accordingly (30ft becomes 20ft). It grants a +8 armor bonus to Armor Class and a damage reduction bonus of 2/adamantine. The character also incurs a 35% chance for spell failure, a -5 armor check penalty, and a +1 maximum dexterity bonus. Plating is considered weightless for determining the shindroid’s encumbrance.
Plating may be enchanted as magic armor, though the shindroid must be present at all times during the process. The plating requires the use of the Masterwork Transformation spell to become masterwork. This also replaces the composite plating racial trait.
Special: You may only select this feat at 1st level.

name: Adaptive Fortune
prerequisites: Fortunate One, adaptable luck racial trait, character level 10th, halfling
benefit: Use adaptable luck more often

name: Adder Strike
prerequisites: Poison use class feature, Improved Unarmed Strike, Craft (alchemy) 1 rank
benefit: May apply contact poison to unarmed strikes

name: Additional Traits
benefit: Gain two additional character traits.

name: Adept Champion
benefit: Trade smite evil damage for bonus on combat maneuver checks.

name: Adept Channel
prerequisites: Ability to cast divine spells, summon familiar class ability, CL 4, Cha 13
benefit: Learn how to channel energy like a cleric.

name: Advanced Armor Training
benefit: Select one advanced armor training option.

name: Advanced Defensive Combat Training
benefit: Gain a +4 bonus to your CMD

name: Advanced Martial Training
prerequisites: Base attack bonus +11, Martial Training, No levels in a class with Swordplay
benefit: Select a Swordplay Form (Dark Sword, Destroy Sword, Holy Sword, or Universal). You may select any one master swordskill from the list, and you may ready an additional swordskill. You must meet the prerequisites for the master swordskill. The damage inflicted by the swordskill is determined as though your sword saint level is equal to half of your character level. The DC is equal to 10 + half your character level + your Charisma modifier.
text:
class="page-content">
You’ve learned the advanced training in swordplay.
Prerequisites: Base attack bonus +11, Martial Training, No levels in a class with Swordplay.
BENEFIT
Select a Swordplay Form (Dark Sword, Destroy Sword, Holy Sword, or Universal). You may select any one master swordskill from the list, and you may ready an additional swordskill. You must meet the prerequisites for the master swordskill. The damage inflicted by the swordskill is determined as though your sword saint level is equal to half of your character level. The DC is equal to 10 + half your character level + your Charisma modifier.
Special: This feat can be selected multiple of times, but must meet the prerequisites for each master swordskill.

name: Advanced Power Weapons Wielder
prerequisites: Caster Level 11th, Improved Power Weapons Wielder feat.
benefit: When using the Improved Power Weapons feat, you may attack a third time at a -10 penalty. In addition, the range of your ranged power weapons increases to 60 feet.
text:
class="page-content">
You’re able to gain a third additional attack with your power weapon.
Prerequisite(s): Caster Level 11th, Improved Power Weapons Wielder feat.
BENEFIT
When using the Improved Power Weapons feat, you may attack a third time at a -10 penalty. In addition, the range of your ranged power weapons increases to 60 feet.

name: Advanced Ranger Trap
benefit: Add +1 to the Disable Device and Perception check DCs for your ranger traps.

name: Advanced Telepathy (Tonkin)
benefit: Your limited telepathy’s range has doubled, allowing you to communicate with any creature within 60 feet, regardless if you share a common language or not.

name: Advanced Weapon Training
prerequisites: Fighter level 5th, weapon training class feature
benefit: Select one advanced weapon training option, applying it to one fighter weapon group you have already selected with the weapon training class feature.

name: Aeroblooded (Goblin)
benefit: You may use Goblin Punch as a spell-like ability up to once per day. Your caster level is equal to your character level.
text:
class="page-content">
The power of the wind flows through your blood, enabling you emulate your ancestors.
Prerequisite(s): Character level 3, Int 12+, goblin
BENEFIT
Your Goblin Punch can be used a number of times per day equal to your Intelligence modifier.

name: Agent of Fear
benefit: Target a creature more often with appearances

name: Agent of Purity
prerequisites: A friend or ally must have been significantly corrupted by a specific natural or supernatural blight, or you must have a regional background trait tied to a specific blight.
benefit: You have devoted your life to purging blight from the world.

name: Agile Maiden
prerequisites: Str 13; Dex 13; Endurance or armor training class feature; proficiency with heavy armor.
benefit: For the purpose of class features (such as a ranger’s combat style, a barbarian’s fast movement, or a magus’s spellcasting), you treat Gray Maiden plate as medium armor or heavy armor, whichever is more beneficial to a given ability. This does not affect the armor’s statistics, and it is still considered heavy armor for all other purposes.

name: Agile Maneuvers
benefit: Use your Dex bonus when calculating your CMB

name: Agile Tongue
benefit: You have a prehensile tongue

name: Agile Tongue (Qu)
benefit: You have a prehensile tongue with a range of 10 feet. You can pick up items weighing no more than 5 pounds, make Sleight of Hand checks, perform the steal or disarm combat maneuvers, or make melee touch attacks with your tongue.
text:
class="page-content">
Your long pink tongue is capable of manipulating small items and even stealing objects.
Prerequisite(s): Qu.
BENEFIT
You have a prehensile tongue with a range of 10 feet. You can pick up items weighing no more than 5 pounds, make Sleight of Hand checks, perform the steal or disarm combat maneuvers, or make melee touch attacks with your tongue.

name: Agonizing Obedience
benefit: Each time you gain this feat you choose an agony. You can perform an obedience for only a single agony in a 24-hour period.

name: Airship Battle Run (Combat)
prerequisites: Dexterity 13, Airship Dodge feat, Airship Mobility feat
benefit: When using an attack action with an airship ranged weapon, you can move both before and after the attack, provided that the total distance does not exceed the airship’s movement. Moving in this way does not provoke an attack of opportunity from the defender you are attacking (though it can provoke attacks of opportunity from other nearby airships, as normal).
text:
class="page-content">
You are skilled at airship skirmish tactics, zipping in and out of an enemy’s sights.
Prerequisite(s): Dexterity 13, Airship Dodge, Airship Mobility.
BENEFIT
When using an attack action with an airship ranged weapon, you can move both before and after the attack, provided that the total distance does not exceed the airship’s movement. Moving in this way does not provoke an attack of opportunity from the defender you are attacking (though it can provoke attacks of opportunity from other nearby airships, as normal).

name: Airship Dodge (Combat)
prerequisites: Dexterity 13, Pilot 6 ranks, Airship Operation feat
benefit: When piloting an airship, you apply a +1 dodge bonus to your airship’s AC.

name: Airship Feint (Combat)
benefit: When piloting an airship, you can make a Bluff check in airship combat as a move action. In addition, you receive a +2 bonus on Bluff checks made to feint in airship combat. See the expanded Bluff skill description for details.
text:
class="page-content">
You are skilled at misleading your enemy in airship combat.
Prerequisite(s): Pilot 9 ranks, Airship Operation
BENEFIT
When piloting an airship, you can make a Bluff check in airship combat as a move action. In addition, you receive a +2 bonus on Bluff checks made to feint in airship combat. See the expanded Bluff skill description for details.

name: Airship Gunnery (Combat)
benefit: You do not take a penalty on Attack rolls when firing an airship weapon.

name: Airship Mobility (Combat)
benefit: When piloting an airship, you apply a +4 dodge bonus to your airship’s AC against attacks of opportunity caused when you out of or within an airship’s threatened area. Any condition that makes your lose your Dexterity bonus to AC also makes you lose your dodge bonuses. Dodge bonuses (such as this one and the dodge bonus granted by the Airship Dodge feat) stack with each other, unlike most types of bonuses.
text:
class="page-content">
You are adept at dodging attacks while piloting airships.
Prerequisite(s): Dexterity 13, Airship Dodge
BENEFIT
When piloting an airship, you apply a +4 dodge bonus to your airship’s AC against attacks of opportunity caused when you out of or within an airship’s threatened area. Any condition that makes your lose your Dexterity bonus to AC also makes you lose your dodge bonuses. Dodge bonuses (such as this one and the dodge bonus granted by the Airship Dodge feat) stack with each other, unlike most types of bonuses.

name: Airship Operation
benefit: You gain Pilot and Navigate as class skills you obtained this feat. When operating an airship, you take no penalty on Pilot checks made when operating the airship, and you also gain a +1 dodge bonus to your airship’s AC per 5 ranks of your Pilot skill.
text:
class="page-content">
You are proficient at operating airships of any type.
BENEFIT
You gain Pilot and Navigate as class skills you obtained this feat. When operating an airship, you gain a +1 dodge bonus to your airship’s AC per 5 ranks of your Pilot skill.
Normal: Without this feat, you do not gain the dodge bonus to your airship’s AC.

name: Airy Step
benefit: Gain a +2 bonus on saving throws against air or electricity damage, and ignore some falling damage

name: Airy Step (Aegyl)
benefit: You gain a +2 bonus on saving throws against effects with the wind or lightning descriptors and effects that deal wind or lightning damage. You may ignore the first 30 feet of any fall when determining falling damage.
text:
class="page-content">
The air responds to your mastery of the skies, protecting you from harm and cushioning your falls.
Prerequisite(s): Aegyl.
BENEFIT
You gain a +2 bonus on saving throws against effects with the wind or lightning descriptors and effects that deal wind or lightning damage.

name: Alchemical Strike
benefit: You can throw a single alchemical item as a full-attack action, increasing the effectiveness of the alchemical agent thrown

name: Alertness
benefit: +2 bonus on Perception and Sense Motive checks.

name: Alien Mindpaths
benefit: Gain +4 on saves vs. mind-affecting effects and scrying

name: Align Equipment
prerequisites: Alignment Channel, Bless Equipment, CL 3, channel energy
benefit: You can imbue weapons, shields, and armor with a special ability listed in the table (see text).

name: Aligned Crafting
prerequisites: Craft Magic Arms and Armor or Craft Wondrous Item.
benefit: Your magical creations reject those you oppose.

name: Alignment Channel
benefit: Channel energy can heal or harm outsiders.

name: All Gnolls Must Die
prerequisites: Deliver the killing blow to 20 gnolls, hyenas, dire hyenas, werehyenas, or jackalweres
benefit: Gain a bonus on Will saves and a bonus to attack and damage a number of gnoll-like creatures.

name: All-Consuming Swing
prerequisites: Str 13, Power Attack, Cleave, Vital Strike, BAB +8
benefit: When you Cleave or Great Cleave, you can apply the additional damage you would gain from Vital Strike, Improved Vital Strike, or Greater Vital Strike to the initial target of your attack. When you do so, the strain on your body causes you to take an amount of damage equal to the extra damage dealt by your Vital Strike feat. This self-inflicted damage is not reduced by damage reduction.

name: Allied Spellcaster
benefit: +2 bonus on level checks to overcome spell resistance.

name: Ally Shield
benefit: Use an ally as cover and make them take the attack instead of you.

name: Alter Binary Mindscape
prerequisites: Int 13, ability to cast instigate psychic duel
benefit: Opponent must spend 1 extra manifestation point to defend itself

name: Altitude Affinity
benefit: Become unaffected by problems with high altitude and gain a +4 bonus to Survival in high altitudes.

name: Amateur Gambler
prerequisites: Profession (gambler) 3 ranks, you possess no levels in a class that grants the MGP class feature.
benefit: You gain the ability to use the MGP and Slots gambler class features, albeit in limited capacity.
text:
class="page-content">
Even though you may not tread the gambler’s path, fortune smiles upon you, granting a glimmer of its favor.
Prerequisites Profession (gambler) 3 ranks, you possess no levels in a class that grants the MGP class feature.
Benefit
You gain limited access to the gambler’s MGP class feature, starting with an amount of MGP equal to your Charisma modifier (minimum 1) and a maximum capacity of 20 MGP (shared between yourself and your extra-dimensional vault). You can bet and buy in for up to an amount of MGP equal to your Charisma modifier (minimum 1).
Additionally, you gain the gambler’s Slots class feature, treating your number of ranks in Profession (gambler) as your effective gambler level. The DC for any effects you apply is determined in part by your Charisma modifier.
Special: This feat can be taken multiple times. Each time you select it, your maximum MGP capacity increases by 20.

name: Amateur Gunslinger
prerequisites: No levels in a class with grit class feature
benefit: Gain limited amount of grit and access to gunslinger deeds

name: Amateur Investigator
prerequisites: Int 13, 1 rank in at least one Knowledge skill, no levels in a class that has inspiration
benefit: Gain a minor pool of inspiration for use with Knowledge, Linguistics, or Spellcraft checks.

name: Amateur Swashbuckler
prerequisites: No levels in a class that has panache
benefit: Gain a minor pool of panache to use with a 1st-level swashbuckler deed of your choice

name: Ambush Awareness
benefit: Take total defense action when surprised

name: Ambush Sense
benefit: You gain a bonus on Perception checks made to determine awareness for the surprise round of combat, and a dodge bonus to AC in any surprise round in which you get to act. These bonuses are equal to the bonus you gain from trap sense.

name: Ambush Squad
benefit: Take both a move action and a standard action on a surprise round when you and ally can both act

name: Ammo Drop
prerequisites: Sleight of Hand 1 rank, proficient with sling
benefit: Load a sling or one end of a double-sling with one hand as a swift action or move action which does not provoke attacks of opportunity.

name: Amplified Radiance
benefit: Shed an aura of light when near allies who share this feat

name: Amplified Rage
prerequisites: Half-orc or orc, rage class feature
benefit: Increase your bonuses to Strength and Constitution by raging near a fellow rager.

name: Anatomical Savant
benefit: Choose one weapon with which you have the Weapon Focus feat. When you strike an opponent that has a chance of negating critical hits or sneak attacks, such as from the fortification armor special ability, reduce that chance by 25%. Treat creatures that are normally immune to critical hits and sneak attacks as instead having a 75% chance to negate the critical hit or sneak attack, taking only the attack’s normal damage

name: Ancestral Enmity
benefit: You gain a +2 bonus on melee attack rolls against dwarves and gnomes

name: Ancestral Scorn
benefit: Whenever you successfully demoralize an outsider of the evil subtype with an Intimidate check, it becomes sickened for 1 round in addition to being affected by the normal effects of being demoralized. If you beat the DC by 5 or more, the creature is nauseated for 1 round instead.

name: Ancestral Weapon Mastery
benefit: Gain proficiency with your race’s racial weapons or gain a bonus Weapon Focus feat with one racial weapon at a time

name: Angel Wings
benefit: Grow wings and gain a fly speed

name: Angel Wings (Forgiven)
prerequisites: Angelic Blood feat, forgiven, character level 10th
benefit: You gain a pair of gleaming feathered wings that grant a fly speed of 30 feet (average maneuverability) if wearing light armor or unencumbered, or 20 feet (poor maneuverability) with a medium or heavy load or medium or heavy armor. Fly is a class skill for you.
text:
class="page-content">
Feathered wings sprout from your back.
Prerequisite(s): Angelic Blood, forgiven, character level 9th.
BENEFIT
You gain a pair of gleaming feathered wings that grant a fly speed of 30 feet (average maneuverability) if wearing light armor or unencumbered, or 20 feet (poor maneuverability) with a medium or heavy load or medium or heavy armor. Fly is a class skill for you.

name: Angelic Blood
benefit: Gain a bonus against evil spells and on stabilize checks

name: Angelic Blood (Forgiven)
benefit: You gain a +2 bonus on saving throws against effects with the dark descriptor and on Constitution checks to stabilize when you are reduced to negative hit points (but not dead). Furthermore, each time you take bleed or blood drain damage, each undead creature or creature with the shadow subtype that is currently adjacent to you also takes 1 point of holy damage.
text:
class="page-content">
Your blood is densely infused with light aether.
Prerequisite(s): Con 13, forgiven.
BENEFIT
You gain a +2 bonus on saving throws against effects with the dark descriptor and on Constitution checks to stabilize when you are reduced to negative hit points (but not dead). Furthermore, each time you take bleed or blood drain damage, each undead creature or creature with the shadow subtype that is currently adjacent to you also takes 1 point of holy damage.

name: Angelic Flesh
benefit: Gain one of a number of celestial effects

name: Animal Affinity
benefit: +2 bonus on Handle Animal and Ride checks.

name: Animal Ally
prerequisites: Nature Soul, character level 4th, must not have an animal companion or mount that advances as an animal companion
benefit: Gain an animal companion as if you were a druid of your character level –3 from the following list: badger, bird, camel, cat (small), dire rat, dog, horse, pony, snake (viper), or wolf. If you later gain an animal companion through another source (such as the Animal domain, divine bond, hunter’s bond, mount, or nature bond class features), the effective druid level granted by this feat stacks with that granted by other sources.

name: Animal Call
benefit: Make convincing animal sounds with Bluff checks

name: Animal Disguise
benefit: Disguise yourself as an animal using pelts and animal parts

name: Animal Ferocity
prerequisites: Base attack bonus +3, ferocity racial ability
benefit: Make full attacks at negative hit points but at a –5 penalty

name: Animal Soul
prerequisites: Animal companion or mount class feature
benefit: You can shrug off spells that don’t work on animals.

name: Ankle Biter
benefit: Bite an opponent that targets you with a combat maneuver as an immediate action.

name: Antagonize
benefit: Use Diplomacy or Intimidate to goad creatures.

name: Anthem of Pageantry (Bardic Masterpiece)
text:
class="page-content">
This piece, developed from Ul’dah musical records about the just rewards of honest striving, consists of a series of complicated crescendos, each culminating in a stirring, lengthy refrain.
Prerequisite(s): Perform (string) or Perform (wind) 7 ranks.
BENEFIT
When you complete the performance, a single room or chamber you occupy appears to be swathed in silks and opulent furnishings you envision. You and up to one ally per bard level within the room who can hear you are clothed in illusory exotic fabrics, furs, and jewels while in the room. If you or an affected ally leave the room before the effect’s duration expires, the illusion ends. A creature can attempt a Will save to disbelieve the illusion.
Use: 1 bardic performance round per 10 minutes of the effect’s duration. 
Action: 1 minute.

name: Anticipate Dodge
prerequisites: Dodge, Mobility, BAB +7, brawler 4, or monk 4
benefit: Gain up to a +2 bonus on attack rolls against creatures with a dodge bonus

name: Apocalyptic Spell
benefit: You can alter a spell with an area of effect and a duration of instantaneous to become an apocalyptic spell. When you cast the spell, the area affected by the spell’s instantaneous effect becomes ruined and devastated in appearance. All surfaces in the area are treated as difficult terrain, and Climb, Fly, and Swim checks attempted in the area take a penalty equal to the spell’s original spell level. The difficult terrain and skill penalties last for a number of rounds equal to the spell’s original spell level. An apocalyptic spell gains the evil descriptor.

name: Aquatic Ancestry
benefit: Gain the amphibious special quality and increase swim speed

name: Aquatic Breath
prerequisites: Ability to cast 3rd-level spells, Elemental Focus (Water).
benefit: As long as you have an elemental (water) spell of 3rd level or higher in your known spells and have at least 3 MP in your MP pool, you can breathe normally in both air and water. This supernatural quality requires no activation. As a secondary benefit, you gain a +1 competence bonus to your caster level when casting elemental (water) spells.
text:
class="page-content">
Your reservoir of magic allows you to breathe normally even underwater.
Prerequisite(s): Ability to cast 3rd-level spells, Elemental Focus (Water).
BENEFIT
As long as you have an elemental (water) spell of 3rd level or higher in your known spells and have at least 3 MP in your MP pool, you can breathe normally in both air and water. This supernatural quality requires no activation. As a secondary benefit, you gain a +1 competence bonus to your caster level when casting elemental (water) spells.

name: Aquatic Combatant
benefit: +2 bonus on Swim checks; avoid normal penalties on melee attack rolls underwater

name: Aquatic Spell
benefit: An aquatic spell functions normally when underwater and requires no caster level check to cast, even if it possesses the [fire] descriptor. In addition, the spell can be cast from the surface into water and still be effective.

name: Arc Slinger
prerequisites: Point-Blank Shot, proficient with sling or halfling sling staff
benefit: Reduce ranged attack penalties due to range by 2

name: Arcane Aptitude (Tarutaru)
benefit: Add one to the DC of a spell or spell-like effect that originates from a magic item that you have activated.
text:
class="page-content">
A magic item that casts spells is more powerful in your hands.
Prerequisite(s): Tarutaru.
BENEFIT
Add one to the DC of a spell or spell-like effect that originates from a magic item that you have activated.

name: Arcane Armor Mastery
prerequisites: Arcane Armor Training, Armor Proficiency, Medium, CL 7
benefit: Reduce your arcane spell failure chance by 20%

name: Arcane Armor Training
benefit: Reduce your arcane spell failure chance by 10%

name: Arcane Blast
benefit: Sacrifice a spell to make ray attack.

name: Arcane Craft (Item Creation, Al Bhed)
benefit: You may create magic items without the requisite item creation feat from the list below when your ranks in Spellcraft reach the sufficient number, using your ranks in Spellcraft as your Caster Level, though this increases the DC of crafting by +10. 1 Rank - Scribe Scroll. 3 Ranks - Craft Alchemical Item, Craft Wondrous Item. 5 Ranks - Craft Magic Arms and Armor, Craft Materia, Craft Wand. 7 Ranks - Forge Ring. 9 Ranks - Craft Rod. 11 Ranks - Craft Staff.
text:
class="page-content">
Your innate talent allows you to use sheer genius in place of skill or prowess.
Prerequisite(s): Al Bhed, Int 15.
BENEFIT
You may create magic items from two item creation feats from the list below without needing the requisite item creation feat when your ranks in Spellcraft reach the sufficient number, using your ranks in Spellcraft as your Caster Level, though this increases the DC of crafting by +10.
Once this feat is chosen, you may pick two item creation feats from the list below, your Spellcraft ranks must be high enough to select the item creation feats.
1 Rank – Scribe Scroll.
3 Ranks – Craft Alchemical Item, Craft Wondrous Item.
5 Ranks – Craft Magic Arms and Armor, Craft Materia, Craft Wand.
7 Ranks – Forge Ring.
9 Ranks – Craft Rod.
11 Ranks – Craft Staff.
15 Ranks – Craft Construct.
Special: This feat can be selected more than once, enabling you to select two additional item creation feats each time this feat is selected.

name: Arcane Insight
benefit: You gain a +1 insight bonus to your AC for 1 round when you use the Arcane Shield feat.

name: Arcane Jinxer
benefit: You can expend a prepared arcane spell or available arcane spell slot to give your jinx target a penalty on its jinx save equal to the level of the expended spell or spell slot.

name: Arcane Ruin (Al Bhed)
benefit: Any successful hit that you score against a magic item that causes damage to that item also causes that item to obtain the broken condition. The item must be restored to its original hit points before it may lose this condition.
text:
class="page-content">
You can easily break magical items.
Prerequisite(s): Al Bhed, 6th level.
BENEFIT
Any successful hit that you score against a magic item that causes damage to that item also causes that item to obtain the broken condition. The item must be restored to its original hit points before it may lose this condition.

name: Arcane School Spirit
prerequisites: Bluff 1 rank, arcane school class feature, gnome
benefit: Bluff someone into reducing their save against your next spell.

name: Arcane Shield
benefit: As an immediate action, you can spend MP up to your caster level and gain a deflection bonus to AC equal to the MP you sacrificed for 1 round.
text:
class="page-content">
You can convert any spell into a defense.
Prerequisites: Spellcaster, caster level 10th.
Benefit
As an immediate action, you can spend MP up to your caster level and gain a deflection bonus to AC equal to the MP you sacrificed for 1 round.

name: Arcane Shield
benefit: Sacrifice a spell to gain deflection bonus to AC.

name: Arcane Strike
benefit: +1 damage and weapons are considered magic

name: Arcane Talent
benefit: Cast a 0-level spell 3 times per day as a spell-like ability.

name: Arcane Talent (Nu Mou or Tarutaru)
benefit: Choose a 0-level spell from the black mage or white mage spell list. You can cast this spell three times per day as a spell-like ability. The caster level is equal to your character level. The save DC is 10 + your Charisma modifier.

name: Arcane Vendetta
benefit: +2 bonus on damage vs. arcane spellcasters.

name: Archon Diversion
prerequisites: Archon Style, Combat Expertise, Combat Reflexes, BAB +4 or monk 4
benefit: 1/rnd when using Archon Style, if have at least one hand free, divert 1 melee weapon attack that would have struck an adjacent ally and take the hit instead, using your own AC to determine whether the attack hits (see text for more details.)

name: Archon Justice
prerequisites: Archon Diversion, Archon Style, Combat Expertise, Combat Reflexes, BAB +8 or monk 7
benefit: Take no penalty to AC when using Archon Style and can spend a swift action instead of a move action to use this ability. Whenever you take damage from using Archon Diversion to divert an opponent’s attack toward yourself, any allies threatening your opponent can make an AOO against the diverted opponent.

name: Archon Style
prerequisites: Combat Expertise, Combat Reflexes, BAB +2 or monk 2
benefit: Grant adjacent allies +2 dodge bonus to AC against single adjacent opponent’s next melee attack (as long as that attack comes before the beginning of your next turn), but you take –2 AC against that opponent until your next turn.

name: Arcing Weapon

class="page-content">

If an outsider fails its save, each round of the performance expends 2 rounds of the remaining duration of any spell or effect that summoned that creature to the current plane (in addition to the normal duration that passes each round).
Called outsiders who fail their Will saves against this masterpiece take a –2 penalty on attack rolls, skill checks, and saving throws for the performance’s duration. If the performer can’t speak the native tongue of the outsider’s home plane, the outsider gains a +4 bonus on its Will save against this effect.

benefit: While you are using this style, you gain a number of benefits whenever you are blinded or unable to see (including when you wear a blindfold or close your eyes). name: Blockout

The type of material the block is made out of depends on the highest level earth spell you can cast. At 1st level it is made of paper (effectively no weight, no hardness, 10 hp). 3rd level is a hollow block of wood (200 lbs, hardness 5, 60 hp). 5th level is a block of solid wood (2000 lbs, hardness 5, 600 hp). 7th level is a block of stone (9 tons, hardness 8, 900 hp). 9th level creates a block of iron (30 tons, hardness 10, 1800 hp). You can always choose to make a block of lesser value if desired. The usual rules about summoning into a place which can support the cube applies, and you may dismiss any and all cubes as a standard action. As a secondary benefit, you gain a +1 competence bonus to your caster level when casting elemental (earth) spells.

name: Chaos of the Void (Bardic Masterpiece)
text:
class="page-content">

BENEFIT

class="page-content">

If there is only 1 die or less, or it is reduced to 1 die, your healing spell takes a penalty of -2 plus an additional -2 per feat you have with Cleric Style as a prerequisite (minimum 1 damage healed).

benefit: While you are using Cloak and Dagger Style and wielding your chosen weapon, whenever you make an AOO against a target, you can attempt a free dirty trick combat maneuver check against the target as a free action as well. Additionally, whenever you successfully perform a dirty trick maneuver against a target, you can immediately attempt a steal combat maneuver check against the target as a free action. If you succeed, the target is unaware you have stolen an item.

name: Cloak and Dagger Tactics
prerequisites: Int 13, Cloak and Dagger Style, Cloak and Dagger Subterfuge, Combat Expertise, Improved Dirty Trick, Vital Strike, Weapon Focus with the chosen weapon, BAB +16
benefit: While you are using Cloak and Dagger Style and wielding your chosen weapon, whenever you hit an opponent that is denied its Dexterity bonus to AC or that you areflanking, or make an attack using Vital Strike (or its improved or greater versions), you can attempt a dirty trick combat maneuver check against that opponent as a free action. If you succeed, the target must succeed at a Fortitude save (DC = 10 + 1/2 your BAB + your Intelligence modifier) or take an additional penalty from the dirty trick selected from the following list: anchored in place and unable to move from that square, confused, exhausted, or staggered. This additional penalty lasts only 1 round, regardless of how long the dirty trick’snormal penalty lasts, and can be removed by the target with a standard action. You can only attempt one free dirty trick combat maneuver check per round using this feat.

name: Close-Quarters Thrower
prerequisites: Dodge, Weapon Focus with selected thrown weapon
benefit: Attacks with selected weapons do not provoke attacks of opportunity

name: Cloud Gazer
benefit: You can see through non-magical fog and mists with no penalty

name: Cloud Gazer (Aegyl)
benefit: You can see through fog, mist, and clouds, without penalty, ignoring any cover or concealment bonuses from such effects. If the effect is created by magic, this feat instead triples the distance you can see without penalty.
text:
class="page-content">
Your insight into your knowledge of the skies gives you a clarity of sight few humes possess.
Prerequisite(s): Aegyl.
BENEFIT
You can see through fog, mist, and clouds, without penalty, ignoring any cover or concealment bonuses from such effects. If the effect is created by magic, this feat instead triples the distance you can see without penalty.

name: Cloud Step
benefit: Air walk for half your slow fall distance

name: Cloven Helm
benefit: When wearing a helmet, you add +1 to your AC against critical hit confirmation rolls; this benefit stacks with Dented Helm. When you use Dented Helm to deflect a critical hit, you may apply all damage from the critical hit to your helmet before applying any damage to yourself. If you take no damage, any additional effects, such as critical feats or poison, are negated.

name: Clustered Shots
benefit: Total damage from full-round ranged attacks before applying DR

name: Clutch of Earth
prerequisites: Ability to cast 2nd-level spells, Elemental Focus (Earth).
benefit: As long as you have an elemental (earth) spell of 2nd level or higher in your known spells and have at least 2 MP in your MP pool, you can spend a standard action to reduce the speed of any land bound creature within 30 feet of you. The creature's normal land speed, as well as its burrow and climb speeds, decrease by 5 feet per level of the highest level earth spell you have, to a minimum speed of 5 feet. This effect lasts for 1 round. A successful Fortitude (DC 10 + half caster level + caster modifier) save negates this effect and renders the target immune to the feat's effect for 24 hours. Creatures currently swimming or flying are immune to this effect. As a secondary benefit, you gain a +1 competence bonus to your caster level when casting elemental (earth) spells.
text:
class="page-content">
You briefly increase the earth’s pull on the target creature.
Prerequisite(s): Ability to cast 2nd-level spells, Elemental Focus (Earth).
BENEFIT
As long as you have an elemental (earth) spell of 2nd level or higher in your known spells and have at least 2 MP in your MP pool, you can spend a standard action to reduce the speed of any land bound creature within 30 feet of you. The creature’s normal land speed, as well as its burrow and climb speeds, decrease by 5 feet per level of the highest level earth spell you can cast, to a minimum speed of 5 feet. This effect lasts for 1 round. A successful Fortitude (DC 10 + half caster level + caster modifier) save negates this effect and renders the target immune to the feat’s effect for 24 hours. Creatures currently swimming or flying are immune to this effect. As a secondary benefit, you gain a +1 competence bonus to your caster level when casting elemental (earth) spells.

name: Coaxing Song (Metasong)
text:
class="page-content">
Your songs reach the minds of even the lowliest dungeon denizens.
Prerequisite: Knowledge (dungeoneering) 6 ranks.
BENEFIT
This feat only works with mind-affecting songs. A coaxing song affects mindless oozes and vermin as if they weren’t mindless, but has no effect on other creature types.
MP Increase: +2 (a coaxing song costs 2 additional MP more than the actual MP cost of the song.) In addition, the perform check DC increases by +2.

name: Coaxing Spell
benefit: A mind-affecting spell modified by this feat affects mindless oozes and vermin as if they weren’t mindless.

name: Cockatrice Strike
benefit: Turn a target to stone with a critical hit

name: Combat Advice
benefit: Grant an ally a competence bonus on next attack roll against a chosen enemy.

name: Combat Casting
benefit: +4 bonus on concentration checks for casting defensively.

name: Combat Distraction
prerequisites: Goblin, Acrobatics 1 rank, Escape Artist 1 rank
benefit: Your antics in combat cause others to suffer a -2 penalty to Perception and Concentration checks.

name: Combat Expertise
benefit: Trade attack bonus for AC bonus

name: Combat Medic
benefit: May take 10 and not provoke attacks of opportunity when using Heal

name: Combat Patrol
benefit: Increase threatened area for AOO

name: Combat Reflexes
benefit: Make additional attacks of opportunity

name: Combat Style Master
prerequisites: Improved Unarmed Strike, two or more style feats, BAB +6 or monk 5
benefit: May switch styles as a free action

name: Command Animals
prerequisites: Animal domain, channel energy class feature
benefit: Use channeled energy to control animals

name: Command Plants

benefit: Use channeled energy to control plants

name: Command Undead
benefit: Channel energy can be used to control undead.

name: Companion Figurine
prerequisites: Handle Animal 1 rank, own a figurine of wondrous power.
benefit: Use your figurine of wondrous power as your animal companion or familiar.

name: Compelling Harmonies
prerequisites: Basic Harmony, Perform (keyboard, percussion, sing, string, or wind) 10 ranks, bardic performance or raging song
benefit: As a standard action, you may expend one round of bardic performance to boost the effectiveness of the bardic performance of an ally within 60 feet who also has this feat. Until the beginning of your next turn, if that ally uses a bardic performance that allows a saving throw, increase that saving throw DC by 2.

name: Compounded Pain
benefit: You can apply the effects of two stare feats to your painful stares.

name: Conceal Scent
benefit: Creatures cannot track you by scent.

name: Conceal Spell
prerequisites: Deceitful, Bluff 1 rank, Disguise 1 rank, Sleight of Hand 1 rank
benefit: Conceal evidence of spellcasting

name: Concentrated Fire
prerequisites: Point-Blank Shot, elf, weapon familiarity racial trait
benefit: When you and an ally with this feat both ready actions to make ranged attacks, use the highest attack roll for both attacks

name: Concentrated Splash
benefit: Forgo dealing splash damage to increase damage done by direct hit with splash weapon

name: Concussive Spell
benefit: Spell with the [sonic] descriptor gains a debilitating concussive effect.

name: Conditional Spell
benefit: A conditional spell is subject to the rules laid out in the spell conditional favor.

name: Confabulist
benefit: Follow a failed lie with another lie

name: Confounding Tumble Deed
prerequisites: Amateur Swashbuckler or panache class feature; Canny Tumble, Acrobatics 7 ranks
benefit: When you avoid attacks of opportunity and hit a foe, you can deny it its Dex bonus to AC for 1 round.

name: Conscript
prerequisites: Serf in service to a lord
benefit: When wielding a farm implement (such as hand axe, pick, pitchfork, or scythe) as a weapon, get +1 bonus on damage rolls. When fighting alongside other conscripts get +1 bonus on init checks.

name: Consecrate Spell
benefit: Spell is maximized against evil creatures and creatures with the evil subtype.

name: Construct Lock (Shindroid)
benefit: You gain a +2 bonus on damage rolls against creatures with the construct type. If you roll a critical threat against a construct, you can forego the confirmation roll to make another attack roll using the same modifier. If this second attack also hits and deals at least 1 point of damage, the construct must succeed on a Fortitude save (DC 10 + 1/2 your character level + your Int modifier) or be rendered immobile and helpless for 1 round (as if it had been paralyzed).
text:
class="page-content">
Your knowledge of construct nature allows you to deal extra damage to or even immobilize such foes.
Prerequisite(s): Base attack bonus +2, shindroid.
BENEFIT
You gain a +2 bonus on damage rolls against creatures with the construct type. If you roll a critical threat against a construct, you can forego the confirmation roll to make another attack roll using the same modifier. If this second attack also hits and deals at least 1 point of damage, the construct must succeed on a Fortitude save (DC 10 + 1/2 your character level + your Int modifier) or be rendered immobile and helpless for 1 round (as if it had been paralyzed).
Special: If you spend a hero point to improve an attack roll against a construct and hit with the attack, the attack roll is automatically considered to be a critical threat regardless of the number rolled on the die.

name: Consume Essence
prerequisites: Base attack bonus +6; swallow whole universal monster ability; evil alignment; magical beast, outsider, or undead type
benefit: Inflict negative levels on swallowed creatures

name: Consume Undeath
benefit: As a full-round action, you can consume the animating force of any undead creature you have created with your death-stealing gaze. This immediately destroys the undead creature, but grants you one of that creature’s special attacks or supernatural abilities (chosen from one of the following abilities possessed by the undead: Constitution drain, disease, energy drain, or paralysis). The ability granted persists for 24 hours or until the next sunrise, whichever comes first.

name: Contagious Spell
benefit: A caster level check to dispel or remove a contagious spell that fails by 5 or more causes it to spread from the original target to the creature that attempted to remove it. The spell spreads to the new target regardless of its normal range or any special targeting requirement like a melee or ranged touch attack. The spell is treated as if you had just cast it on the new target. The new target receives a saving throw or the benefit of spell resistance (if applicable) if the spell normally allows it.

name: Contingent Channeling
prerequisites: True healer class feature, Selective Channeling
benefit: May transfer positive energy to ally who can use it to heal.

name: Contingent Spell
prerequisites: Ability to cast cure spells (a cure spell is any spell with “cure” in its name).
benefit: A contingent spell infuses a target with a dormant healing or restorative spell that can trigger when the target needs it the most.

name: Contingent Spell (Metamagic)
prerequisites: Ability to cast cure spells (a cure spell is any spell with “cure” in its name)

name: Conviction
benefit: Vampires are more averse to your holy symbols than normal.

name: Cooperative Counterspelling
prerequisites: Spellcraft 5 ranks, racial spell-like ability of 1st level or higher
benefit: When you and an ally with this feat both ready actions to counterspell, you gain additional counterspelling options

name: Cooperative Crafting
prerequisites: 1 rank in any Craft skill, any item creation feat
benefit: +2 bonus on Craft or Spellcraft checks while working together.

name: Cooperative Disabling
prerequisites: Disable Device 1 rank, trapfinding class feature
benefit: Ally can attempt a second Disable Device check as an immediate action

name: Coordinated Blast
prerequisites: Spellcraft 5 ranks, any racial spell-like ability
benefit: Exclude allies with this feat from area spells and abilities

name: Coordinated Charge
prerequisites: At least two other teamwork feats, BAB +10
benefit: You may charge the same foe when an ally does

name: Coordinated Defense
benefit: +2 bonus to CMD

name: Coordinated Distraction
benefit: When you and at least one ally with this feat threaten the same enemy, the enemy treats the DC to cast spells defensively as 2 higher for each threatening character with this feat. If you or your allies are incapable of taking an AOO against the target for any reason, the effects of this feat do not apply.

name: Coordinated Maneuvers
benefit: +2 bonus on combat maneuver checks

name: Coordinated Reposition
benefit: Whenever an ally with this feat who is threatening a creature you are threatening takes a 5-foot step, you can move 5 feet as an immediate action. This movement does not provoke attacks of opportunity.

name: Coordinated Shot
benefit: When an ally with this feat threatens a foe, gain a +1 bonus on ranged attack rolls, or +2 if that ally is flanking the foe

name: Cornugon Shield
benefit: Shield bonus to AC when wielding a spiked chain

name: Cornugon Smash
benefit: Make free Intimidate checks when you Power Attack

name: Cornugon Stun
benefit: Use Stunning Fist with special monk weapons as well as unarmed attacks

name: Cornugon Trip
benefit: May throw spiked chain to make trip attacks

name: Coronach
benefit: At 5 TP or more, you may spend all TP to deliver a special crossbow or firearm attack that takes the place of an attack in a full-attack or just a single attack. This attack deals normal damage but doubling the damage you receive from Sniping Shot. Compare your attack roll to a DC of 10 + the target’s Hit Dice + the target’s Wisdom modifier or ranks in Sense Motive. If you beat this DC, the target cannot attack you for 2 rounds. If you attack the target again before these 2 rounds are up, they may target you normally. Once you have used this ability on a creature, they cannot be targeted again for 1 day. At 10 TP or more, you may spend all TP to perform the same check, but the target cannot attack you for 4 rounds. At 15 TP, you may spend all TP to perform the same check, but the target cannot attack you for 6 rounds.
text:
class="page-content">
Your shots leave your foes rightfully terrified of you.
Prerequisite(s): Numbing Shot, BAB +9.
BENEFIT
At 5 TP or more, you may spend all TP to deliver a special crossbow or firearm attack that takes the place of an attack in a full-attack or just a single attack. This attack deals normal damage but doubling the damage you receive from Sniping Shot. Compare your attack roll to a DC of 10 + the target’s Hit Dice + the target’s Wisdom modifier or ranks in Sense Motive. If you beat this DC, the target cannot attack you for 2 rounds. If you attack the target again before these 2 rounds are up, they may target you normally. Once you have used this ability on a creature, they cannot be targeted again for 1 day. At 10 TP or more, you may spend all TP to perform the same check, but the target cannot attack you for 4 rounds. At 15 TP, you may spend all TP to perform the same check, but the target cannot attack you for 6 rounds.

name: Corsair
benefit: +2 initiative while on ships, +1 damage with light or one-handed weapons on ships.

name: Cosmopolitan
benefit: Read and speak two additional languages.

name: Counter Reflexes
benefit: Opponents with Mobility do not gain a bonus when they provoke attacks of opportunity from you

name: Counterpoint to Inspiration
prerequisites: Basic Harmony, Compelling Harmonies, Perform (keyboard, percussion, sing, string, or wind) 10 ranks, bardic performance or raging song
benefit: When an ally with this feat is within 60 feet and uses a bardic performance or raging song that grants allies a morale bonus or competence bonus, you may perform the same bardic performance or raging song to increase those bonuses by +1. This increase only lasts as long as you and your ally each maintain the same performance, and cannot be extended with effects like Lingering Performance. Additional bards with this feat beyond the second don’t increase the bonuses further.

name: Counterpunch
prerequisites: Dex 18, Combat Reflexes, Improved Unarmed Strike, Weapon Focus (unarmed strike), BAB +16 or brawler 12
benefit: When you fight unarmed and a foe misses with all melee attacks, it provokes attacks of opportunity from you

name: Counterspell, Improved
benefit: Counterspell with spell of the same school.

name: Courageous Resolve
prerequisites: Craven racial trait or fearless racial trait, halfling
benefit: Fear effects are less potent against you

name: Coven Caster
benefit: As a standard action, you can attempt a special aid another action (1d20 + your choice of your Intelligence or Charisma modifier; DC 10). If you succeed, you can increase an adjacent spellcaster’s caster level by 1 until the beginning of your next turn. If you also have the coven witch hex, you can apply this bonus to all members of your coven within 30 feet.

name: Cover Tracks
benefit: Increase the DC of Survival checks to track you and your allies

name: Covering Defense
benefit: Provide cover to an ally with total defense

name: Covering Fire
benefit: You can use the aid another action with a ranged attack against an opponent, regardless of whether the opponent threatens an ally.

name: Craft Alchemical Item¹
benefit: You can create alchemical items.

name: Craft Construct
prerequisites: CL 5, Craft Magic Arms and Armor, Craft Wondrous Item
benefit: You can create any construct whose prerequisites you meet.

name: Craft Cybernetics
prerequisites: Technologist feat, Heal 9 ranks, Craft (Electronic) 9 ranks
benefit: You can create cybernetic items.
text:
class="page-content">
You can build cyberware and install it in a creature’s body.
Prerequisite(s): Technologist feat, Heal 9 ranks, Craft (Electronic) 9 ranks.
BENEFIT
You can create cybernetic items. Creating a cybernetic item takes 1 day for every 1,000 gil in the item’s price. To create the object, you must use up raw materials costing half of this total price. You can repair a broken cybernetic item if it is one that you could make. Doing so costs half the raw materials and half the time it would take to craft that item from scratch. You can also install a cybernetic item in a creature’s body. See the Cybertech section on installing cyberware.

name: Craft Cybernetics
benefit: Create and install cybertech.

name: Craft Magic Arms and Armor
benefit: Create magic armors, shields, and weapons

name: Craft Magitek
prerequisites: Technologist feat, Craft (Mechanical) 11 ranks, Knowledge (Engineering or Technology) 11 ranks
benefit: You can create magiteks.
text:
class="page-content">
You can craft powerful war machines, called magiteks.
Prerequisite(s): Technologist feat, Craft (mechanical) 11 ranks, Knowledge (engineering or technology) 11 ranks.
BENEFIT
You can create magiteks. Any character with access to the vehicle’s key or other control mechanism may drive and use this vehicle. Creating a magitek takes 1 week for every 1,000 gil in the item’s price. To create the object, you must use up raw materials costing half of this total price. See magiteks for more information.
You can repair a broken magitek if it is one that you could make. Doing so costs half the raw materials and half the time it would take to craft the magitek from scratch.

name: Craft Materia
benefit: You can create materia.
text:
class="page-content">
You can create materia, which are special little crystal orbs that contain magicite that provide a magical effect when affixed to a weapon, shield, or suit of armor.
Prerequisite(s): Caster level 5th.
BENEFIT
You can create materia of any level, or upgrade an already existing materia to a higher level using normal crafting rules.
Crafting a materia takes 1 day for every 1,000 gil in the materia’s price. To craft materia, you must use up raw materials costing half of its base price.
For any materia that can cast spells, treat the spells it can cast as part of the construction requirements. For materia that don’t cast spells but do grant abilities, treat the abilities that they grant as requirements (if applicable). Higher level materia include the requirements from its lower level versions into its own requirements (for example, a Level 2 Fire Materia requires both Fire and Fire II).
See magic item creation rules for more information. See the Materia section for a list of what materia you can make.

name: Craft Ooze
prerequisites: Brew Potion, Craft Wondrous Item, Craft (alchemy) 3 ranks, caster level 5
benefit: You can create living oozes as though they were magical items.

name: Craft Pharmaceutical
benefit: Create pharmaceutical items.

name: Craft Poppet
benefit: You can craft poppets and add augmentations to existing poppets that you control.

name: Craft Rod
benefit: Create magic rods

name: Craft Shadow Piercing
benefit: You can create special wondrous items—typically barbs, hooks, rings, and spikes—that adorn piercings in the wearer’s flesh and grant magical abilities. Both you and the recipient of the piercing (if not yourself) must be present for the entire piercing process.

name: Craft Staff
benefit: Create magic staves

name: Craft Technological Arms and Armor
benefit: Create technological weapons and armor.

name: Craft Technological Item
benefit: Create technological items.

name: Craft Wand
benefit: Create magic wands

name: Craft Wondrous Item
benefit: Create magic wondrous items

name: Crane Riposte
benefit: When you deflect an attack, you may make an AOO

name: Crane Style
prerequisites: Dodge, Improved Unarmed Strike, BAB +2 or monk 1
benefit: Take –2 penalty when fighting defensively

name: Crane Wing
prerequisites: Crane Style, Dodge, Improved Unarmed Strike, BAB +5 or monk 5
benefit: May deflect one attack per round while fighting defensively or using total defense

name: Cranial Adjustment
benefit: You can perform the hypnotism occult skill unlock even if you can’t use psychic magic. If you can cast psychic spells or have the Psychic Sensitivity feat, you can use hypnotism one additional time per day.

name: Cranial Implantation
benefit: You can perform the phrenology occult skill unlock, though you must use needles or similar sharp implements rather than your fingertips, dealing 1d3 points of damage to the subject. If you can cast psychic spells or have the Psychic Sensitivity feat, you can use phrenology one additional time per day.

name: Create Enhanced Firearm
prerequisites: Craft Magic Arms and Armor; Craft (weapons) 1 rank or Gunsmithing.
benefit: You can craft superior firearms.

name: Create Reliquary Arms and Shields
prerequisites: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, ability to cast consecrate or desecrate
benefit: Make your shield or weapon a holy symbol.

name: Create Sanguine Elixir
prerequisites: Cha 15, Brew Potion, Craft (alchemy) 12 ranks, sorcerer 3
benefit: Create an elixir that allows another to use a bloodline power.

name: Creature of Darkness
benefit: Your darkvision increases to 120 ft. & you can also see perfectly in any darkness.

name: Criminal Reputation
benefit: Influence criminals more easily

name: Critical Focus
benefit: +4 bonus on attack rolls made to confirm critical hits

name: Critical Mastery
benefit: Apply two effects to your critical hits

name: Critical Versatility
benefit: Once per day, you can spend 1 hour practicing maneuvers to gain one single critical feat that you meet the prerequisites for. You gain the benefits of the chosen critical feat until you choose to practice a different critical feat.

name: Critical, Banishing
prerequisites: Critical Focus, ability to cast dismissal or banishment, CL 9
benefit: When you confirm a critical hit with a slashing or bludgeoning weapon, you may cast dismissal or banishment on that target as an immediate action, and the target takes a –4 penalty on its Will save to resist the spell’s effect. You must have dismissal or banishment prepared or otherwise available to cast, and using this ability casts the corresponding spell.

name: Critical, Bleeding
benefit: Whenever you score a critical hit, the target takes 2d6 bleed

name: Critical, Blinding
benefit: Whenever you score a critical hit, the target is blinded

name: Critical, Censoring
benefit: Whenever you score a critical hit against an opponent, the victim is unable to speak for 1d4+1 rounds.

name: Critical, Crippling
benefit: Whenever you score a critical hit, the target’s speed is halved

name: Critical, Deafening
benefit: Whenever you score a critical hit, the target is deafened

name: Critical, Exhausting
benefit: Whenever you score a critical hit, the target is exhausted

name: Critical, Improved
benefit: Double the threat range of one weapon

name: Critical, Sickening
benefit: Whenever you score a critical hit, the target is sickened

name: Critical, Staggering
benefit: Whenever you score a critical hit, the target is staggered

name: Critical, Stunning
benefit: Whenever you score a critical hit, the target is stunned

name: Critical, Tiring
benefit: Whenever you score a critical hit, the target is fatigued

name: Crossbow Mastery
benefit: Reload crossbow as free action and make full attacks

name: Crowd Control
benefit: You gain a +2 competence bonus to your CMD when an enemy uses Acrobatics to move through a square you threaten. For each ally within your reach that also has this feat, the bonus increases by an additional 2.

name: Crowd of Bullies
benefit: Allies with this feat gain a +2 bonus on combat maneuver checks after you fail a combat maneuver check

name: Crusader’s Fist
prerequisites: Lay on hands or touch of corruption class feature, Improved Unarmed Strike, BAB +6
benefit: May use lay on hands or touch of corruption upon successful unarmed strike

name: Crusader’s Flurry
prerequisites: Channel energy and flurry of blows class feature, Weapon Focus with deity’s favored weapon
benefit: May use flurry of blows with deity’s favored melee weapon.

name: Crushing Blow
benefit: Stunning Fist reduces target’s AC

name: Crypt Song (Metasong)
text:
class="page-content">
You can infuse your songs with the power of the crypts, sending foes to face ineluctable judgment.
BENEFIT
You can enhance any song that inflicts hit point damage to become a crypt song. A creature that dies within 1 round of being damaged by a crypt song is considered to have been killed by a death effect for the purpose of being returned to life. An undead creature damaged by a crypt song gains the sickened condition for a number of rounds equal to the song’s original song level; this duration is halved if the undead creature succeeds at its saving throw against the song. A crypt song gains the death descriptor.
MP Increase: +2 (a coaxing song costs 2 additional MP more than the actual MP cost of the song.) In addition, the perform check DC increases by +2.

name: Crypt Spell
benefit: You can enhance any spell that inflicts hit point damage to become a crypt spell. A creature that dies within 1 round of being damaged by a crypt spell is considered to have been killed by a death effect for the purpose of being returned to life. An undead creature damaged by a crypt spell gains the sickened condition for a number of rounds equal to the spell’s original spell level; this duration is halved if the undead creature succeeds at its saving throw against the spell. If the spell does not allow a save, the target can attempt a Will save to negate the sickened effect. A crypt spell gains the death descriptor.

name: Cudgeler Style
benefit: When you hit with a charge attack to deal nonlethal damage while using this style, your weapon deals damage as if it were one size category larger than it actually is. If you have the ability to make more than one attack on a charge, this increase applies only to your first attack.

name: Cudgeler Sweep
prerequisites: Bludgeoner, Cudgeler Style, BAB +5 or monk 5
benefit: When you hit with a charge attack using the Cudgeler Style feat, you can immediately attempt a single trip combat maneuver check against the target with a +2 competence bonus as a free action. This provokes an AOO as normal for a trip combat maneuver.

name: Cudgeler Takedown
prerequisites: Bludgeoner, Cudgeler Style, Cudgeler Sweep, BAB +9 or monk 9
benefit: When you hit with a charge attack using the Cudgeler Style feat, your weapon deals damage as though it were one size category larger for 1 round or until it leaves your hand. When you successfully trip an opponent with the Cudgeler Sweep feat, your opponent must succeed at a Fortitude save (DC = 10 + your character level + your Strength modifier) or be stunned for 1 round.

name: Cultivate Magic Plants
prerequisites: Brew Potion, Craft Wondrous Item; Knowledge (nature) 1 rank
benefit: Grow magical plants.

name: Cunning Intuition
prerequisites: Ready for Anything, BAB +13 or rogue 13, Sense Motive 13 ranks
benefit: Choose your readied action when it triggers

name: Cushioning Shield (Combat, Shield Mastery)
prerequisites: Shield Focus, base attack bonus +6 or fighter level 4th.
benefit: When you fall 10 or more feet, you can direct half of the falling damage you would take to your shield.

name: Cutting Humiliation
benefit: Humiliate someone to weaken Charisma-based checks

name: Cybertech Savant
benefit: Your Constitution and Intelligence score are considered four points higher for purposes of determining how many implantations of cybertech you can have.
text:
class="page-content">
You are one with cybernetics and are able to implant more devices than normal.
BENEFIT
Your Constitution and Intelligence score are considered four points higher for purposes of determining how many implantations of cybertech you can have.

name: Cypher Magic
benefit: Gain bonuses to CL when using scrolls.

name: Cypher Script
prerequisites: Knowledge (arcana) 1 rank, Linguistics 1 rank, Spellcraft 1 rank, spellbook class feature
benefit: You are more efficient at using your spellbook.

name: Dance of Beauty’s Wiles (Bardic Masterpiece)
text:
class="page-content">
A creation of Lakshmi’s deific orders, this swaying sensuous dance fans the fires of desire.
Prerequisite(s): Perform (dance) 5 ranks.
BENEFIT
When you begin this performance, select one creature within 30 feet to become overwhelmed by lustful feelings toward you. Each round, the target must attempt a Will save. If the target would not normally be attracted to you, it receives a +4 bonus on its saving throws. For each failure, the DCs of your Bluff and Diplomacy checks against that creature are reduced by 2 (to a maximum reduction of 10) and the target takes a –1 penalty on Will saving throws against enfeebling effects that you create (to a maximum of –5). name: Dance of the Naga (Bardic Masterpiece)

class="page-content">
Your expressive dance makes your allies much more limber.

BENEFIT
When you complete this performance, choose one target per bard level to gain the benefits of this masterpiece. An affected creature can move through areas at least half its width with no penalty for squeezing, and can move through a space at least one-quarter its width using the normal penalties for squeezing. This is a polymorph effect.
Use: 1 round of bardic performance per minute of this effect’s duration. 
Action: 1 minute.

name: Dark Adept
benefit: Gain new spell-like abilities.

class="page-content">

class="page-content">
You can daze creatures with the power of your songs.
BENEFIT
You can modify a song to daze a creature damaged by the song. When a creature takes damage from this song, they become dazed for a number of rounds equal to the original level of the song. If the song allows a saving throw, a successful save negates the daze effect. If the song does not allow a save, the target can make a Will save to negate the daze effect. If the song effect also causes the creature to become dazed, the duration of this metasong effect is added to the duration of the song. Songs that do not inflict damage do not benefit from this feat.

benefit: Use ki to stave off death.

prerequisites: Dex 13, Weapon Finesse, Perform (dance) 2 ranks, proficient with scimitar
benefit: Use Dex modifier instead of Str modifier with scimitar.

name: Desert Runner (Varg)
benefit: You gain a +5-foot racial bonus to your base speed when you travel through desert or plains terrain. Additionally, you gain the benefits of the Run feat while in those terrains.
text:
class="page-content">
In your native desert and savannah environments, you are unmatched in speed.
Prerequisite(s): Con 13, varg.
BENEFIT
You gain a +5-foot racial bonus to your base speed when you travel through desert or plains terrain. Additionally, you gain the benefits of the Run feat while in those terrains.
Special: You may take this feat an additional time, which adds +5 feet to your base speed. This also increases your run multiplier by 1, and grants you an additional +4 bonus to your Acrobatics checks for jumping after a running start.

name: Desperate Battler
benefit: Gain +1 morale bonus on melee attack and damage when alone

text:
class="page-content">
You’ve learn to chain different tier 1 weapon skills with an ally.
Prerequisite(s): Any tier 1 weapon skill feats, BAB +5.
BENEFIT

name: Detonator
benefit: At 5 TP or more, you may spend all TP to deliver a special firearm attack that takes the place of an attack in a full-attack or just a single attack. This attack deals normal damage, and lodges a payload into the target. This payload is delayed for 1 round and will explode for 1d6 fire damage. Successful ranged or melee attacks against the target increase the amount of damage the payload deals by +1d6, reaching a maximum of 3d6 fire damage. When the payload reaches the maximum amount of damage, it will immediately explode. This only affects the target. At 10 TP or more, you may spend all TP to lodge a payload that is delayed for 2 rounds, starting at 1d6 fire damage, increasing by + 1d6, to a maximum of 6d6 fire damage. At 15 TP, you may spend all TP to lodge a payload that is delayed for 3 rounds, starting at 1d6 fire damage, increasing by + 1d6, to a maximum of 9d6 fire damage.
text:
class="page-content">
A sly payload added to your shots make for a rather destructive addition.
Prerequisite(s): Sniper Shot, BAB +5.
BENEFIT
At 5 TP or more, you may spend all TP to deliver a special firearm attack that takes the place of an attack in a full-attack or just a single attack. This attack deals normal damage, and lodges a payload into the target. This payload is delayed for 1 round and will explode for 1d6 fire damage. Successful ranged or melee attacks against the target increase the amount of damage the payload deals by +1d6, reaching a maximum of 3d6 fire damage. When the payload reaches the maximum amount of damage, it will immediately explode. This only affects the target. At 10 TP or more, you may spend all TP to lodge a payload that is delayed for 2 rounds, starting at 1d6 fire damage, increasing by + 1d6, to a maximum of 6d6 fire damage. At 15 TP, you may spend all TP to lodge a payload that is delayed for 3 rounds, starting at 1d6 fire damage, increasing by + 1d6, to a maximum of 9d6 fire damage.

BENEFIT
Select one element (earth, fire, holy, ice, lightning, shadow, water, or wind). Upon a successful hit, with your selected element, with a power weapon that deals the same elemental damage, it can also inflict a status effect (these effects are considered 3rd-level spell effects):
• Earth: Upon a successful hit, the creature make a Fortitude save (DC 10 + half your caster level + your highest mental modifier) or be inflicted with the Weighted status for 1 round + 1 round per 5 caster levels. Each successful hit thereafter increases the duration by 1 round.
• Fire: Upon a successful hit, the creature make a Reflex save (DC 10 + half your caster level + your highest mental modifier) or be inflicted with the Burning status for 1 round + 1 round per 5 caster levels. Each successful hit thereafter increases the duration by 1 round.
• Holy: Upon a successful hit, the creature make a Fortitude save (DC 10 + half your caster level + your highest mental modifier) or be inflicted with the Illuminated status for 1 round + 1 round per 5 caster levels. Each successful hit thereafter increases the duration by 1 round.
• Ice: Upon a successful hit, the creature make a Fortitude save (DC 10 + half your caster level + your highest mental modifier) or be inflicted with the Frozen status for 1 round + 1 round per 5 caster levels. Each successful hit thereafter increases the duration by 1 round.
• Lightning: Upon a successful hit, the creature make a Reflex save (DC 10 + half your caster level + your highest mental modifier) or be inflicted with the Static status for 1 round + 1 round per 5 caster levels. Each successful hit thereafter increases the duration by 1 round.
• Shadow: Upon a successful hit, the creature make a Fortitude save (DC 10 + half your caster level + your highest mental modifier) or be inflicted with the Dimmed status for 1 round + 1 round per 5 caster levels. Each successful hit thereafter increases the duration by 1 round.
• Water: Upon a successful hit, the creature make a Fortitude save (DC 10 + half your caster level + your highest mental modifier) or be inflicted with the Drenched status for 1 round + 1 round per 5 caster levels. Each successful hit thereafter increases the duration by 1 round.
• Wind: Upon a successful hit, the creature must make a Reflex save (DC 10 + half your caster level + your highest mental modifier) or be inflicted with the Squalled status for 1 round + 1 round per 5 caster levels. Each successful hit thereafter increases the duration by 1 round.
Special: This feat can be taken multiple times. Each time this feat is taken, it applies to a different element.

benefit: A creature you jinx that is fascinated by a bard’s fascinate ability takes a –10 penalty on initiative checks while affected by the jinx. A creature under the effect of your fascinate ability has a –2 penalty on its save against your jinx.

name: Fast Blade
benefit: You gain a TP Pool, which begins at 0 and maximizes at 15. For each successful attack made by a heavy blade weapon group you make or get struck by a melee or ranged attack, you gain 1 TP. This attack deals damage as normal + 2d6 points of damage. At 10 TP or more, you may spend all TP to deal + 4d6 points of damage. At 15 TP, you may spend all TP to deal + 6d6 damage. This TP Pool lasts until you sleep for the night, in the morning, it empties out. In addition, your weapons of the heavy blade weapon group deal an additional point of damage for each weapon skill feat in this line that you have. If you have another TP pool from another weaponskill feat, it does not stack.

class="page-content">

If the song doesn’t allow a save, creatures harmed by it can attempt a Will save (against the same DC the song would have if it did allow a save) to negate the shaken effect. If the song effect already causes creatures to become shaken, on a failed save, add the duration of this metasong effect to the duration of the shaken condition imposed by the song. name: Gogo’s House of Imaginary Walls (Bardic Masterpiece)
text:
class="page-content">
You can trap opponents with the power of your acting.
Prerequisite(s): Perform (act) 10 ranks.
BENEFIT
You silently mime building an invisible wall, flattening your hands along linear planes to indicate its location and orientation. This “wall” is only real for creatures that see you perform this masterpiece (Will negates); you and your allies may automatically fail your saves if you want to treat the wall as real (for example, if you want to use the wall as a bridge to cross a chasm). For creatures who believe the wall is real, it has hardness 8, 90 hit points, and a break DC of 30 (multiple believing creatures can attack the walls, breaking through it more quickly as if they were all attacking a real wall rather than each attacking separate mental constructs). This is an illusion (phantasm) effect. Because the wall is a mental image, it blocks incorporeal creatures that fail their saves (because they perceive it as a magical barrier that excludes them), though they can still go around the wall or through the floor or ceiling to bypass it. It does not affect objects or creatures immune to mental effects (which can result in situations like an archer firing through the wall but unable to physically cross it).
You can create one 10-foot-square wall per use of this ability; over several rounds you can extend this square or create other walls, all of which persist until you stop using bardic performance rounds to sustain them. The wall is immobile once created. Part of the wall must be in or along the edge of your space, and you cannot create a wall that extends beyond your natural reach (though you can create a wall, move, and create another by using this ability again). Once created, the wall exists until you end your performance or affected creatures “break” it. Abilities that extend the duration of a bardic performance (such as Lingering Performance) affect this masterpiece.
Use: 1 bardic performance round per round. 
Action: 1 standard action per 10 ft. square.
