name: Greater Syricta Nobility (Syricta)
prerequisites: Syricta, Syricta Nobility and Improved Syricta Nobility feats
benefit: Increase your Constitution score by 1, up to a maximum of 20. Your breath weapon can now be used once every 1d4 rounds instead of uses per day and increases breath weapon damage by your Constitution modifier.
text:
class="page-content">
Your blood courses with power, granting your breath weapon multiple uses and greater power.
Prerequisite(s): Syricta, Syricta Nobility and Improved Syricta Nobility feats.
BENEFIT
• Increase your Constitution score by 1, up to a maximum of 20.
• Your breath weapon can now be used once every 1d4 rounds instead of uses per day and increases breath weapon damage by your Constitution modifier.

name: Greater Tenacious Hunter
prerequisites: Combat Reflexes, Tenacious Hunter, Perception 3 ranks, Stealth 3 ranks
benefit: Deny Dexterity bonus to creatures pinpointed

name: Greater Weapon of the Chosen
benefit: Roll twice with your favored weapon and take the better roll

name: Greater Weapon Shift
prerequisites: Improved Weapon Shift, Weapon Shift, beast shape class feature
benefit: When you apply a melee weapon’s damage type and properties to your natural attacks using the Weapon Shift feat, your natural attacks also gain an enhancement bonus on attack and damage rolls equal to the enhancement bonus (if any) of the weapon.
text:
class="page-content">
In animal form, your natural attacks are as deadly as the weapons you were holding.
Prerequisites: Improved Weapon Shift, Weapon Shift, beast shape class feature.
BENEFIT
When you apply a melee weapon’s damage type and properties to your natural attacks using the Weapon Shift feat, your natural attacks also gain an enhancement bonus on attack and damage rolls equal to the enhancement bonus (if any) of the weapon.

name: Greater Whip Mastery
benefit: Grapple using a whip

name: Greater Wild Empathy
prerequisites: Knowledge (nature) 5 ranks, wild empathy class feature
benefit: Use wild empathy to intimidate and expand the creatures it can affect.

name: Greater Wilding Strike
prerequisites: Str 18, Improved Unarmed Strike, Improved Wilding Strike, Wilding, Wilding Strike, BAB +16
benefit: Your unarmed strike damage increases to 1d10 (or 1d8 if you are Small)

name: Green Faith Acolyte
benefit: Your spells work more efficiently on plants.

name: Grisly Ornament
benefit: You can attempt a Craft or Heal check to craft a special type of trophy called an ornament from part of a creature that’s been dead for less than an hour.

name: Groundling
prerequisites: Cha 13, gnome, gnome magic racial trait
benefit: Speak with burrowing animals as spell-like ability.

name: Group Deliver Touch Spells
prerequisites: Group Shared Spells, have a familiar with the share spells and deliver touch spells abilities
benefit: You and any allies with this feat can cast spells through one another’s familiars as though each ally had the share spells ability with each other familiar. This feat otherwise functions as the share spells ability.

name: Group Limit Break
benefit: Whenever you or your allies with this teamwork feat within 30 feet are at half health, you or your allies can initiate a Limit Break (regardless if you or your allies aren’t at half health, as long as one of you are).

name: Group Shared Spells
prerequisites: Have a familiar with the share spells ability
benefit: You and any allies with this feat can cast spells with a target of “you” on each other’s familiars as touch spells. Both the target familiar and that familiar’s master must be willing for the spell to take effect. You can cast spells on each other’s familiars even if the spells would not normally affect creatures of the targeted familiar’s type.

name: Grow Plant Creature
prerequisites: Train Plants, Handle Animal 5 ranks, Knowledge (nature) 5 ranks
benefit: You can grow plants and perform rituals to invest them with animating spirits, becoming assassin vines, treants, or viper vines. Each plant creature has a list of additional prerequisites, costs, and skill checks required to grow them (see Growing Plant Creatures below). At the GM’s discretion, characters with this feat may grow other plant creatures as well.

name: Grudge Fighter
benefit: You gain a +1 morale bonus on attack and damage rolls made against any creature that attacked you in the current combat.

name: Grudge Fighter (Combat, Seeq)
benefit: You gain a +1 morale bonus on attack and damage rolls made against any creature that attacked you in the current combat.

name: Gruesome Shapechanger
benefit: Bloody transformation sickens foes and makes area slippery

name: Gruesome Slaughter
prerequisites: Intimidating Prowess, Killing Flourish, Intimidate 11 ranks, slayer 11
benefit: Creatures demoralized by Killing Flourish could become sickened

name: Guarded Charge (Combat, Shield Mastery)
prerequisites: Shield Focus, base attack bonus +6 or fighter level 4th.
benefit: When performing a bull rush or overrun combat maneuver as part of a charge, you don’t provoke an attack of opportunity for that maneuver. If you already have the Improved Bull Rush or Improved Overrun feats, you gain an additional +2 bonus on your combat maneuver check when attempting the respective maneuver.

name: Guardian of the Wild
benefit: When you are in a terrain type you have selected the Attuned to the Wild feat for, you gain a +2 dodge bonus to Armor Class

name: Guardian of the Wild (Viera)
benefit: When you are in a terrain type you have selected the Attuned to the Wild feat for, you gain a +2 dodge bonus to Armor Class. If you are in an area that qualifies as more than one kind of terrain, these bonuses do not stack; you receive the bonus for only one of the terrain types.
text:
class="page-content">
Your mystic connection with the wilderness enhances your ability to react to threats.
Prerequisite(s): Attuned to the Wild, viera.
BENEFIT
When you are in a terrain type you have selected the Attuned to the Wild feat for, you gain a +2 dodge bonus to Armor Class. If you are in an area that qualifies as more than one kind of terrain, these bonuses do not stack; you receive the bonus for only one of the terrain types.

name: Guided Hand
prerequisites: Channel Smite, proficiency with deity’s chosen weapon
benefit: May use Wisdom modifier for attack rolls with favored weapon.

name: Guild Partner
benefit: Whenever you are in a settlement that is the size of small town or larger, you can purchase (but not sell) items through your contacts.

name: Gun Arm Expertise (Combat)
benefit: When you use the full-attack action, you may fire your gun arm as an additional attack against the same target if you have successfully hit with a melee attack using the gun arm during the round, using the same BAB with a -5 penalty without provoking attacks of opportunity.

name: Gun Twirling
prerequisites: Amateur Gunslinger feat or grit class feature, Dazzling Display, Weapon Focus
benefit: You can spend 1 grit point to make a feint attempt using a one-handed firearm for which you have Weapon Focus (instead of a melee weapon). The target of this feint must be within 30 feet of you and be able to see you. If you have the Quick Draw feat, you can holster a one-handed firearm as a free action as long as you have at least 1 grit point.

name: Gunslinger
prerequisites: BAB +4, Weapon Focus (any firearm), proficiency with any firearm
benefit: When you attack with a firearm, you do not provoke attacks of opportunity.

name: Gunslinger (Combat, Variety of Races)
prerequisites: Goblin, gnath, tarutaru, moogle, mandragora, tonkin, or palico
benefit: You can wield Medium firearms without taking the penalty for an inappropriately sized weapon.
text:
class="page-content">
You have learned how to fire the big guns.
Prerequisite(s): Goblin, gnath, moogle, tarutaru, mandragora, tonkin, or palico.
BENEFIT
You can wield Medium firearms without taking the penalty for an inappropriately sized weapon.
Normal: You take a –2 penalty when using an inappropriately sized weapon.

name: Gunsmithing
benefit: If you have access to a gunsmith’s kit, you can create and restore firearms/gunarms, craft bullets, and mix black powder for all types of firearms. You do not need to make a Craft check to create firearms, gunarms and ammunition or to restore firearms.
text:
class="page-content">
You know the secrets of repairing and restoring firearms and gun arms.
BENEFIT
If you have access to a gunsmith’s kit, you can create and restore firearms/gunarms, craft bullets, and mix black powder for all types of firearms. You do not need to make a Craft check to create firearms, gunarms and ammunition or to restore firearms.
• Crafting Firearms: You can craft any firearm or gun arm for a cost in raw materials equal to half the price of the firearm. Crafting a firearm in this way takes 1 day of work.
• Crafting Ammunition: You can craft a stack of ammo for a cost in raw materials equal to 50% of the price. If you have at least 1 rank in Craft (alchemy), you can craft alchemical cartridges for a cost in raw materials equal to half the price of the cartridge. Crafting a stack of ammo takes 1 day of work.
• Restoring a Broken Firearm: Each day, with an hour’s worth of work, you can use this feat to repair a single firearm with the broken condition. You can take time during a rest period to restore a broken firearm with this feat.
Special: If you have a class feature that grants a battered weapon as part of a class feature, this feat grants the following additional benefit. You can use this feat to repair and restore your initial, battered weapon. It costs 300 gp and 1 day of work to upgrade it to a masterwork firearm of its type.

name: Gunsmithing
benefit: May create, repair, and restore firearms.

name: Gust Slash
benefit: At 5 TP or more, you may spend all TP to deliver a special light blade attack that takes a place of an attack of a full-attack or just a single attack. This attack deals damage as normal + 2d6 points of wind damage. At 10 TP or more, you may spend all TP to deal + 4d6 points of wind damage. At 15 TP, you may spend all TP to deal + 6d6 points of wind damage.
text:
class="page-content">
You can deliver a special light blade attack that slices a foe with wind damage.
Prerequisite(s): Wasp Sting, BAB +5.
BENEFIT
At 5 TP or more, you may spend all TP to deliver a special light blade attack that takes a place of an attack of a full-attack or just a single attack. This attack deals damage as normal + 2d6 points of wind damage. At 10 TP or more, you may spend all TP to deal + 4d6 points of wind damage. At 15 TP, you may spend all TP to deal + 6d6 points of wind damage.

name: Hacker
benefit: You gain a +2 bonus to Knowledge (Technology) and Computers. Computers is considered a class skill for you. If you have 10 or more ranks in these skills, the bonus increases to +4.
text:
class="page-content">
You are familiar with the advanced mechanics of technology.
BENEFIT
You gain a +2 bonus to Knowledge (Technology) and Computers. Computers is considered a class skill for you. If you have 10 or more ranks in these skills, the bonus increases to +4.

name: Half-Drow Paragon
prerequisites: Drow-blooded and drow magic racial traits, half-elf
benefit: You count as a drow for any effects that relate to race

name: Halfling Slinger
benefit: You gain a +1 racial bonus on attack rolls made using a sling.

name: Hamatula Grasp
prerequisites: Hamatula Strike, Improved Grapple, Str 13, BAB +9
benefit: Deal more damage to foes impaled with Hamatula Strike.

name: Hamatula Strike
benefit: Impale opponents with grapple checks.

name: Hamatulatsu
prerequisites: Improved Unarmed Strike, Weapon Focus (unarmed strike)
benefit: Unarmed attacks can inflict piercing damage and sicken foes

name: Hammer the Gap
benefit: With a full-attack action, each hit against the same opponent deals extra damage

name: Hand’s Autonomy
benefit: Your possessed hand can act independently.

name: Hand’s Detachment
benefit: Your possessed hand can painlessly pull free of your body or reattach itself, leaving you with a bloodless but raw-looking stump at the end of one arm while the hand itself performs remote tasks under your command, acting in many ways like a strange familiar

name: Hand’s Knowledge
benefit: The connection to the memories of the spirit possessing your hand deepens.

name: Hand’s Sight
benefit: While your possessed hand isn’t carrying anything, you gain darkvision with a range of 60 feet and cannot be flanked.

name: Hard-headed
benefit: You gain a +1 bonus on attack rolls and combat maneuver checks made using a helmet. You receive a +2 bonus on saves against spells and special abilities that cause you to become staggered or stunned.

name: Harder They Fall
prerequisites: Str 13, Int 13, Combat Expertise, Power Attack
benefit: Grant ally a +2 bonus on bull rush or trip attempt

name: Harmonic Sage
prerequisites: Bardic performance class feature, Knowledge (engineering) 5 ranks
benefit: Gain extra abilities when performing within an artificial structure.

name: Harmonic Song
text:
class="page-content">
You can weave bardic music effects into your songs in such a way that your song-performing and bardic performance become indistinguishable.
Prerequisite(s): Bardic performance ability.
BENEFIT
Whenever you perform a 1st or higher level song while you are maintaining a bardic performance, you can maintain the bardic performance for that round without expending one of your rounds of performance for the day. In addition, you can switch from one bardic performance to another as a swift action when you perform a song while maintaining a bardic performance.

name: Harmonic Spell
benefit: Casting spells extends duration of your bardic performance.

name: Harrowed
benefit: +1 on saves vs. enchantment; can draw Harrow cards for bonuses.

name: Harrowed Summoning
benefit: When you cast a conjuration (summoning) spell or use a spell-like ability to summon one or more creatures, you can draw two random cards from a complete harrow deck you own.

name: Harrying Partners
benefit: When you successfully use the aid another action to improve the Armor Class or attack roll of an ally who also has this feat, the benefit from aid another lasts until the beginning of your next turn.

name: Haruspicy
benefit: If you perform a successful coup de grace, you gain a +2 circumstance bonus on skill checks attempted as part of a single occult ritual or occult skill unlock performed within the next minute.

name: Hasty Rebirth
benefit: You rejuvenate in just one day.

name: Haunt Scavenger
prerequisites: Any one item creation feat or Craft (alchemy) 3 ranks
benefit: You can harvest the ectoplasmic remains of haunts, incorporeal undead, or the like to craft magic items.

name: Haunted Gnome
prerequisites: Cha 13, gnome magic racial trait, Knowledge (arcana) 1 rank
benefit: You add haunted fey aspect to your list of gnome magic spell-like abilities, and you can use this spell-like ability twice per day.

name: Haunted Gnome Assault
benefit: Gain independent use of gnome magic

name: Haunted Gnome Shroud
benefit: Gain additional use of gnome magic

name: Healer’s Touch
prerequisites: Cure a cumulative total of 1,000 points of damage for other creatures with healing spells, dealing damage slows the progress
benefit: Healing spells to heal targets other than yourself are maximized.

name: Heavenly Radiance
prerequisites: Aasimar, daylight spell-like ability, sufficiently high level (see description)
benefit: Gain additional spell-like abilities

name: Heavenly Radiance (Forgiven)
prerequisites: Forgiven , Light spell-like ability, sufficiently high level and Charisma (see feat description)
benefit: You gain one additional use per day of daylight. Choose one spell from the table below; by expending a use of daylight, you may use this spell as a spell-like ability. To select a spell, you must meet the minimum character level and Charisma score for its listing in the table. The save DC for this spell is Charisma-based.
text:
class="page-content">
Your strong light can be used in a variety of ways.
Prerequisite(s): Forgiven , Daylight spell-like ability, sufficiently high level and Charisma (see below).
BENEFIT
You gain one additional use per day of daylight. Choose one spell from the table below; by expending a use of daylight, you may use this spell as a spell-like ability. To select a spell, you must meet the minimum character level and Charisma score for its listing in the table. The save DC for this spell is Charisma-based.
Spell-Like AbilityMinimum Character LevelMinimum Charisma Score
Holy Weapon3rd12
Light Rays 5th13
Radiant Spikes7th14
Holy Light 9th15
Radiance11th16
Special: You may take this feat multiple times. Each time you select it, you gain an additional use of daylight and may select another spell from the table.

name: Heighten Song (Metasong)
benefit: Variable
text:
class="page-content">
You can perform songs as if they were a higher level.
BENEFIT
A heightened song has a higher song level than normal (up to a maximum of 6th level). Unlike other metasong feats, Heighten song actually increases the effective level of the song that it modifies. All effects dependent on song level (such as saving throw DCs) are calculated according to the heightened level.
MP Increase: The heightened song costs MP equal to a song of its effective level. In addition, the perform check DC increases by its new effective level.

name: Heighten Spell
benefit: Treat spell as a higher level

name: Heighten Spell (Metamagic)
benefit: Variable

name: Hell Knight Aegis
prerequisites: Heavy Armor Proficiency, BAB +5, allegiance to a Hell Knight order
benefit: Once per day as a full-round action, you can give your armor the broken condition.

name: Hell Knight Obedience
prerequisites: Knowledge (planes) 3 ranks, allegiance to a Hell Knight order
benefit: Upon taking this feat, you gain proficiency in all of your order’s favored weapons. Additionally, by meditating and inflicting strenuous reckonings upon yourself, you unlock the power behind your order’s doctrine.

name: Hell Knight Obsession
prerequisites: Hell Knight Obedience, Knowledge (planes) 3 ranks, allegiance to a Hell Knight order
benefit: During your hour-long reckoning, if you choose to deal lethal damage to yourself, you reach a state of fantastic focus.

name: Hellcat Pounce
prerequisites: Hellcat Stealth, Skill Focus (Stealth), sneak attack +2d6
benefit: Gain bonus attacks against surprised opponents.

name: Hellcat Stealth
benefit: You may make Stealth checks in normal or bright light even when observed, but at a -10 penalty.

name: Helpless Prisoner
prerequisites: Bluff 5 ranks, Escape Artist 1 rank, gnome
benefit: Make Bluff checks to convince captors of your harmlessness.

name: Hermean Blood
benefit: 2 skills of your choice are class skills.

name: Heroic Defiance
benefit: Once per day, delay onset of harmful condition for 1 round.

name: Heroic Leader
prerequisites: Cha 13; any combat feat; ability to gain an animal companion, cohort, eidolon, familiar, or mount
benefit: Your animal companion, cohort, eidolon, familiar, or mount doesn’t count as threatening your opponent for the purposes of feats that require you to be the only character threatening a target. Allies with Hit Dice equal to or less than 1/2 your own Hit Dice don’t count as threatening opponents for the purposes of such feats.

name: Heroic Recovery
benefit: Once per day, gain new saving throw against harmful condition requiring Fort save.

name: Heroic Will
prerequisites: Iron Will, base Will save +4, human
benefit: Reroll a Will saving throw once per day

name: Hero’s Fortune
benefit: You gain a hero point. The maximum number of hero points you can have at any one time is increased to 5.

name: Hex Strike
prerequisites: Hex class feature, Improved Unarmed Strike
benefit: Upon successful unarmed strike, you may use a hex

name: Hidden Presence
prerequisites: Int or Cha 17, ability to cast possession or
benefit: Abjurations and divinations treat you as the greater possession possessed creature

name: Hide Worker
benefit: Gain a +4 bonus on Craft (armor) checks when 3 ranks working with hides, can sometimes craft items at discount

name: Hide-Out
benefit: Anyone attempting to locate or scry upon you finds it more difficult.

name: High Magic Focus
prerequisites: Any metamagic feat, Spellcraft 7 ranks, ability to cast 2nd-level spells, human
benefit: Spontaneously apply metamagic feats without using higher-level spell slots or increasing casting time if allies ready an action to cast the same spell

name: Hindrance Dismissal
benefit: You can dismiss any pit spell (such as create pit, hungry pit, spiked pit, and similar spells with ‘pit’ in their names) or wall spell (such as wall of fire, wall of ice, and similar spells with ‘wall’ in their names) you cast. The spells must have a duration of at least 1 round. This ability follows the normal rules for dismissing spells, allowing you to dismiss conjured pits and walls as a standard action.

name: History of Scars
prerequisites: Take a cumulative total of 1,000 points of damage, being healed reduces this total
benefit: Take a penalty on Charisma checks, but gain a thick natural armor skin.

name: Hobgoblin Discipline
benefit: While you are near other hobgoblins, gain a bonus on saving throws

name: Hold the Blade
benefit: If you have one hand free, as an immediate action you can take a -4 penalty to your AC and attempt to disarm an opponent that has hit you with a melee weapon as part of a flanking attack or a sneak attack.

name: Hologram Emitter (Shindroid)
prerequisites: Shindroid, Magitek Unit alternate racial trait
benefit: You gain the ability to cast Mind Map and Silent Image as spell-like abilities up to a total of 3 times per day, but their range is one 10ft cube within 5ft of you. You can use Silent Image to speech, but only while making an illusion that copies creatures, and the movement thereof that you’ve seen before, and only while copying the movements when they were saying what they had previously said, making a visual record of an event.
text:
class="page-content">
You have the ability to create small holograms.
Prerequisites: Shindroid, Magitek Unit alternate racial trait.
BENEFIT
You gain the ability to cast Mind Map and Silent Image as spell-like abilities up to a total of 3 times per day, but their range is one 10ft cube within 5ft of you. You can use Silent Image to speech, but only while making an illusion that copies creatures, and the movement thereof that you’ve seen before, and only while copying the movements when they were saying what they had previously said, making a visual record of an event.

name: Horde Charge
benefit: Gain an additional bonus to attack and damage rolls when charging

name: Horde Charge (Teamwork, Galka)
benefit: When charging during the same round as an ally with this feat, you gain a +2 bonus on attack and damage rolls in addition to the normal bonus for charging. If you can make multiple attacks on a charge, this bonus only applies to the first attack.

name: Horrific Gorging
prerequisites: Bite attack, swallow whole universal monster ability, size Large or larger
benefit: Swallow one foe to make its allies shaken

name: Horse Master
prerequisites: Expert trainer class feature, Ride 6 ranks
benefit: Use your character level to determine powers and abilities for your mount

name: Hostile Figment
prerequisites: Ability to cast 2nd-level spells, Spell Focus (Illusion)
benefit: As long as you have an illusion spell of 2nd level or higher in your known spells and have at least 2 MP in your MP pool, you are able to produce threatening figments. As a swift action, you can choose a 5-ft square within 5 ft per highest-level illusion spell you can cast, to be the originating point of an hostile figment. The hostile figment threaten opponents, although it is unable to attack on its own (see below), it does allow allies to flank. The hostile figment lasts for 1 round before disappearing. A threatened creature is allowed a Will save (DC 10 + half caster level + caster modifier) to disbelieve the figment, negating its effect against that creature. As a standard action, you can have the hostile figment lash out at an opponent it threatens. This deals 1d4 damage per level of the highest-level illusion spell you can cast and deal bludgeoning, earth, fire, piercing, ice, lightning, slashing, water, or wind damage, as appropriate to the illusion. You cannot target an opponent that has successfully disbelieved the hostile figment. As a secondary benefit, you gain a +1 competence bonus to your caster level when casting illusion spells.
text:
class="page-content">
You create figments of imagination that can strike creatures.
Prerequisite(s): Ability to cast 2nd-level spells, Spell Focus (Illusion).
BENEFIT
As long as you have an illusion spell of 2nd level or higher in your known spells and have at least 2 MP in your MP pool, you are able to produce threatening figments. As a swift action, you can choose a 5-ft square within 5 ft per highest-level illusion spell you can cast, to be the originating point of an hostile figment. The hostile figment threaten opponents, although it is unable to attack on its own (see below), it does allow allies to flank. The hostile figment lasts for 1 round before disappearing. A threatened creature is allowed a Will save (DC 10 + half caster level + caster modifier) to disbelieve the figment, negating its effect against that creature.
As a standard action, you can have the hostile figment lash out at an opponent it threatens. This deals 1d4 damage per level of the highest-level illusion spell you can cast and deal bludgeoning, earth, fire, piercing, ice, lightning, slashing, water, or wind damage, as appropriate to the illusion. You cannot target an opponent that has successfully disbelieved the hostile figment.
As a secondary benefit, you gain a +1 competence bonus to your caster level when casting illusion spells.

name: Hover
benefit: This creature can hover in place with ease and can kick up clouds of dust and debris.

name: Human Spirit
benefit: You receive 1 bonus skill rank, plus 1 per level (max 4)

name: Huntmaster
prerequisites: Handle Animal 1 rank; either the animal companion, divine bond (mount), or mount class feature; human
benefit: Your bond with your animal companion or special mount is stronger than most

name: Hurricane Breath
prerequisites: Ability to cast 2nd-level spells, Elemental Focus (Wind).
benefit: As long as you have an elemental (wind) spell of 2nd level or higher in your known spells and have at least 2 MP in your MP pool, you can attempt to knock a single creature within 30 feet back with a blast of wind. This requires a standard action and functions much like a bull rush; roll 1d20 + the level of the highest-level wind spell you can cast opposed by your opponent's Strength check. If you succeed, you push the creature back 5 feet. As a secondary benefit, you gain a +1 competence bonus to your caster level when casting elemental (wind) spells.
text:
class="page-content">
The power of elemental wind you hold in your mind allows you to exhale the wind.
Prerequisite(s): Ability to cast 2nd-level spells, Elemental Focus (Wind).
BENEFIT
As long as you have an elemental (wind) spell of 2nd level or higher in your known spells and have at least 2 MP in your MP pool, you can attempt to knock a single creature within 30 feet back with a blast of wind. This requires a standard action and functions much like a bull rush; roll 1d20 + the level of the highest-level wind spell you can cast opposed by your opponent’s Strength check. If you succeed, you push the creature back 5 feet. As a secondary benefit, you gain a +1 competence bonus to your caster level when casting elemental (wind) spells.

name: Hydraulic Maneuver
benefit: Use hydraulic push to perform combat maneuvers

name: Hydromancy
prerequisites: Ability to cast 4th-level spells, Elemental Focus (Water)
benefit: As long as you have an elemental (water) spell of 4th level or higher in your known spells and have at least 4 MP in your MP pool, you may control water at-will using half your caster level. When you cast control water (whether at will or using MP to cast it), you may even sculpt the water into any shape you desire, although it is still water. While you could make a pillar of water to raise yourself given a sufficient amount, making a water ladder is probably not a good idea. As a secondary benefit, you gain a +1 competence bonus to your caster level when casting elemental (water) spells.
text:
class="page-content">
Your mastery of water magic beckons at your command.
Prerequisite(s): Ability to cast 4th-level spells, Elemental Focus (Water).
BENEFIT
As long as you have an elemental (water) spell of 4th level or higher in your known spells and have at least 4 MP in your MP pool, you may control water at-will using half your caster level. When you cast control water (whether at will or using MP to cast it), you may even sculpt the water into any shape you desire, although it is still water. While you could make a pillar of water to raise yourself given a sufficient amount, making a water ladder is probably not a good idea. As a secondary benefit, you gain a +1 competence bonus to your caster level when casting elemental (water) spells.

name: Hymn of Restored Balance (Bardic Masterpiece)
text:
class="page-content">
You perform a song of such beauty that it touches the soul of any who hears it, allowing them to recover from any adverse conditions.
Prerequisite(s): Perform (sing) or Perform (wind) 6 ranks.
BENEFIT
At the end of the round on which you complete this song, all allies within 30 feet who observed your performance gain a new saving throw to end the ongoing effects of certain debilitating conditions. An ally who is exhausted, fatigued, nauseated, sickened, staggered, or stunned as the result of a previously failed saving throw can attempt a new saving throw to immediately end one of the above effects. Characters under multiple effects must choose which effect they wish to attempt to end prematurely. Effects that did not grant a saving throw to resist can’t be ended by this masterpiece.
In addition, anyone who observed this performance gains the effects of delay poison at a caster level equal to your bard level.
Use: 3 bardic performance rounds. 
Action: 1 full round.

name: Hymn Singer
prerequisites: Bardic performance, good alignment, worshiper of a good deity
benefit: Your bardic performances keep vampires at bay.

name: Ice Climber
prerequisites: Arctic Adaptation or Mountaineer; Climb 2 ranks
benefit: Gain bonuses to climb on or move across slippery surfaces and to notice and avoid avalanches

name: Ifrit’s Rondo (Bardic Masterpiece)
text:
class="page-content">
Incendiary rhythms quicken your allies’ movements, but the effort of keeping up with the beat causes burnout.
Prerequisite(s): Perform (oratory) or Perform (percussion) 7 ranks.
BENEFIT

These allies must be within 60 feet of you to receive this benefit. class="page-content">

This fast-paced tune harmonizes with the magical frequencies of another plane, allowing you to draw an extraplanar creature to you and bargain for its service. When you complete this performance, you call one or more outsiders as if using planar ally. Unlike with planar ally, the creature is not necessarily associated with your deity, and has an initial attitude of “indifferent” toward you. This ability otherwise works like planar ally.
