name: Reactive Arcane Shield
benefit: If you are aware of an attack against you that has already been declared and you choose to use the Arcane Shield feat, the immediate action to activate the feat occurs before the attack roll against you is resolved. In addition, all adjacent allies also gain the feat’s deflection bonus to AC for 1 round.

name: Reactive Healing
prerequisites: Quick Channel or Quicken Spell; channel energy or lay on hands class feature
benefit: When reduced to 0 hp or fewer, use channel energy or lay on hands to heal yourself as immediate action.

name: Read Spell Traces
benefit: Learn more from magic auras

name: Ready for Anything
prerequisites: Alertness, Improved Initiative, Lightning Reflexes, Quick Draw, BAB +6 or uncanny dodge class feature
benefit: Always act on the surprise round

name: Ready for Battle
benefit: +2 on initiative rolls for allies with implanted tricks

name: Ready for Pain
benefit: DR/— against nonlethal damage for allies with implanted tricks

name: Realistic Likeness
benefit: You can mimic an individual that you have encountered

name: Rebounding Leap
prerequisites: Acrobatics 5 ranks, Ride 11 ranks, leaping lance class feature
benefit: Remount your steed as a swift action with successful Acrobatics check.

name: Rebuffing Reduction
benefit: Bull Rush opponent who fails to pierce your DR.

name: Reckless Aim
benefit: Take a –1 penalty to AC and gain a +2 competence bonus on attack roll with a ranged attack against opponent engaged in melee. If you roll a natural 1 the attack, you hit a random adjacent creature threatening the target instead.

name: Reckless Moves
benefit: Use an adjacent ally to help you stay balanced in combat but to their disadvantage.

name: Reckless Rage
prerequisites: Power Attack; rage or raging song class feature
benefit: Take a penalty on attack rolls to deal more damage while raging.

name: Recovered Rage
prerequisites: Rage or raging song class feature
benefit: Regain rage or raging song with each foe you reduce to 0 or fewer hit points.

name: Recruits
benefit: You gain a number of cohorts (as the Leadership feat) that represent NPCs you are responsible for instructing and overseeing.

name: Red Feast
benefit: You deal 1d6 Con damage and gain 10 hp or 10 temporary hp from your blood drain special attack.

name: Red Lotus Blade
benefit: At 5 TP or more, you may spend all TP to deliver a special heavy blade attack that takes a place of an attack of a full-attack or just a single attack. This attack deals damage as normal and causes your sword to light up with flames like a flaming weapon for 1 minute. At 10 TP or more, you may spend all TP to causes your sword to light up with flames like a flaming burst weapon for 2 minutes. At 15 TP, you may spend all TP to cause your heavy blade attacks to inflict Burning status (DC 10 + half of your character level + your Strength modifier) for 1 minute.
text:
class="page-content">
You can deliver a special heavy blade attack that causes your blade to light up with a red, glowing flame.
Prerequisite(s): Burning Blade, BAB +7.
BENEFIT
At 5 TP or more, you may spend all TP to deliver a special heavy blade attack that takes a place of an attack of a full-attack or just a single attack. This attack deals damage as normal and causes your sword to light up with flames like a flaming weapon for 1 minute. At 10 TP or more, you may spend all TP to causes your sword to light up with flames like a flaming burst weapon for 2 minutes. At 15 TP, you may spend all TP to cause your heavy blade attacks to inflict Burning status (DC 10 + half of your character level + your Strength modifier) for 1 minute.

name: Redeemed Kobold
benefit: Your scales gain a metallic sheen, making you more likable to surface races

name: Redirect Attack
benefit: Once per turn, when an opponent only you threaten fails an attack against you, you can redirect the attack to target another foe. The new target must be adjacent to you and within reach of the opponent that missed you. Attempt a combat maneuver check; if the result exceeds both the Combat Maneuver Defense of the opponent who missed you and the Armor Class of the new target, the attack strikes and deals its normal damage.

name: Reflexive Interception
prerequisites: Intercept Blow, base attack bonus +3, evasion
benefit: Provide evasion to master

name: Reinforce Crafting
prerequisites: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, ability to cast make whole or mending
benefit: Your magical creations are hardier than most.

name: Reject Poison
benefit: Improve your chances against poisons you are familiar with.

name: Relentless Butcher
benefit: Stun your opponents with critical hits.

name: Relentless Cheer
prerequisites: Halfling, fearless and halfling luck racial traits
benefit: +1 on all saves, increasing to +3 vs. fear, when adjacent to allies who have this feat

name: Relentless Reprise (Bardic Masterpiece)
prerequisites: Perform (keyboard), Perform (sing), Perform (string), or Perform (wind) 4 ranks.
text:
class="page-content">
Your song replays endlessly in your target’s mind, sapping resolve and sanity.
Prerequisite(s): Perform (keyboard), Perform (sing), Perform (string), or Perform (wind) 4 ranks.
BENEFIT
Whenever you end a bardic performance, you can add a quick reprise that makes it unnaturally catchy. Any creature within 30 feet of you when you finish your performance will run the risk of having your tune replaying endlessly in its mind. Unless the creature succeeds on a Will saving throw (DC = 10 + 1/2 your bard level + your Charisma modifier), the tune distracts it for 1 day per bard level. The creature takes a –4 penalty on concentration checks, initiative checks, and Perception checks as long as it remains distracted. The creature’s sleep also becomes fitful, requiring half again as long for the usual benefit and entirely negating the benefits of full bed rest beyond a normal rest. Once per day upon waking after rest, the creature can attempt a new Will saving throw to shake off the relentless reprise. If it fails, the creature takes 1d2 points of Wisdom damage.
This is a curse effect with audible components.
Use: 1 round of bardic performance. 
Action: 1 immediate action.

name: Relentless Shot
benefit: When you trip an opponent within 30 feet with a ranged attack, you also threaten that opponent until your next turn and you can make attacks of opportunity against that opponent with ranged weapons.

name: Relic Breaker
prerequisites: Str 13, Gate Breaker, Improved Sunder, Power Attack, BAB +1.
benefit: Whenever you sunder a held object, its bearer must succeed at a Reflex saving throw or the bearer catches on fire (taking 1d6 points of fire damage immediately, and an additional 1d6 points of fire damage each subsequent round the creature fails a Reflex saving throw). When your total Hit Dice reach 5, this damage increases by 1d6, and it increases by 1d6 every 5 levels thereafter, to a maximum of 5d6 at 20th level. The saving throw’s DC is equal to 10 + 1/2 your HD + your Charisma modifier.

name: Remote Bomb
benefit: Increase the delay on your bombs and detonate bombs remotely.

name: Rending Claws
benefit: Deal 1d6 extra damage if both claws hit.

name: Rending Claws (Bangaa)
prerequisites: Base attack bonus +6, claws racial trait, bangaa
benefit: If you hit with two claw attacks in 1 round, the attack deals additional damage equal to 1d3 + your 1-1/2 Str modifier.

name: Rending Fury
benefit: Need half the normal number of attacks to deal rend damage.

name: Reposition, Greater
benefit: Enemies you reposition provoke attacks of opportunity.

name: Reposition, Improved
benefit: +2 bonus on reposition attempts, no AOO.

name: Reposition, Tactical
benefit: You can reposition a foe into a dangerous space such as a pit or blade barrier.

name: Repositioning Strike
benefit: Attempt a reposition attack on a successful critical hit.

name: Researcher
benefit: In a small town or larger settlement, you can research notes and gain a bonus on a Knowledge check.

name: Resilient Armor
prerequisites: Divine bond (armor or shield) or sacred armor class feature
benefit: Gain DR against the some attacks.

name: Resilient Brute
benefit: Convert some damage from a critical hit to nonlethal damage

name: Resilient Brute (Galka)
benefit: Once per day, when a creature confirms a critical hit against you, you may treat half the damage as nonlethal damage. You cannot use this ability if you are immune to nonlethal damage. When your base attack bonus reaches +10, you may use this ability an additional time per day.
text:
class="page-content">
You absorb punishment others find deadly.
Prerequisite(s): Galka.
BENEFIT
Once per day, when a creature confirms a critical hit against you, you may treat half the damage as nonlethal damage. You cannot use this ability if you are immune to nonlethal damage. When your base attack bonus reaches +10, you may use this ability an additional time per day.

name: Resilient Eidolon
benefit: When you are knocked unconscious, fall asleep, or are killed, your eidolon remains with you.

name: Resolute Rager
benefit: Make an additional saving throw against a fear effect currently affecting you

name: Resolute Rager (Seeq)
benefit: While raging, when under the effect of a fear effect that allows a saving throw, you can make a new saving throw against that fear effect at the start of each of your turns before acting. If you make the new save, the fear effect ends.
text:
class="page-content">
Fear passes quickly while you are raging.
Prerequisite(s): Seeq, rage class feature.
BENEFIT
While raging, when under the effect of a fear effect that allows a saving throw, you can make a new saving throw against that fear effect at the start of each of your turns before acting. If you make the new save, the fear effect ends.

name: Respectful Prey
benefit: You have learned to assuage monstrous predators with special offerings.

name: Returning Throw
prerequisites: Point-Blank Shot, Precise Shot, Sleight of Hand 3 ranks, goblinoid subtype
benefit: When an ally misses with a thrown weapon attack, you can catch the weapon and use it to attack the original target

name: Revelation Strike
prerequisites: Improved Unarmed Strike, revelation class feature
benefit: Affect an opponent with revelation as part of a melee attack.

name: Revered Guidance
prerequisites: Aasimar, must be taken at 1st level
benefit: Select one of the following creature subtypes: dwarf, elf, gnome, halfling, human, or orc. You gain a +4 racial bonus on Diplomacy checks made to influence creatures of the selected subtype.

name: Reverse-Feint
benefit: As a move action, you can leave a gap in your defenses for one adjacent opponent to use. If the opponent attacks you on its next turn, it gains a +4 bonus on its attack roll. Whether or not the opponent successfully hits, you may attack it as an immediate action with a single melee attack, gaining a +2 bonus on your attack roll.

name: Reverse-Feint (Combat, Galka)
benefit: As a swift action, you can leave a gap in your defenses for one adjacent opponent to use. If the opponent attacks you on its next turn, it gains a +4 bonus on its attack roll. Whether or not the opponent successfully hits, you may attack it as an immediate action with a single melee attack, gaining a +2 bonus on your attack roll.

name: Reward of Grace
benefit: With each use of lay on hands, gain a +1 sacred bonus on attack rolls.

name: Reward of Life
benefit: With each use of lay on hands, gain hit points equal to your Charisma.

name: Reward of the Faithful
prerequisites: Knowledge (religion) 1 rank, alignment must match that of your worshiped deity.
benefit: Whenever you are the only target of a divine spell cast by a follower of your chosen deity other than you, the spell’s caster level is treated as though it were 2 higher than it actually is. Additionally, whenever you regain hit points as a result of a worshiper of your deity other than you channeling energy or casting a cure spell, you regain 1 additional hit point per die rolled for the healing gained.

name: Rhabdomancy
benefit: You can perform the dowsing occult skill unlock even if you can’t use psychic magic. If you can cast psychic spells or have the Psychic Sensitivity feat, you can use dowsing one additional time per day.

name: Rhetorical Flourish
benefit: Use verbal misdirection while making Diplomacy check.

name: Rhino Charge
prerequisites: Power Attack, Improved Bull Rush, BAB +5
benefit: Learn to ready a charge attack.

name: Ricochet Shot Deed
prerequisites: Amateur Gunslinger feat or grit class feature, Blind-Fight.
benefit: Ricochet your shots off of a wall or other solid terrain

name: Ricochet Splash Weapon
benefit: Make an attack roll with a splash weapon if it misses and lands in another creature’s square.

name: Ride-By Attack
benefit: Move before and after a charge attack while mounted.

name: Righteous Healing
benefit: Heal more when you have a judgment active.

name: Rime Spell
benefit: Spell with the [cold] descriptor also entangles creatures if the spell damages them.

name: Riot Battery
prerequisites: Shinsect Riot Style, Weapon Focus (Club or Tonfa).
benefit: While in Shinsect Riot Style and wielding a club or tonfa, you are treated as if you have the Bludgeoner feat when you choose to deal non-lethal damage to an opponent. In addition, you can perform a Forceful Strike as a standard action. Make a melee attack at your highest base attack bonus. Should you hit, that struck creature must make a Fortitude save (DC 10 + half your character level + your Intelligence modifier). On a failure, the opponent becomes staggered for 1 round. You can perform Forceful Strike a number of times per day equal to your Intelligence modifier and only with a club or tonfa.
text:
class="page-content">
Shinsect officers often have to make use of non-lethal and lethal force with their standard issue company weapon: the baton. However, mercenaries have been able to adapt their tactics to be usable for all club-like weapons.
Prerequisite(s): Shinsect Riot Style, Weapon Focus (Club or Tonfa).
BENEFIT
While in Shinsect Riot Style and wielding a club or tonfa, you are treated as if you have the Bludgeoner feat when you choose to deal non-lethal damage to an opponent. In addition, you can perform a Forceful Strike as a standard action. Make a melee attack at your highest base attack bonus. Should you hit, that struck creature must make a Fortitude save (DC 10 + half your character level + your Intelligence modifier). On a failure, the opponent becomes staggered for 1 round. You can perform Forceful Strike a number of times per day equal to your Intelligence modifier and only with a club or tonfa.

name: Riot Brutality
prerequisites: Shinsect Riot Style, Riot Takedown, Improved Grapple.
benefit: When you succeed at grappling or pinning a creature with Riot Takedown, you can spend an attack of opportunity in order to slam them into the ground or into an adjacent, unattended surface or object (such as a wall, a crate, a door, etc.). If you hit, the slam deals 1d6 + your base attack bonus as bludgeoning damage to both the creature and the object or surface. If you choose to do non-lethal damage, the slam is increased to 2d6 + your base attack bonus as bludgeoning damage. You can perform this slam as an attack of opportunity at the end of your turn so long as you maintain the grappled or pinned condition against your opponent.
text:
class="page-content">
Your takedowns are efficient and impactful.
Prerequisite(s): Shinsect Riot Style, Riot Takedown, Improved Grapple.
BENEFIT
When you succeed at grappling or pinning a creature with Riot Takedown, you can spend an attack of opportunity in order to slam them into the ground or into an adjacent, unattended surface or object (such as a wall, a crate, a door, etc.). If you hit, the slam deals 1d6 + your base attack bonus as bludgeoning damage to both the creature and the object or surface. If you choose to do non-lethal damage, the slam is increased to 2d6 + your base attack bonus as bludgeoning damage. You can perform this slam as an attack of opportunity at the end of your turn so long as you maintain the grappled or pinned condition against your opponent.

name: Riot Dread and Dispersal
prerequisites: Shinsect Riot Style, Riot Suppressive Fire, 5 ranks in Intimidate or 5 ranks in Bluff.
benefit: When you succeed on the feint or demoralize attempt provided by the Riot Suppressive Fire feat by 5 or more, the condition of their foe worsens. If you pass the DC to feint your opponent by 5 or more, they suffer an additional penalty to AC equal to your Intelligence modifier for the duration of the feint. If you pass the DC to demoralize an opponent by 5 or more, any movement (except a 5-ft.-step and the movement used in a Withdraw action) in the first range increment of your firearm provokes an attack of opportunity from that opponent so long as they have the shaken condition
text:
class="page-content">
The Shinsect and their fellow law enforcers make a statement when facing you with a smoking gun: If you are on the ‘business end’ of their weaponry, you’d best be prepared to leave in a body bag.
Prerequisite(s): Shinsect Riot Style, Riot Suppressive Fire, 5 ranks in Intimidate or 5 ranks in Bluff.
BENEFIT
When you succeed on the feint or demoralize attempt provided by the Riot Suppressive Fire feat by 5 or more, the condition of their foe worsens. If you pass the DC to feint your opponent by 5 or more, they suffer an additional penalty to AC equal to your Intelligence modifier for the duration of the feint. If you pass the DC to demoralize an opponent by 5 or more, any movement (except a 5-ft.-step and the movement used in a Withdraw action) in the first range increment of your firearm provokes an attack of opportunity from that opponent so long as they have the shaken condition.

name: Riot Elite
prerequisites: Shinsect Riot Style, Riot Takedown, Riot Battery or Riot Suppressive Fire, and Throw Anything.
benefit: While in Shinsect Riot Style, you increase the range increment of the following thrown weapons by 10 feet: grenades (of all kinds) and alchemical splash weapons (such as alchemist fire, a flask of acid, flares, bombs, etc.). In addition, while in this style, you are treated as having the Splash Weapon Mastery feat.
text:
class="page-content">
Shinsect Elites make the best of thrown weapons such as grenades, flares, and sometimes their own gear.
Prerequisite(s): Shinsect Riot Style, Riot Takedown, Riot Battery or Riot Suppressive Fire, and Throw Anything.
BENEFIT
While in Shinsect Riot Style, you increase the range increment of the following thrown weapons by 10 feet: grenades (of all kinds) and alchemical splash weapons (such as alchemist fire, a flask of acid, flares, bombs, etc.). In addition, while in this style, you are treated as having the Splash Weapon Mastery feat.

name: Riot Expert
prerequisites: Shinsect Riot Style, Riot Elite, and a Base Attack Bonus +11.
benefit: While in Shinsect Riot Style, you gain an insight bonus equal to your Intelligence modifier to AC when you are surrounded by more than two creatures. You increase the DC to Reflex saves for splash weapons you wield by an amount equal to half your Intelligence modifier. You deal an extra 2d6 points of damage on a critical hit with a club, tonfa, or 1-handed firearm (this counts as precision damage). In addition, you cannot be staggered or stunned by non-magical sources (such as Stunning Fist) while wearing medium or heavy armor.
text:
class="page-content">
By understanding the mentality of riotous mobs, you can use your gear to be ready for anything.
Prerequisite(s): Shinsect Riot Style, Riot Elite, and a Base Attack Bonus +11.
BENEFIT
While in Shinsect Riot Style, you gain an insight bonus equal to your Intelligence modifier to AC when you are surrounded by more than two creatures. You increase the DC to Reflex saves for splash weapons you wield by an amount equal to half your Intelligence modifier. You deal an extra 2d6 points of damage on a critical hit with a club, tonfa, or 1-handed firearm (this counts as precision damage). In addition, you cannot be staggered or stunned by non-magical sources (such as Stunning Fist) while wearing medium or heavy armor.

name: Riot Suppressive Fire
prerequisites: Shinsect Riot Style, Point-Blank Shot, proficiency with 1-handed firearms, 3 ranks in Intimidate or 3 ranks in Bluff.
benefit: When in Shinsect Riot Style and wielding a 1-handed firearm, you gain the benefits of the Ranged Feint feat. However, instead of feinting, you can also choose to demoralize a target creature as long as you are within the first range increment of your firearm. You can add your Intelligence modifier as a competence bonus to the feint or demoralize check.
text:
class="page-content">
Shinsect officers know the value of Suppressive fire. Often used to distract or demoralize enemies in order to keep collateral damage to a minimum and to capture their targets in the confusion.
Prerequisite(s): Shinsect Riot Style, Point-Blank Shot, proficiency with 1-handed firearms, 3 ranks in Intimidate or 3 ranks in Bluff.
BENEFIT
When in Shinsect Riot Style and wielding a 1-handed firearm, you gain the benefits of the Ranged Feint feat. However, instead of feinting, you can also choose to demoralize a target creature as long as you are within the first range increment of your firearm. You can add your Intelligence modifier as a competence bonus to the feint or demoralize check.

name: Riot Takedown
prerequisites: Shinsect Riot Style, Str 15 or Dex 15, Base Attack Bonus +3.
benefit: While in Shinsect Riot Style, you can perform a Takedown. Make either a grapple, trip or reposition combat maneuver as a full round action. Should you succeed at any of those maneuvers, you can immediately make a pin attempt as part of the maneuver (which is another grapple check). If you have a club, baton, tonfa and one free hand, you do not suffer the penalty of not having two hands free to grapple a creature.
text:
class="page-content">
Using Riot Suppression tactics, you know how to pin targets quickly for capture.
Prerequisite(s): Shinsect Riot Style, Str 15 or Dex 15, Base Attack Bonus +3.
BENEFIT
While in Shinsect Riot Style, you can perform a Takedown. Make either a grapple, trip or reposition combat maneuver as a full round action. Should you succeed at any of those maneuvers, you can immediately make a pin attempt as part of the maneuver (which is another grapple check). If you have a club, baton, tonfa and one free hand, you do not suffer the penalty of not having two hands free to grapple a creature.
Normal: Grappling a creature without having two hands free grants a -4 penalty to the grapple attempt.

name: Riptide Attack
benefit: You may automatically drag a tripped target as a swift action.

name: Risky Striker
benefit: You can choose to take a –1 penalty to AC to gain a +2 bonus on melee damage rolls against creatures two or more size categories larger than you. When your BAB reaches +4 and every four levels thereafter, the damage increases by 2. The bonus damage is multiplied in the case of a critical hit. You can only choose to use this feat when you declare that you are making an attack action or a full-attack action with a melee weapon. The effects last until your next turn.

name: Risky Striker (Combat, Moogle)
benefit: You can choose to take a –1 penalty to AC to gain a +2 bonus on melee damage rolls against creatures two or more size categories larger than you. When your base attack bonus reaches +4 and every four levels thereafter, the damage increases by 2. The bonus damage is multiplied in the case of a critical hit. You can only choose to use this feat when you declare that you are making an attack action or a full-attack action with a melee weapon. The effects last until your next turn.

name: Ritual Hex
prerequisites: Knowledge (arcana) 4 ranks, Knowledge (history) 4 ranks, hex class feature
benefit: You learn to perform a special occult ritual known as Beseeching the Patron, which temporarily grants you a hex you don’t already know how to use.

name: Ritual Spell I (Metamagic)
text:
class="page-content">
You are able to cast a 1st-level enhancing spell as a ritual.
Prerequisite: Caster Level 6th.
BENEFIT
Three times per day, you can cast a single 1st-level enhancing spell (that neither deals or heals damage nor increases or decreases size) as a ritual spell. The casting time of the ritual spell increases to 10 minutes, the duration of the spell increases by 1 step (1 round > 1 round/level > 1 minute/level > 10 minutes/level) to a maximum of 10 minutes per caster level, and removes the MP cost from casting the spell. This does not work with other metamagic feats or class features, however.

name: Ritual Spell II (Metamagic)
text:
class="page-content">
You are able to cast a 2nd-level enhancing spell as a ritual.
Prerequisite: Caster Level 12th.
BENEFIT
Twice per day, you can cast a single 2nd-level enhancing spell (that neither deals or heals damage nor increases or decreases size) as a ritual spell. The casting time of the ritual spell increases to 10 minutes, the duration of the spell increases by 1 step (1 round > 1 round/level > 1 minute/level > 10 minutes/level) to a maximum of 10 minutes per caster level, and removes the MP cost from casting the spell. This does not work with other metamagic feats or class features, however.

name: Ritual Spell III (Metamagic)
text:
class="page-content">
You are able to cast a 3rd-level enhancing spell as a ritual.
Prerequisite: Caster Level 18th.
BENEFIT
Once per day, you can cast a single 3rd-level enhancing spell (that neither deals or heals damage nor increases or decreases size) as a ritual spell. The casting time of the ritual spell increases to 10 minutes, the duration of the spell increases by 1 step (1 round > 1 round/level > 1 minute/level > 10 minutes/level) to a maximum of 10 minutes per caster level, and removes the MP cost from casting the spell. This does not work with other metamagic feats or class features, however.

name: River Raider
benefit: +2 bonus on Swim and Stealth checks in non- stormy water, can take more actions than normal in surprise rounds where you’re in water

name: Riving Strike
benefit: Those damaged by your Arcane Strike take a penalty on saves against spells and spell-like abilities.

name: Robot’s Bane
benefit: Gain offensive and defensive bonuses against robots.

name: Roll with It
benefit: Reduce damage you take from an attack and get tossed aside.

name: Rondeau of Bastok (Bardic Masterpiece)
text:
class="page-content">
Your carefully structured song imposes rigid order on your listeners.
Prerequisite(s): Perform (sing) 4 ranks.
BENEFIT
This song follows a set repetition of verses and refrains with a pattern of syllables that remains constant from line to line. As you sing, listeners find their actions bound by your song’s relentless order. One enemy per bard level within listening range must make a successful Will save or find its movements hampered. A creature that fails its save can move only in a straight line each turn. The creature can choose which direction it wishes to move each turn, but it can move only along a straight line in that direction, and cannot move around corners or otherwise deviate from this line until its next turn. This effect lasts as long as you maintain the performance. Although this song has words, it is not language-dependent.
Use: 1 bardic performance round per round.
Action: 1 round.

name: Ronso Discipline (Ronso)
benefit: While you are within 30 feet of at least two other ronsos, you gain a +1 morale bonus on saving throws.
text:
class="page-content">
The presence of other ronsos bolsters your resolve.
Prerequisite(s): Base attack bonus +1, ronso.
BENEFIT
While you are within 30 feet of at least two other ronsos, you gain a +1 morale bonus on saving throws.

name: Rouse Emotions
prerequisites: Cha 13, Charming Performance, Perform (any) 5 ranks, bardic performance or raging song
benefit: You can use Charming Performance on all creatures within 60 feet.

name: Rubble Skirmisher
benefit: Gain a +2 bonus on combat maneuver checks and CMD when in naturally occurring difficult terrain

name: Rugged Northerner
benefit: Treat cold weather conditions as one step less severe.

name: Run
benefit: Run at 5 times your normal speed.

name: Runic Charge
benefit: You can deliver touch spells with frightful ferocity.

name: Ruthless Opportunist
benefit: When an ally with this feat hits a foe using an AOO, gain +2 on attacks against that foe for 1 round

name: Sabotage Magic Item
prerequisites: Magical Aptitude, Disable Device 5 ranks, Use Magic Device 5 ranks
benefit: Sabotage an item to cause a mishap

name: Sabotage Specialist
benefit: Items you sabotage fail at a more precise time

name: Sabotaging Sunder
prerequisites: Str 13, Improved Sunder, Power Attack, Disable Device 7 ranks
benefit: Break objects through sabotage rather than force

name: Sabotaging Sunder, Improved
benefit: Use Sabotaging Sunder on more objects and without provoking attacks of opportunity

name: Sacred Geometry
benefit: It’s complicated (see text).

name: Sacred Summons
prerequisites: Aura class feature, ability to cast summon monster
benefit: Summon monsters whose alignment subtype matches yours as a standard action.

name: Sacrificial Adept
prerequisites: Knowledge (arcana) 4 ranks, Knowledge (planes) 4 ranks, Knowledge (religion) 4 ranks, Spellcraft 4 ranks, ability to cast 3rd-level spells, evil alignment
benefit: Kill sentient creatures to enhance your spells

name: Sacrificial Ritualist
benefit: Kill sentient creatures to enhance your ritual

name: Saddle Shrieker
benefit: Take a -1 penalty to attacks and CMB checks to give your mount a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls with its natural weapons.

name: Sap Adept
benefit: Gain bonus damage on nonlethal attacks.

name: Sap Master
benefit: Deal twice your sneak attack damage when dealing nonlethal damage.

name: Saving Shield
benefit: Grant shield bonus to an adjacent ally.

name: Scale and Skin
benefit: Whenever a transmutation spell or spell-like ability affects you, your natural armor bonus increases by 1. If you have no natural armor bonus to Armor Class, treat your natural armor bonus as 0 for the purposes of this feat. The bonus to your natural armor bonus increases by 2 if the caster level of the effect is 10th or higher.

name: Scaled Disciple
prerequisites: Ability to spontaneously cast divine spells, kobold
benefit: Your dragon-themed spells are more potent, and you can use divine spellcasting to qualify for the Dragon Disciple prestige class

name: Scarred Legion

benefit: Emotion or fear spell gives penalties against further such spells

name: Scavenger's Eye (Tarutaru)

name: Scavenger’s Eye

name: Scent of Fear

name: School Strike

name: Schooled Reserve
benefit: Add your Bravery bonus on saves against vampires.

name: Scorching Weapons

name: Scorpion Style
benefit: Reduce target’s speed to 5ft.

name: Scouting Summons

benefit: When casting a conjuration (summoning) spell that summons a single creature, you can possess the creature as per magic jar (but with no receptacle necessary).

name: Scribe Makimono
benefit: You can create ninjutsus in written form called Makimonos.
text:
class="page-content">
You can create ninjutsus in written form called Makimonos.
Prerequisite(s): Caster level 1st, Ninjutsu class feature.
BENEFIT
This feat counts as Scribe Scroll for prerequisites and functions like the feat, but only for Ninjutsu’s from the ninja spell list. Scrolls made this way are used in the same manner as regular scrolls. A Ninja can learn additional ninjutsu from these scrolls, and can use these scrolls without making a Use Magic Device Check nor does he need to decipher the scroll. This feat counts as Scribe Scroll for prerequisites. You can create an Makimono of any ninjutsu that you know. Scribing a makimono takes 2 hours if its base price is 250 gil or less, otherwise scribing a makimono takes 1 day for each 1,000 gil in its base price. To scribe a makimono, you must use up raw materials costing half of this base price. You cannot scribe multiple ninjutsu into a single makimono. Makimonos work just like Scrolls, but can only contain ninjutsu.

name: Scribe Orchestrion Roll
benefit: You can create song scrolls called Orchestrion Rolls.

class="page-content">
You can create song scrolls called Orchestrion Rolls.
Prerequisite(s): Caster level 1st, Songs class feature.
BENEFIT
This feat counts as Scribe Scroll for prerequisites. You can create an orchestrion roll of any song that you know. Scribing an orchestrion roll takes 2 hours if its base price is 250 gil or less, otherwise scribing an orchestrion roll takes 1 day for each 1,000 gil in its base price. To scribe an orchestrion roll, you must use up raw materials costing half of this base price. You may scribe multiple songs into one roll, paying the cost and time for each. Orchestrion Rolls work just like Scrolls, but can only contain Songs.

If you succeed, the target is considered off balance (see Table: Combat Adjustments Underwater) until it recovers its balance, usually by making a Swim check on its turn. This feat has no effect on creatures with a swim speed, those using magic such as freedom of movement, and creatures that can’t be tripped.

name: Second Wind
benefit: When you spend a swift action to attempt a performance combat check, you gain a +2 bonus on your performance combat check, and if you are shaken, sickened, or fatigued, these conditions are suppressed until the end of your next turn.

name: Seraph Strike
benefit: You gain a TP Pool, which begins at 0 and maximizes at 15. This attack deals normal damage + 1d6 points of holy damage, and the target must make a Will save (DC 10 + half of your character level + your Strength modifier) or be inflicted with the Illuminated status for 1d6 rounds. At 10 TP or more, you may expend all TP to make a special hammer attack that deals + 3d6 points of holy damage and forces the target to make a Will save (DC 12 + half of your character level + your Strength modifier) or be inflicted with the Illuminated status effect for 2d6 rounds. At 15 TP, you may expend all TP to make a special hammer attack that deals + 5d6 points of holy damage and forces the target to make a Will save (DC 14 + half of your character level + your Strength modifier) or be inflicted with the Illuminated status effect for 3d6 rounds. This TP Pool lasts until you sleep for the night, in the morning, it empties out. In addition, your weapon attacks from the hammer and flail weapon groups deal an additional point of damage for each weapon skill feat in this line that you have. If you have another TP pool from another weaponskill feat, it does not stack.

class="page-content">

Prerequisite(s): Perform (sing) or Perform (percussion) 7 ranks.
BENEFIT
Up to one creature per bard level that can see and hear you can ignore the effects of encumbrance and armor on its skill checks and movement while you engage in this performance. This does not allow affected creatures to exceed their maximum carrying capacity.

class="page-content">

benefit: When you deal damage, target’s ability to use any polymorph effects is hindered.

name: Shapeshifter Savage

benefit: While you are using Shapeshifter Style, if you use your beast shape or wild shape ability as a standard action, you can also make a single melee attack with one of your natural weapons at your highest base attack bonus against one foe within your reach.

class="page-content">
You have enough control over your transformations that you can lash out at an opponent while assuming your beast form.

name: Shapeshifter Style
prerequisites: Beast Shape or Wild Shape class feature
benefit: You reshape your body, gaining one of the following benefits. You choose the benefit when you enter the style, and while in the style you can change the benefit as a swift action. • Brutal Attack: Choose one of your natural attacks. You gain a +1 bonus on damage rolls with that attack when using this style, plus an additional +1 for every feat you have that lists Shapeshifter Style as a prerequisite (maximum +3). • Steady Grip: You gain a climb speed of 10 feet. • Tensed Sinews: You gain a +1 bonus on Reflex saving throws and a +5 enhancement bonus to your base speed. • Toughened Hide: You gain a +1 enhancement bonus to your existing natural armor bonus.
text:
class="page-content">

name: Shield Master

name: Shield Ward
prerequisites: Shield Focus feat, 3rd-level warrior/knight or BAB +5
benefit: While wielding a shield, you apply your shield bonus to your touch AC.
text:
class="page-content">
You use your shield like a wall of steel and wood. When an opponent attempts to draw in close to you, your shield forces him away or ruins his attacks.
Prerequisite(s): Shield Focus, 3rd-level warrior/knight or BAB +5.
Benefit
While wielding a shield, you apply your shield bonus to your touch AC.

name: Shielded Caster
benefit: +4 bonus on concentration checks.

name: Shielded Gauntlet Attack
prerequisites: Shield Gauntlet Style, Weapon Focus (gauntlet or spiked gauntlet), proficiency with bucklers and light shields.
benefit: While using Shield Gauntlet Style, you can calculate the damage of your gauntlet or spiked gauntlet using the sacred weapon damage value of a warpriest with a level 4 less than your BAB. The style also allows you to take one AOO each round that does not count toward your maximum number of attacks of opportunity. This must be used to make an attack with your gauntlet (or spiked gauntlet), or a disarm or steal combat maneuver. You do not provoke an AOO for performing either combat maneuver, and you are able to attempt a steal combat maneuver with this AOO despite the maneuver normally requiring a standard action.

name: Shielded Gauntlet Master
prerequisites: Shielded Gauntlet Attack, Shield Gauntlet Style, Weapon Focus (gauntlet or spiked gauntlet), proficiency with bucklers and light shields.
benefit: While using Shield Gauntlet Style, you no longer lose your shield bonus to AC when you attack with your gauntlet (or spiked gauntlet) or use it to hold a weapon. In addition, you add your gauntlet’s enhancement bonus to the shield bonus to AC granted by this feat as if it were a shield enhancement bonus.

name: Shielded Mage
prerequisites: Proficient in at least one type of shield
benefit: While wielding a shield, you avoid the chance for spell failure.
text:
class="page-content">
Your specialized training in shields allows you to avoid spell failure.
Prerequisite: Proficient in at least one type of shield.
BENEFIT
While wielding a shield you are proficient with, you avoid the chance for spell failure. Additionally, using that shield does not prevent you from completing somatic spell components with the hand wielding the shield.
This feat does not work with tower shields.
Normal: Shields interfere with a spell-caster’s gestures, which can cause spells to fail if those spells have a somatic component.

name: Shielded Mage (Combat, Shield Mastery)
prerequisites: Shield Focus, base attack bonus +3 or fighter level 1st.
benefit: You reduce the arcane spell failure of any shield you use by 15% (to a minimum of 0%). Using a shield does not prevent you from completing somatic spell components with the hand wielding the shield.

name: Shielded Stand (Combat, Shield Mastery)
prerequisites: Shield Focus, base attack bonus +3 or fighter level 1st.
benefit: As a swift action, you can prevent yourself or an adjacent ally from provoking an attack of opportunity when standing from prone or when picking up an object from the ground.

name: Shielding Sap (Mandragora)
prerequisites: Protective sap alternate racial trait, mandragora, character level 5
benefit: When you are at one quarter of your maximum hit point value, the natural armor conveyed by your protective sap alternate racial trait increases by 2.
text:
class="page-content">
Your protective sap becomes more effective.
Prerequisite(s): Protective sap alternate racial trait, mandragora, character level 5.
BENEFIT
When you are at one quarter of your maximum hit point value, the natural armor conveyed by your protective sap alternate racial trait increases by 2.

name: Shift
prerequisites: Have a movement speed above 30 feet
benefit: Once per day, you can use the withdraw action as a free action usable outside of your turn, instead of as a full-round action.
text:
class="page-content">
You may withdraw as a free action.
Prerequisite(s): Have a movement speed (land/fly/climb/swim) above 30.
BENEFIT
Once per day, you can use the withdraw action as a free action usable outside of your turn, instead of as a full-round action.

name: Shifter’s Edge
benefit: Add your shifter level to damage with your claws class feature when you use Weapon Finesse

name: Shifter’s Rush
prerequisites: Wild shape class feature, shifter level 4th
benefit: Use wild shape as a free action when you charge or move more than 10 feet

name: Shikigami Manipulation
prerequisites: Catch Off-Guard or Throw Anything, Shikigami Mimicry, Shikigami Style, Use Magic Device 5 ranks
benefit: You channel a magic item’s power to enhance its improvised attacks, even though it was never meant to be used as a weapon.

name: Shikigami Mimicry
prerequisites: Catch Off-Guard or Throw Anything, Shikigami Style
benefit: Your unique understanding of improvised tools enables you to turn the intrinsic form of all manner of objects to your advantage in combat.

name: Shikigami Style
benefit: Your skill with improvised weapons makes them more dangerous than they would otherwise be.

name: Shinsect Riot Style
benefit: You can assume the Shinsect Riot Style as a swift action and you add your Intelligence modifier as a competence bonus to your CMB when making grapple, trip, feint and reposition attempts if you have a club or tonfa in one hand. In addition, when you are flanking a creature with an ally, you can sacrifice your flanking bonus to reroll a grapple, trip, feint or reposition combat maneuver check once per round. You must take the new roll regardless of the result. You regain your flanking bonus at the start of your next turn.
text:
class="page-content">
With Shinsect training, this style makes creative use of Shinsect equipment and similar weapons to disperse or adapt to mob tactics.
Prerequisite(s): Int 13, Combat Reflexes.
BENEFIT
You can assume the Shinsect Riot Style as a swift action and you add your Intelligence modifier as a competence bonus to your CMB when making grapple, trip, or reposition attempts, or to your Bluff check when making feint attempts if you have a club or tonfa in one hand. In addition, when you are flanking a creature with an ally, you can sacrifice your flanking bonus to reroll a grapple, trip, feint or reposition combat maneuver check once per round. You must take the new roll regardless of the result. You regain your flanking bonus at the start of your next turn.

name: Shiva’s Refuge (Bardic Masterpiece)
text:
class="page-content">
Praying to the Ice Queen for assistance, your elegant ballet invokes shelter from ice and snow.
Prerequisite(s): Perform (dance) or Perform (oratory) 10 ranks.
BENEFIT
This masterpiece can be performed only at or after dusk, or in weather conditions stormy enough to affect visibility. When completed, this masterpiece conjures a frozen shelter. This acts as the hemisphere form of wall of ice centered on you, except that the radius is 20 feet, the hemisphere has a single doorway large enough for a Medium creature, and the shelter lasts until the next sunrise or until you leave the shelter.
Use: 5 rounds of bardic performance. 
Action: 5 full rounds.

name: Shocking Amplification
benefit: Whenever you cast a spell with the electricity descriptor that targets one or more creatures, you can take a –1 penalty on attack rolls made with the spell and reduce the spell’s saving throw DC by 1 to cause the target closest to you that is dealt electricity damage by the spell to become fatigued for 1 round. This cannot cause a creature that is already fatigued to become exhausted. You must choose to use this feat before making an attack roll or before your target attempts its saving throw. This feat has no effect on spells that neither allow a saving throw nor require an attack roll.

name: Shocking Fist (Combat, Shindroid)
benefit: As a free action, you can channel some of your life force into a slam attack. You must declare that you are using this feat before you make your attack roll. When you use this feat, you deal damage to yourself (any amount equal to or less than your base attack bonus). If the attack hits, you deal ld4 points of lightning damage to the target per point of damage you dealt to yourself. For example, if you dealt 3 points of damage to yourself, a successful attack would deal an extra 3d4 points of lightning damage. If the attack misses, the attempt is wasted (but you still take the damage you dealt to yourself). You can attempt a shocking fist attack any number of times per day, but only once per round.

name: Shot on the Run
prerequisites: Dex 13, Mobility, Point Blank Shot, BAB +4
benefit: Make ranged attack at any point during movement

name: Shoulder Tackle
benefit: You gain a TP Pool, which begins at 0 and maximizes at 15. For each successful attack made by a Monk weapon group you make or get struck by a melee or ranged attack, you gain 1 TP. At 5 TP or more, you may spend all TP to deliver a special unarmed strike that takes a place of an attack of a full-attack or just a single attack. This attack deals damage as normal and the target must make a Fortitude save (DC 10 + half of your character level + your Wisdom modifier) or be stunned for 1 round. At 10 TP or more, you may spend all TP to cause the target must make a Fortitude save (DC 12 + half of your character level + your Wisdom modifier) or be stunned for 2 rounds. At 15 TP, you may spend all TP to cause the target must make a Fortitude save (DC 14 + half of your character level + your Wisdom modifier) or be stunned for 3 rounds. This TP Pool lasts until you sleep for the night, in the morning, it empties out. In addition, your weapons of the Monk weapon group deal an additional point of damage for each weapon skill feat in this line that you have. If you have another TP pool from another weaponskill feat, it does not stack.
text:
class="page-content">
You can deliver a special unarmed strike that stuns a foe.
Prerequisite(s): Weapon Focus, BAB +3.
BENEFIT
You gain a TP Pool, which begins at 0 and maximizes at 15. For each successful attack made by a Monk weapon group you make or get struck by a melee or ranged attack, you gain 1 TP. At 5 TP or more, you may spend all TP to deliver a special unarmed strike that takes a place of an attack of a full-attack or just a single attack. This attack deals damage as normal and the target must make a Fortitude save (DC 10 + half of your character level + your Wisdom modifier) or be stunned for 1 round. At 10 TP or more, you may spend all TP to cause the target must make a Fortitude save (DC 12 + half of your character level + your Wisdom modifier) or be stunned for 2 rounds. At 15 TP, you may spend all TP to cause the target must make a Fortitude save (DC 14 + half of your character level + your Wisdom modifier) or be stunned for 3 rounds. This TP Pool lasts until you sleep for the night, in the morning, it empties out. In addition, your weapons of the Monk weapon group deal an additional point of damage for each weapon skill feat in this line that you have. If you have another TP pool from another weaponskill feat, it does not stack.

name: Shrapnel Strike
benefit: You can bash things to damage nearby opponents.

name: Shrewd Tactician
benefit: Opponents do not gain a +2 bonus on attack rolls for flanking you.

name: Shrouded in Mystery
prerequisites: Bluff 1 rank; Disguise 1 rank; kitsune, nagaji, samsaran, tengu, or wayang
benefit: Against other humanoid races, gain a +2 bonus on Will saves vs. mind-affecting spells and a +3 bonus on Bluff checks

name: Shrug On
benefit: As a full-round action, you can shrug yourself into the largest and most protective section of a suit of armor with which you are proficient. The armor does not grant any magical benefits in this state, and its armor check penalty and maximum Dexterity bonus to AC are both 2 worse than normal. When donned using this feat, medium armor grants a +3 armor bonus, and heavy armor grants a +5 armor bonus. Light armor grants no armor bonus when donned using this feat.

name: Sickening Grasp
prerequisites: Ability to cast 3rd-level spells, Spell Focus (Necromancy)
benefit: As long as you have a necromancy spell of 3rd level or higher in your spells known and have at least 3 MP in your MP pool,, any living creature you hit with a melee touch attack becomes sickened for a number of rounds equal to the level of the highest-level necromancy spell you can cast. The subject can reduce this duration to 1 round with a successful Fortitude save (DC 10 + half your caster level + your highest mental stat modifier). As a secondary benefit, you gain a +1 competence bonus to your caster level when casting necromancy spells.
text:
class="page-content">
You wreak havoc with the inner organs of a target, causing it to grow ill.
Prerequisite(s): Ability to cast 3rd-level spells, Spell Focus (Necromancy).
BENEFIT
As long as you have a necromancy spell of 3rd level or higher in your spells known and have at least 3 MP in your MP pool,, any living creature you hit with a melee touch attack becomes sickened for a number of rounds equal to the level of the highest-level necromancy spell you can cast. The subject can reduce this duration to 1 round with a successful Fortitude save (DC 10 + half your caster level + your highest mental stat modifier). As a secondary benefit, you gain a +1 competence bonus to your caster level when casting necromancy spells.

name: Sickening Song (Metasong)
text:
class="page-content">
You can sicken creatures with your songs.
BENEFIT
You can modify a song to sicken a creature damaged by the song. When a creature takes damage from this song, they become sickened for a number of rounds equal to the original level of the song. If the song allows a saving throw, a successful save negates the sickening effect. If the song does not allow a save, the target can make a Fortitude save to negate the sickening effect. If the song effect also causes the creature to become sickened, the duration of this metasong effect is added on to the duration of the song. Songs that do not inflict damage do not benefit from this feat.
MP Increase: +2 (a sickening song costs 2 additional MP more than the actual MP cost of the song.) In addition, the perform check DC increases by +2.

name: Sickening Spell
benefit: Sicken creature with spell damage

name: Sickening Spell-Like Ability
prerequisites: Spell-like ability at CL 6th or higher
benefit: Spell-like ability sickens damaged foes

name: Sidestep
benefit: Make 5-foot step immediately after an opponent misses

name: Sidestep, Improved
benefit: Sidestep without using your 5-foot step on your next turn

name: Sidewinder
benefit: At 5 TP or more, you may spend all TP to deliver a special bow attack that takes the place of an attack in a full-attack or just a single attack. This attack is made at a penalty of -5, and deals normal damage + 3d6. At 10 TP or more, you may spend all TP to make an attack at the same penalty, dealing normal damage adding + 6d6 to the damage. At 15 TP, you may spend all TP to make an attack at the same penalty, dealing normal damage + 9d6 damage.
text:
class="page-content">
You have learned to pull with extreme force, at sacrifice to your aim.
Prerequisite(s): Piercing Arrow, BAB +7.
BENEFIT
At 5 TP or more, you may spend all TP to deliver a special bow attack that takes the place of an attack in a full-attack or just a single attack. This attack is made at a penalty of -5, and deals normal damage + 3d6. At 10 TP or more, you may spend all TP to make an attack at the same penalty, dealing normal damage adding + 6d6 to the damage. At 15 TP, you may spend all TP to make an attack at the same penalty, dealing normal damage + 9d6 damage.

name: Siege Commander
prerequisites: Craft (siege weapon) 5 ranks, Knowledge (engineering) 5 ranks or Profession (Siege Engineer) 1 rank
benefit: Grant weapon crew +4 on assemble or move checks

name: Siege Engineer
prerequisites: Knowledge (engineering) 5 ranks or Profession (siege engineer) 5 ranks, proficiency with 1 siege weapon
benefit: You are considered proficient with all siege weapons

name: Siege Gunner
benefit: Take no size penalties for aiming a direct fire siege weapon

name: Signature Deed
benefit: Use 1 deed for 1 fewer grit point Feats

name: Signature Strike Style
prerequisites: Precise Shot; Weapon Focus; BAB +7; Intimidate 7 ranks; Improved Called Shot, targeted strike swashbuckler deed, or targeting gunslinger deed
benefit: Your accuracy when attacking is both delightfully artistic and chillingly deadly.

name: Signature Strike Taunt
prerequisites: Precise Shot, Signature Strike Style, Weapon Focus, BAB +9, Intimidate 9 ranks
benefit: Your mocking strikes leave your foe deeply embarrassed and infuriated.

name: Signature Strike Triumph
prerequisites: Precise Shot, Signature Strike Style, Signature Strike Taunt, Weapon Focus, BAB +11, Intimidate 11 ranks
benefit: With an effortless flourish, you strike terror into your foes and inspire your allies.

name: Signifer Armor Training
prerequisites: Arcane Armor Mastery, Arcane Armor Training, Heavy Armor Proficiency, CL 7, allegiance to a Hell Knight order
benefit: As a swift action, you can reduce the arcane spell failure chance due to the armor you are wearing by 30% for any spells you cast this round.

name: Silent as Stone
benefit: This creature gains a +4 bonus to Stealth checks and suffers no penalties to Stealth checks when climbing. In addition, may drag and kill foes silently with strands in some cases.

name: Silent Kill
prerequisites: Stealth 12 ranks, assassinate advanced slayer talent or ninja master trick
benefit: Kill during the surprise round and slip back into shadows

name: Silent Spell
benefit: Cast spell without verbal components

name: Simple Weapon Proficiency
benefit: No penalty on attacks made with simple weapons.

name: Sin Seer
benefit: Gain the ability to detect evil.

name: Sir Bearington’s Jig (Bardic Masterpiece)
text:
class="page-content">
In the Gradianian musical The Bear, a lively tune plays whenever the eponymous animal tumbles onto stage. When played with skill, the song actually has the power to grant an animal temporary intelligence.
Prerequisite(s): Perform (string) or Perform (wind) 11 ranks.
BENEFIT
Choose a non-hostile animal within line of sight that can see and hear you perform. This masterpiece affects the target as the awaken spell for as long as you maintain the performance. Abilities that extend the duration of a bardic performance (such as Lingering Performance) affect this masterpiece.
Use: 1 round of bardic performance per round. 
Action: 1 full round.

name: Siren’s Requiem (Bardic Masterpiece)
text:
class="page-content">
By filling your performance with the mournful angst of a lost love, your song evokes the inexorable pull of the grave upon every living thing.
Prerequisite(s): Perform (sing) 17 ranks.
BENEFIT
All living creatures you select within 30 feet at the start of your turn each round gain 2 negative levels unless they succeed at a Fortitude saving throw (DC = 10 + 1/2 your bard level + your Charisma bonus). This is a death effect and a sonic effect.
Use: 3 rounds of bardic performance per round. 
Action: 1 full round action.

name: Sizzling Shot
prerequisites: Grit class feature or Amateur Gunslinger, base attack bonus +4.
benefit: Your bullets ignite when you fire them.

name: Skald’s Vigor
benefit: Gain fast healing while raging and performing or performing raging song.

name: Skeleton Summoner
prerequisites: Spell Focus (necromancy), ability to cast summon monster
benefit: Summon skeletons instead of living creatures with summon monster.

name: Skill Focus
benefit: +3 bonus on one skill (+6 at 10 ranks).

name: Skilled Driver
benefit: Gain +4 bonus on driving checks with made with one vehicle

name: Skilled Flyer (Gria or Moogle)
benefit: Add 10 ft. to your fly speed and improve your maneuverability one stage. This feat may be taken multiple times.

name: Skilled Rager
benefit: Pick a skill and use it while raging.

name: Skin Suit
prerequisites: Int 7, undead creature that was originally humanoid
benefit: Hide in false flesh during the day

name: Slashing Grace
prerequisites: Dex 13, Weapon Finesse, Weapon Focus with selected weapon
benefit: Treat a slashing weapon as a piercing melee weapon

name: Slayer’s Feint
prerequisites: Dex 15, Acrobatic or slayer 1, Combat Expertise, Acrobatics 1 rank
benefit: Use Acrobatics instead of Bluff to feint

name: Slayer’s Knack
benefit: Double the threat range of all weapons against one favored enemy.

name: Sleep Venom
benefit: Cause your racial venom to put creatures to sleep instead of dealing Dex damage

name: Sleeper Hold
benefit: You might knock out an opponent if you maintain a grapple for a number of rounds equal to its Constitution bonus. See text for details.

name: Sliding Axe Throw
benefit: Use throwing axes to trip your opponent.

name: Sliding Dash
prerequisites: Dex 15, Acrobatics 10 ranks or acrobatic charge class feature, Bluff 3 ranks
benefit: Charge through a foe for a flank attack

name: Sling Flail
benefit: Make melee attacks with a sling

name: Slow Faller
prerequisites: Acrobatics 5 ranks or slow fall class feature
benefit: Gain or improve the slow fall ability.

name: Sluggish Jinx
benefit: Your jinx’s penalty on saving throws also applies to the target’s initiative and attack rolls.

name: Sly Draw
benefit: Make a sleight of hand check instead of Bluff to feint when drawing a light weapon.

name: Small But Deadly
prerequisites: Weapon Focus or natural weapon, Small size or smaller
benefit: You can ignore your racial penalty to Strength when calculating the damage you deal with natural weapons or weapons you’ve trained with.

name: Smash Axe
benefit: At 5 TP or more, you may expend all TP to make a special axe attack that takes the place of an attack in a full attack or a single attack. This attack deals normal damage + 1d6, and forces the target to make a Fortitude save (DC 10 + half of your character level + your Strength modifier) or be stunned for 1 round. At 10 TP or more, you may spend all TP to deal normal damage + 2d6 and make an attack that forces the target to make a Fortitude save (DC 12 + half of your character level + your Strength modifier) or be stunned for 2 rounds. At 15 TP, you may spend all TP to deal normal damage + 3d6 and make an attack that forces the target to make a Fortitude save (DC 14 + half of your character level + your Strength modifier) or be stunned for 3 rounds.
text:
class="page-content">
With a brutal strike, you send your foes reeling.
Prerequisite(s): Shield Break, BAB +5.
BENEFIT
At 5 TP or more, you may expend all TP to make a special axe attack that takes the place of an attack in a full attack or a single attack. This attack deals normal damage + 1d6, and forces the target to make a Fortitude save (DC 10 + half of your character level + your Strength modifier) or be stunned for 1 round. At 10 TP or more, you may spend all TP to deal normal damage + 2d6 and make an attack that forces the target to make a Fortitude save (DC 12 + half of your character level + your Strength modifier) or be stunned for 2 rounds. At 15 TP, you may spend all TP to deal normal damage + 3d6 and make an attack that forces the target to make a Fortitude save (DC 14 + half of your character level + your Strength modifier) or be stunned for 3 rounds.

name: Smashing Crush
prerequisites: Str 13, Improved Sunder, Smashing Style, Weapon Focus with the chosen weapon.
benefit: While using Smashing Style, reduce an object’s hardness by 1 when you successfully damage it with a sunder combat maneuver.

name: Smashing Dent
prerequisites: Str 13, Improved Sunder, Smashing Crush, Smashing Style, Weapon Focus with the chosen weapon, base attack bonus +6.
benefit: While using Smashing Style, reduce a suit of armor’s armor bonus to Armor Class by 1 and increase its armor check penalty by 1 when you damage it with a sunder combat maneuver.

name: Smashing Style
prerequisites: Str 13, Improved Sunder, Power Attack, Weapon Focus with the chosen weapon.
benefit: Immediately bull rush or trip combat maneuver an opponent when you succeed at a sunder check against a suit of armor worn by that opponent with an axe, hammer, or flail.

name: Smell Fear
benefit: +4 on Perception checks to detect frightened creatures.

name: Smiting Reversal
benefit: 3/day after being targeted by a smite attack, immediately make an AOO against the attacker with a bonus on this attack roll equal to your Cha bonus and a bonus to damage equal to your character level. This AOO ignores all damage reduction the creature possesses.

name: Smoking Boulder
benefit: Cause a boulder you throw to erupt into a 10-foot-radius spread of heavy smoke on a successful hit that lasts for 1d4 rounds.

name: Snap Shot
benefit: Threaten squares within 5 feet of you when wielding a ranged weapon

name: Snapping Flank
benefit: Whenever you are flanking with an ally who also has this feat, as a swift action you can make a bite attack against the opponent you and your ally are flanking.

name: Snatch
benefit: This creature can grab other creatures with ease.

name: Snatch Arrows
benefit: Catch one ranged attack per round.

name: Sneaking Precision
prerequisites: Sneak attack class feature, Critical Focus, any critical feat, BAB +9
benefit: On the second sneak attack in a round, you may apply a critical feat.

name: Sneaky Vagabond
benefit: You get a +2 bonus on Stealth checks when others are actively trying to find you. In crowds, this bonus increases to +4.

name: Sniper Shot
benefit: You gain a TP Pool, which begins at 0 and maximizes at 15. For each successful attack made by a crossbow or firearm weapon group you make or get struck by a melee or ranged attack, you gain 1 TP. At 5 TP or more, you may spend all TP to deliver a special crossbow or firearm attack that takes the place of an attack in a full-attack or just a single attack. This attack deals damage as normal + 2d6 damage, and negates the penalty for firing into your second range increment. At 10 TP or more, you may spend all TP to deal normal damage + 4d6 damage, and negates the penalty for firing into the third range increment. At 15 TP, you may spend all TP to deal normal damage + 6d6 damage, and negates the penalty for firing into the fourth range increment. This TP Pool lasts until you sleep for the night, in the morning, it empties out. In addition, your weapons of the crossbow or firearm weapon group deal an additional point of damage for each weapon skill feat in this line that you have. If you have another TP pool from another weaponskill feat, it does not stack.
text:
class="page-content">
From on high and from far away, you precisely land your shots.
Prerequisite(s): Weapon Focus, BAB +3.
BENEFIT
You gain a TP Pool, which begins at 0 and maximizes at 15. For each successful attack made by a crossbow or firearm weapon group you make or get struck by a melee or ranged attack, you gain 1 TP. At 5 TP or more, you may spend all TP to deliver a special crossbow or firearm attack that takes the place of an attack in a full-attack or just a single attack. This attack deals damage as normal + 2d6 damage, and negates the penalty for firing into your second range increment. At 10 TP or more, you may spend all TP to deal normal damage + 4d6 damage, and negates the penalty for firing into the third range increment. At 15 TP, you may spend all TP to deal normal damage + 6d6 damage, and negates the penalty for firing into the fourth range increment. This TP Pool lasts until you sleep for the night, in the morning, it empties out. In addition, your weapons of the crossbow or firearm weapon group deal an additional point of damage for each weapon skill feat in this line that you have. If you have another TP pool from another weaponskill feat, it does not stack.
Special: When used with the Sniping action (found under Stealth), you reduce the penalty to your Stealth check by half (this cannot reduce the penalty below -5).

name: Snuffing Spell
benefit: The first time a creature takes damage from or fails a saving throw against a snuffing spell, any non-magical light sources it has are immediately extinguished and you can attempt to dispel any active spells with the light descriptor that are affecting the target as if you had also cast the targeted version of dispel magic. Spells that do not target creatures can’t be snuffing spells.

name: Sociable
benefit: Grant friendly creatures a +2 bonus on Diplomacy checks.

name: Sociable (Elvaan)
benefit: As a move action, you grant all friendly creatures within 30 feet who can see or hear you (including yourself ) a +2 bonus on Diplomacy checks for a number of rounds equal to your Charisma modifier (minimum 1 round).
text:
class="page-content">
You have a way of helping others to get along.
Prerequisite(s): Cha 13, elvaan.
BENEFIT
As a move action, you grant all friendly creatures within 30 feet who can see or hear you (including yourself ) a +2 bonus on Diplomacy checks for a number of rounds equal to your Charisma modifier (minimum 1 round).

name: Social Bravery
benefit: Apply bravery against various social attacks

name: Solar Spell
benefit: Spells you cast with the [light] descriptor are fortified with the cleansing energies of the sun.

name: Solid Shadows
benefit: When casting greater shadow conjuration, greater shadow evocation, shadow conjuration, or shadow evocation (and, at the GM’s discretion, any similar spell with the [shadow] descriptor that mimics a spell of another school), that spell is 20% more real than normal.

name: Solo Maneuvers
benefit: Whenever you are the only one threatening an opponent, you gain a +1 bonus on combat maneuvers against that creature and a +1 bonus to CMD against combat maneuvers made by that creature.

name: Song Perfection (Metasong)
prerequisites: Perform 15 ranks, at least three metasong feats
text:
class="page-content">
You are unequaled at the performance of one particular song.
Prerequisites: Perform 15 ranks, at least three metasong feats.
BENEFIT
Pick one song which you have the ability to perform. Whenever you perform that song, you may apply any one metasong feat you have to that song without affecting its MP cost, as long as the total modified cost of the song does not exceed the maximum amount of MP you may spend on a single song. In addition, if you have other feats which allow you to apply a set numerical bonus to any aspect of this song (such as Spell Focus, Spell Penetration, and so on), double the bonus granted by that feat when applied to this song.

name: Sorceress’ Fury (Bardic Masterpiece)
text:
class="page-content">
You scream out a litany of every way you have been harmed by others, from physical abuse, to verbal insults, to subtle harassment, to any other number of contemptuous actions that denied you something you were rightfully due. All because of what you were.
Prerequisite(s): Perform (act) or Perform (oratory) 7 ranks.
BENEFIT
When you complete the performance, you fall prone, the emotion or power behind your speech driving you to your knees. Any creature that damaged you within the last round must succeed at a Will save or be cursed, as per the bestow curse spell.
Once per day, if you are reduced to fewer than 0 hit points, you can activate this bardic masterpiece as an immediate action before you become dying or dead as long as you have at least 3 rounds of bardic performance remaining.
Use: 3 rounds of bardic performance. 
Action: 1 full-round action.

name: Sorcerous Bloodstrike
benefit: Regain a bloodline power when you reduce a creature to 0 or fewer hit points.

name: Sorcerous Strike
prerequisites: Sorcerer bloodline class feature, Improved Unarmed Strike
benefit: Apply a bloodline ability as part of a melee attack

name: Soulblade
benefit: As a standard action, you can make a weapon attack against a haunt. If successful, your attack deals damage equal to your weapon dice plus any enhancement bonus (but not other bonuses, such as those granted by Strength, Weapon Specialization, or class features like sneak attack). You can use any Vital Strike feat in order to enhance this attack.

name: Soulwrecking Strike
benefit: Whenever you use the attack action against a creature that is possessed, both the creature and any creature possessing it are damaged by your attack (the amount of damage includes your weapon’s damage dice, your Strength modifier, weapon special abilities, and so on). The possessing creature can attempt a Will save (DC = 10 + 1/2 your base attack bonus + your Charisma modifier) to halve the damage. Damage Reduction applies normally against this attack, but incorporeal creatures take full damage from this attack as if they were corporeal.

name: Sow Terror
benefit: Cause a creature to become shaken for 1d4 rounds when you make eerie noises or strange sounds.

name: Space Captain (PuPu)
benefit: You got promoted to Head of your own PuPu Crew, congratulations! This feat works like the Leadership feat but uses your Intelligence instead of your Charisma. Your cohort and followers are all PuPu.
text:
class="page-content">
Due to your admirable intelligence, you managed to attract a crew of PuPu to serve you.
Prerequisite(s): Character level 7, Int 12+, pupu.
BENEFIT
You got promoted to Head of your own PuPu Crew, congratulations! This feat works like the Leadership feat but uses your Intelligence instead of your Charisma. Your cohort and followers are all PuPu.

name: Spawnlink
prerequisites: Int 13, create spawn universal monster ability
benefit: See through spawn’s eyes

name: Spear Dancer
prerequisites: Weapon Focus (any two-handed reach weapon), Perform 4 ranks
benefit: Each time you hit a creature with a two-handed reach weapon that you have Weapon Focus in, the creature is dazzled for 1 round.

name: Spear Dancing Reach
prerequisites: Dex 17, Spear Dancing Spiral, Spear Dancing Style, Two-Weapon Fighting, Weapon Finesse, Weapon Focus with the chosen weapon.
benefit: While using Spear Dancing Style and making a full attack using the chosen weapon as a double weapon, you can grant the reach special weapon feature to one or both of the weapon’s ends until the end of your turn as a swift action.

name: Spear Dancing Spiral
prerequisites: Dex 15, Spear Dancing Style, Two-Weapon Fighting, Weapon Finesse, Weapon Focus with the chosen weapon.
benefit: While using Spear Dancing Style, you gain the benefit of Weapon Finesse with the chosen weapon if it is appropriately sized for a creature of your size category. In addition, you can use any feat or ability that functions with a quarterstaff with your chosen weapon.

name: Spear Dancing Style
prerequisites: Dex 13, Two-Weapon Fighting, Weapon Focus with the chosen weapon.
benefit: Fight with a chosen polearm or spear as if it were a double weapon instead of a brace or reach weapon.

name: Special Delivery
prerequisites: Bonded Mind, Share Spells, ability to deliver spells through an animal companion, eidolon, familiar, or phantom, CL 3
benefit: Whenever you are in contact with an ally who has the Bonded Mind feat and you cast a touch spell, you can designate the ally as the “toucher,” as per the deliver touch spells familiar ability.

name: Spectrum Sight
benefit: You can perform the read aura occult skill unlock even if you can’t use psychic magic. If you can cast psychic spells or have the Psychic Sensitivity feat, you can use read aura one additional time per day.

name: Spell Bane
benefit: Your spells’ DCs increase by 2 when bane is in effect.

name: Spell Bluff
benefit: Bluff other spellcasters, increasing the DC needed to identify your spell.

name: Spell Chain
benefit: Whenever you make a successful caster level check to overcome a target’s spell resistance, the next ally who also has this feat that attempts to overcome the same target’s spell resistance can roll twice when attempting his own caster level check, taking the better result. This benefit must be used within 1 round or else it is lost.

name: Spell Expertise, Major
benefit: Cast 5th-level or lower spell as spell-like ability 2/day.

name: Spell Expertise, Minor
benefit: Cast 1st-level spell as spell-like ability 2/day.

name: Spell Focus
benefit: +1 bonus on save DCs for one school.

name: Spell Focus, Greater
benefit: +1 bonus on save DCs for one school.

name: Spell Hex
benefit: Cast a 1st-level spell as a hex.

name: Spell Mastery
benefit: Prepare some spells without a spellbook.

name: Spell Penetration
benefit: +2 bonus on level checks to beat spell resistance

name: Spell Penetration, Greater
benefit: +2 bonus on level checks to beat spell resistance

name: Spell Perfection
benefit: Apply any metamagic feat to one spell without penalty, up to 9th level.

name: Spell Perfection (Metamagic)
prerequisites: Spellcraft 15 ranks, at least three metamagic feats

name: Spell Specialization
prerequisites: Int 13; Spell focus, Elemental Focus, Light Focus, or Dark Focus
benefit: Select one spell of a school for which you have taken the prerequisite feat. Treat your caster level as being two higher for all level-variable effects of the spell.
text:
class="page-content">
Select one spell. You cast that spell with greater than normal power.
Prerequisite(s): Int 13; Spell focus, Elemental Focus, Light Focus, or Dark Focus
BENEFIT
Select one spell of a school for which you have taken the prerequisite feat. Treat your caster level as being two higher for all level-variable effects of the spell.
Every time you gain an even level in the spellcasting class you chose your spell from, you can choose a new spell to replace the spell selected with this feat, and that spell becomes your specialized spell.
Special: You can gain this feat multiple times. Its effects do not stack. Each time you take the feat, it applies to a different spell.

name: Spell Specialization
benefit: Pick one spell and cast it as if you were higher level.

name: Spell Specialization, Greater
prerequisites: Int 13, Spell Focus, Spell Specialization, ability to cast 5th-level spells
benefit: Sacrifice a spell to cast your specialized spell.

name: Spell-Drinker
prerequisites: Con 13; Great Fortitude, Iron Will, or Lightning Reflexes.
benefit: The magic that cannot harm you only makes you stronger.

name: Spellbreaker
benefit: Enemies provoke attacks if their spells fail

name: Spellsong
prerequisites: Cha 13, bard performance class feature, ability to cast 1st-level spells
benefit: Combine spellcasting and bardic performance.

name: Spider Step
benefit: Walk on walls or ceilings for half your slow fall distance

name: Spider Summoner
prerequisites: Ability to cast summon monster or summon nature’s ally spells, drow
benefit: When casting either a summon monster spell or a summon nature’s ally spell, your options increase

name: Spiked Destroyer
benefit: When you succeed a bull rush or overrun you may automatically attack with armor spikes against the same target.

name: Spinning Throw
prerequisites: Improved Bull Rush, Improved Trip, Improved Unarmed Strike, Ki Throw
benefit: Spend a swift action to bull rush opponent, move it, then knock it prone

name: Spirit Ally
benefit: You have a close connection with a spiritual assistant capable of aiding you in small ways.

name: Spirit Focus
benefit: Increase spirit bonus from one legend by 1

name: Spirit of Syldra (Bardic Masterpiece)
text:
class="page-content">
You play a soulful melody inspired by the legend in which a pirate’s prized companion, slain by a wicked lord, returns in spirit form and instructs the pirate to construct an instrument from its body so that neither the pirate nor beast would be lonely.
Prerequisite(s): Perform (strings) 7 ranks.
BENEFIT
Upon the completion of this performance, you inspire the animal (or similar) companions, familiars, and mounts of allies who can hear the performance to avoid a similar fate, granting them the benefits of greater magic fang with a caster level equal to your bard level.
Use: 1 round of bardic performance per creature affected. 
Action: 1 round.

name: Spirit of the Corps
benefit: Whenever you are within 10 feet of an ally benefiting from a spell or effect that grants a morale bonus on a particular type of roll, once during that effect’s duration, you can apply that morale bonus on a roll you make of that type. For instance, if an ally with this feat is benefiting from heroism, once during the duration of the spell you could gain a +2 morale bonus on one saving throw, attack roll, or skill check. You can use this feat only once per round, and only once per spell or effect.

name: Spirit of the Wild
prerequisites: Attuned to the Wild, Guardian of the Wild, elf
benefit: When you are in a terrain type you have selected the Attuned to the Wild feat for, you gain a +4 bonus on Perception checks made to act in the surprise round of combat

name: Spirit of the Wild (Viera)
prerequisites: Attuned to the Wild, Guardian of the Wild, viera
benefit: When you are in a terrain type you have selected the Attuned to the Wild feat for, you gain a +4 bonus on Perception checks made to act in the surprise round of combat. If you act in the surprise round, you gain blindsense out to a range of 30 feet during the surprise round. If you are in an area that qualifies as more than one kind of terrain, these bonuses do not stack; you receive the bonus for only one terrain type.
text:
class="page-content">
Your mystic connection with one type of wilderness has grown even stronger.
Prerequisite(s): Attuned to the Wild, Guardian of the Wild, viera.
BENEFIT
When you are in a terrain type you have selected the Attuned to the Wild feat for, you gain a +4 bonus on Perception checks made to act in the surprise round of combat. If you act in the surprise round, you gain blindsense out to a range of 30 feet during the surprise round. If you are in an area that qualifies as more than one kind of terrain, these bonuses do not stack; you receive the bonus for only one terrain type.

name: Spirit Oni Master
prerequisites: Knowledge (planes) 3 ranks; Lawful neutral, lawful evil, or neutral evil
benefit: You have bound a spirit oni to your service.

name: Spirit Ridden
benefit: You can invite lesser spirits to partially share your body in exchange for their training and experience.

name: Spirit Sense
prerequisites: Psychic Sensitivity or ability to cast psychic spells
benefit: +5 on checks to notice haunts, 75% chance to affect incorporeal creatures

name: Spirit Speaker
benefit: Talk to spirits you’ve absorbed

name: Spirit Symbiosis
prerequisites: Ability to cast speak with dead, phantom class feature
benefit: For 10 minutes per class level you possess, when you cast speak with dead, you can choose not to gain any of the normal effects of the spell, instead temporarily merging the summoned spirit into your phantom, exchanging your phantom’s current emotional focus and all related abilities for a new emotional focus of your choice.

name: Spirit Talker
prerequisites: Hex class feature; shaman 6 or witch 6
benefit: Commune with a spirit to gain temporary use of one of its hexes.

name: Spirit Vision
