prerequisites: Magic jar as a known spell or spell-like ability, Wis 15
benefit: When you sense life forces while seeking a host, you can observe them as you could when you were in your own body. Attempting to possess a body is a standard action.

name: Spirited Charge
benefit: Double damage on a mounted charge

name: Spiritual Balance
prerequisites: Ki pool class feature, still mind class feature
benefit: Still mind applies against possession, spend ki to double the bonus

name: Spiritual Guardian
prerequisites: Ability to cast spiritual weapon or spiritual ally, spirit magic class feature
benefit: Increase the attack power of your spirit spells.

name: Spiritual Training
benefit: You can resist the control of possessing spirits.

name: Spiritualist’s Call
benefit: Phantom gets a bonus when summoned

name: Spirit’s Gift
prerequisites: Animal companion or familiar class feature
benefit: Commune with a spirit to grant your animal companion or familiar a shaman spirit augmentation.

name: Spit Venom
benefit: As a full-round action, you can spit poison up to 10 feet as a ranged touch attack. If you hit, the target must make a successful Fortitude save or be blinded for 1d6 rounds. The DC of this save is equal to 10 + 1/2 your total Hit Dice + your Constitution modifier. You can use this ability once per day plus one additional time per day for every three Hit Dice you have.

name: Splash Volley
benefit: Throw a splash weapon to an ally which he can redirect at a separate foe.

name: Splash Weapon Mastery
benefit: Gain a number of benefits when throwing a splash weapon.

name: Splintering Weapon
prerequisites: BAB +1, proficient with weapon, weapon made of primitive material
benefit: Break a weapon to deal bleed damage.

name: Split Hex
benefit: A targeted hex can affect two creatures.

name: Split Major Hex
benefit: A targeted major hex can affect two creatures.

name: Spontaneous Metafocus
prerequisites: Cha 13, one metamagic feat, ability to spontaneously cast spells
benefit: Apply metamagic to one spell and keep the standard casting time.

name: Spontaneous Nature’s Ally
prerequisites: Knowledge (nature) 5 ranks, ability to spontaneously cast cure or inflict spells, Animal or Plant domain
benefit: Lose a spell slot to spontaneous cast a summon nature’s ally spell of the same level.

name: Spotter
benefit: When you stand adjacent to an ally with this feat, you gain a +2 circumstance bonus to your ranged attacks. You also benefit from Point-Blank Shot, Far Shot, or Precise Shot, if your ally has the applicable feat.

name: Spotter (Combat, Teamwork, Varg)
benefit: When you stand adjacent to an ally with this feat, you gain a +2 circumstance bonus to your ranged attacks. You also benefit from Point-Blank Shot, Far Shot, or Precise Shot, if your ally has the applicable feat.

name: Sprightly Armor (Combat, Armor Mastery)
prerequisites: Dex 13, base attack bonus +11 or fighter level 8th, armor training class feature, proficiency with light armor.
benefit: You add your armor’s enhancement bonus as a bonus on your initiative checks.

name: Spring Attack
benefit: Move before and after melee attack

name: Spring Loaded (Al Bhed)
benefit: If an enemy is within melee reach, you may make a single melee attack during the first round of combat, before initiative begins. Afterwards, combat process resumes normally, and you may attack again on your initiative if able to.
text:
class="page-content">
Because you have rigged yourself with springs and triggers, you get a free attack before initiative begins.
Prerequisite(s): Al Bhed, 1 rank in Knowledge (engineering).
BENEFIT
If an enemy is within melee reach, you may make a single melee attack during the first round of combat, before initiative begins. Afterwards, combat process resumes normally, and you may attack again on your initiative if able to.
Special: The al bhed must prepare the spring device ahead of time with a successful Knowledge (engineering) check, DC 15. The device can be made of scrap (costs nothing) and has a nominal weight.

name: Spring-Heeled Reaping
prerequisites: Dex 17, Dodge, Mobility, Shot on the Run or Spring Attack, Spring-Heeled Sprint, Spring-Heeled Style, BAB +11, proficiency with light armor.
benefit: While using Spring-Heeled Style, whenever you use Shot on the Run or Spring Attack, you can attack two different creatures at any point in your movement. Each attack is made at your full attack bonus. Any creature that you attack in melee with this feat cannot make attacks of opportunity against you for that movement, as normal for Spring Attack.

name: Spring-Heeled Sprint
prerequisites: Dex 15, Dodge, Mobility, Shot on the Run or Spring Attack, Spring-Heeled Style, BAB +7, proficiency with light armor.
benefit: While using Spring-Heeled Style, you can move up to twice your speed when using the Shot on the Run or Spring Attack feats.

name: Spring-Heeled Style
prerequisites: Dex 13, Dodge, Mobility, Shot on the Run or Spring Attack, BAB +4, proficiency with light armor.
benefit: If using this style during any round in which you take a move action to move 10 or more feet, you gain a +2 bonus on weapon attack rolls until the start of your next turn. While using this style, you gain the AC bonus feats from Mobility against attacks of opportunity provoked by making a ranged attack or loading a ranged weapon.

name: Springing Leaper (Burmecian)
benefit: Whenever you jump, you may move 5 feet further than normal. This only applies to horizontal movement, not vertical movement.
text:
class="page-content">
Your double-jointed legs let you leap further than others.
Prerequisites: Burmecian, Acrobatics 3 ranks
BENEFIT
Whenever you jump, you may move 5 feet further than normal. This only applies to horizontal movement, not vertical movement.

name: Squash Flat
prerequisites: Improved Bull Rush, Merciless Rush, worship an evil god
benefit: If your bull rush exceed targets CMD by 5, attempt a trip.

name: Squire
prerequisites: Character level 3rd, proficiency with all martial weapons
benefit: You gain a squire “cohort.”.

name: Stabbing Shot
benefit: Use arrow as a melee attack to push enemies back

name: Stabbing Shot (Combat, Viera)
benefit: When adjacent to an opponent and making a full-attack action with a great bow, longbow or shortbow (including composite bows), you may choose to make a melee attack against that opponent with a drawn arrow rather than firing it. If the attack hits—whether or not it does damage—your target is pushed back 5 feet away from you. You can then fire arrows from your bow normally, at the original target, or at another target within range. This melee attack replaces the extra attack from Rapid Shot, and all of your attack rolls for the round (the melee attack and the ranged attacks) take a –2 penalty. If your initial attack leaves you with no enemies threatening you, you can make the subsequent ranged attack or attacks without provoking attacks of opportunity.
text:
class="page-content">
You can clear the way to continue using your bow.
Prerequisite(s): Rapid Shot, viera.
BENEFIT
When adjacent to an opponent and making a full-attack action with a great bow, longbow or shortbow (including composite bows), you may choose to make a melee attack against that opponent with a drawn arrow rather than firing it. If the attack hits—whether or not it does damage—your target is pushed back 5 feet away from you. You can then fire arrows from your bow normally, at the original target, or at another target within range. This melee attack replaces the extra attack from Rapid Shot, and all of your attack rolls for the round (the melee attack and the ranged attacks) take a –2 penalty. If your initial attack leaves you with no enemies threatening you, you can make the subsequent ranged attack or attacks without provoking attacks of opportunity.

name: Stable Gallop
benefit: Lower penalties while charging, gain concentration bonus

name: Stage Combatant
benefit: Take no penalty to deal nonlethal damage

name: Staggering Fist
prerequisites: Dex 13, Wis 13, Improved Unarmed Strike, BAB +2
benefit: Stagger foes with unarmed strikes

name: Stalker’s Focus
prerequisites: Knowledge (nature) 3 ranks, Survival 3 ranks, no levels in a class that has the animal focus class feature
benefit: Gain an animal focus for you or your animal companion.

name: Stalwart
benefit: Forgo dodge AC bonus for equivalent DR

name: Stance of the Xorn
benefit: Flanking creatures do not gain a bonus to hit you.

name: Stand Still
benefit: Stop enemies from moving past you

name: Star Initiate
prerequisites: Knowledge (arcana) 1 rank, Knowledge (nature) 1 rank, Knowledge (planes) 1 rank.
benefit: Detect astrological events more easily, increase their benefits and reduce their penalties.

name: Star Scholar
prerequisites: Star Initiate, Knowledge (arcana) 5 ranks, Knowledge (nature) 5 ranks, Knowledge (planes) 5 ranks.
benefit: Increase the duration of effects caused by astrological events

name: Starlight Summons
prerequisites: Spell Focus (conjuration), ability to cast summon nature’s ally
benefit: Summoned creatures gain a bonus on Perception and Stealth checks.

name: Starry Grace
benefit: Use Dexterity on starknife damage rolls

name: Startling Beast Shape
prerequisites: Dazzling Display, beast shape class feature
benefit: You abruptly change shape, startling those who aren’t prepared for your reveal. Whenever you use your beast shape ability to assume your beast form or return to your true form, you can also use Dazzling Display as a free action. Reduce the result of your Intimidate check by 5 against opponents who know that you can beast shape. When using Dazzling Display in this manner, you can use the feat without needing a weapon in hand.
text:
class="page-content">
You use your beastshaping ability in order to demoralize your enemies.
Prerequisites: Dazzling Display, beast shape class feature.
BENEFIT
You abruptly change shape, startling those who aren’t prepared for your reveal. Whenever you use your beast shape ability to assume your beast form or return to your true form, you can also use Dazzling Display as a free action. Reduce the result of your Intimidate check by 5 against opponents who know that you can beast shape. When using Dazzling Display in this manner, you can use the feat without needing a weapon in hand.

name: Startling Getaway
benefit: Move away after a startling appearance

name: Startoss Comet
prerequisites: Dex 13, Point-Blank Shot, Startoss Style, Weapon Focus with the chosen weapon.
benefit: Make an attack with a thrown weapon against two opponents as a standard action.

name: Startoss Shower
prerequisites: Dex 13, Point-Blank Shot, Startoss Comet, Startoss Style, Weapon Focus with the chosen weapon, base attack bonus +4.
benefit: Make additional attacks against nearby enemies when using Startoss Comet.

name: Startoss Style
prerequisites: Dex 13, Point-Blank Shot, Weapon Focus with the chosen weapon.
benefit: Deal extra damage with a thrown weapon when not wielding a weapon or shield (other than a buckler) in your off hand.

name: Status Remover
benefit: As long as you have a healing spell of 4th level or higher in your known spells and have at least 4 MP in your MP pool, you can spend a standard action to remove a status effect from a creature within 30 feet. The level of the status effect removal is based on the highest-level healing spell you can cast. For example, if you can cast 3rd level spells, then you could remove 3rd level and lower status effects. As a secondary benefit, you gain a +1 competence bonus to your caster level when casting healing spells.
text:
class="page-content">
You remove the status effect from a target creature.
Prerequisite(s): Ability to cast 4th-level spells.
BENEFIT
As long as you have a healing spell of 4th level or higher in your known spells and have at least 4 MP in your MP pool, you can spend a standard action to remove a status effect from a creature within 30 feet. The level of the status effect removal is based on your highest level healing spell you can cast. For example, if you can cast 3rd level spells, then you could remove 3rd level and lower status effects. As a secondary benefit, you gain a +1 competence bonus to your caster level when casting healing spells.

name: Steadfast Personality
benefit: Use your Charisma modifier on saves against mind-affecting effects.

name: Steadfast Slayer
benefit: If you are the only character threatening an opponent and you successfully attack the opponent with a two-handed melee weapon, for each size category larger than you that opponent is, you gain a +2 bonus on your melee damage roll.

name: Steady Engagement
benefit: If you prevent an opponent from moving via Stand Still, may disarm or trip the target as an immediate action.

name: Steal MP
prerequisites: Sneak Attack class feature, MP pool
benefit: If you hit an opponent with a successful sneak attack, you can choose to forgo dealing 1d6 points of sneak attack damage and instead steal 1d4 MP from your target. For each die of sneak attack damage you forgo, the more die you steal from your opponent's MP.
text:
class="page-content">
You siphon off your opponent’s MP.
Prerequisite: Sneak Attack class feature, must have a MP pool.
Benefit
If you hit an opponent with a successful sneak attack, you can choose to forgo dealing 1d6 points of sneak attack damage and instead steal 1d4 MP from your target. For each die of sneak attack damage you forgo, the more die you steal from your opponent’s MP.

name: Steal, Greater
benefit: Enemies do not notice theft until later

name: Steal, Improved
benefit: +2 bonus on steal attempts, no AOO

name: Stealth Synergy
benefit: Take the highest roll made by you and your allies on Stealth checks

name: Stealthy
benefit: +2 bonus on Escape Artist and Stealth checks.

name: Steam Caster
benefit: Convert a fire spell into steam, allowing it to work normally underwater

name: Steam Spell
benefit: You can apply Steam Spell only to a spell with the fire descriptor. A steam spell works underwater without a caster level check, but it requires a caster level check to function above water. A steam spell uses up a slot the same spell level as the spell’s actual level.

name: Steel Soul
benefit: +4 racial bonus on saves against spells and spell-like abilities.

name: Step Up
benefit: Take a 5-foot step as an immediate action

name: Step Up and Strike
benefit: Follow adjacent creature and attack as an immediate action

name: Stick Together
benefit: When an adjacent ally with this feat moves, you can move up to your speed as an immediate action, as long as your movement ends adjacent to that ally. If you do so, you are staggered on your next turn. This movement provokes attacks of opportunity as normal.

name: Still Spell
benefit: Cast spell without somatic components

name: Stock-Striker Style
benefit: Your fighting technique makes you equally deadly with your firearm’s stock as with its bullets.

name: Stock-Striker Sweep
prerequisites: Stock-Striker Style, BAB +7, pistol-whip gunslinger deed
benefit: The force of your firearm strikes can drive back your foe or damage a second target.

name: Stock-Striker Takedown
prerequisites: Point-Blank Shot, Stock-Striker Style, Stock-Striker Sweep, BAB +9, pistol-whip gunslinger deed
benefit: Your melee strike leaves your target vulnerable to a merciless finishing shot.

name: Stoic
benefit: +1 bonus on all saving throws against fear effects.

name: Stoic Pose
benefit: You can turn still as a statue, allowing you to make Stealth checks without cover or concealment

name: Stoic Pose (Tarutaru)
benefit: By spending 5 rounds finding a suitable location, you can hold yourself so still that you appear to be a Small object such as a pile of rocks. This allows you to make a Stealth check without cover or concealment, as long as you do not move or take any other actions.
text:
class="page-content">
You can hold yourself as still as a statue, evading detection.
Prerequisite(s): Tarutaru.
BENEFIT
By spending 5 rounds finding a suitable location, you can hold yourself so still that you appear to be a Small object such as a pile of rocks. This allows you to make a Stealth check without cover or concealment, as long as you do not move or take any other actions.

name: Stone Awareness
benefit: Gain tremorsense 15 feet when in contact with earth or stone.

name: Stone Clinger
benefit: This creature gains a climb speed of 10 ft. and can hang from ceilings and drop on foes, dealing them piercing damage.

name: Stone Dodger
benefit: Whenever you are able to see and hear at least one ally with this feat, you receive a +4 dodge bonus to AC against attacks from hurled rocks (or projectiles of similar shape, including bludgeoning ranged attacks from siege weapons). If you are hit by such an attack while you have this bonus, you can attempt a Reflex save to take only half damage from the attack. The DC for this save is equal to the bonus of the ranged attack used to hurl the rock.

name: Stone Magic
prerequisites: Stone giant elder (700 years or older), Cha 17
benefit: In addition to normal spell-like abilities of a stone giant elder, can use passwall, statue, spike stones, stoneskin, and wall of stone 1/day.

name: Stone Read
benefit: Gain a +3 bonus on Perception checks while underground or in mountainous environment. If you have 10+ ranks in Knowledge (dungeoneering), bonus increases to +6.

name: Stone Sense
benefit: Gain tremorsense 10 ft.

name: Stone Singer
benefit: Gain benefits to bardic performance underground and against earth creatures.

name: Stone Soul
benefit: Your natural armor bonus increases by 1. Once per day, you can use stoneskin (on yourself only) as a spell-like ability. Your caster level is equal to 1/2 your Hit Dice.

name: Stone-Faced
benefit: +4 bonus on Bluff checks to lie or conceal motives.

name: Stonecunning, Improved
benefit: +4 bonus on Perception checks to notice unusual stonework.

name: Stony Step
benefit: Ignore 5 feet of earth-based difficult terrain

name: Storm Bolt
prerequisites: Ability to cast 3rd level spells, Elemental Focus (Lightning).
benefit: As long as you have an elemental (lightning) spell of 3rd level or higher in your known spells and have at least 3 MP in your MP pool, you can fire a 20-foot line of lightning as a standard action. This bolt deals 1d6 points of lightning damage per level of the highest-level lightning spell you can cast. A successful Reflex (DC 10 + half caster level + caster modifier) save halves damage. As a secondary benefit, you gain a +1 competence bonus to your caster level when casting elemental (lightning) spells.
text:
class="page-content">
The lightning energy contained within your magic rages inside you, begging to be released.
Prerequisite(s): Ability to cast 3rd level spells, Elemental Focus (Lightning).
BENEFIT
As long as you have an elemental (lightning) spell of 3rd level or higher in your known spells and have at least 3 MP in your MP pool, you can fire a 20-foot line of lightning as a standard action. This bolt deals 1d6 points of lightning damage per level of the highest-level lightning spell you can cast. A successful Reflex (DC 10 + half caster level + caster modifier) save halves damage. As a secondary benefit, you gain a +1 competence bonus to your caster level when casting elemental (lightning) spells.

name: Storm Soul
benefit: You gain immunity to electricity.

name: Storm Survivor
benefit: Gain a +2 bonus on Perception checks, Survival checks, and saves against storm effects during a storm of any type

name: Storm-Lashed
benefit: Halves the penalties in strong weather. +2 on saves vs. electricity.

name: Stouthearted
benefit: Use raging song to reroll failed saves against fear effects.

name: Strangler
benefit: Deal sneak damage to grappled opponent

name: Street Carnage
prerequisites: Street Style, Street Sweep, BAB +8 or monk 7
benefit: Gain ×3 critical multiplier with unarmed strikes

name: Street Smarts
benefit: +2 bonus on Knowledge (local) and Sense Motive checks

name: Street Style
prerequisites: Str 15, Improved Bull Rush, Improved Unarmed Strike, Power Attack, BAB +4 or monk 3
benefit: Deal extra damage and bull rush in urban areas

name: Street Sweep
benefit: Follow up attack to knock bull-rushed foes prone

name: Strengthened Wings (Moogle or Gria)
benefit: Your fly speed increases by 10 feet, your flight maneuverability increases by 1 step, and you no longer need to rest after flying. You can only fly as long as you do not carry more than a Light load, are not wearing any armor heavier than medium, and are not fatigued or exhausted.
text:
class="page-content">
Your wings have strengthened enough to allow you to fly without limitations.
Prerequisite(s): Character level 10, moogle or gria.
BENEFIT
Your fly speed increases by 10 feet, your flight maneuverability increases by 1 step, and you no longer need to rest after flying. You can only fly as long as you do not carry more than a Light load, are not wearing any armor heavier than medium, and are not fatigued or exhausted.
Special: A character with the Armor Training class feature may wear medium or heavy armor with this feat.

name: Stretched Wings
prerequisites: Str 13, Skill Focus (Fly), strix, wing-clipped racial trait
benefit: Increase your racial fly speed to 60 feet (average)

name: Stretched Wings (Aegyl)
prerequisites: Str 13, Skill Focus (Fly), aegyl, wing-clipped racial trait
benefit: Your aegyl racial fly speed increases to 40 feet (poor). You ignore the wing-clipped trait's Fly check requirement to fly upward.
text:
class="page-content">
You strengthen your crippled wings.
Prerequisite(s): Str 13, Skill Focus (Fly), aegyl, wing-clipped racial trait.
BENEFIT
Your aegyl racial fly speed increases to 40 feet (average). You ignore the wing-clipped trait’s Fly check requirement to fly upward.

name: Strike Back
benefit: Attack foes that strike you while using reach

name: Strong Comeback
benefit: Add a +2 bonus on all rerolls.

name: Strong Implement Link
benefit: Cast spells away from an implement more easily

name: Structural Strike
prerequisites: Knowledge (engineering) 5 ranks, precise strike class feature or precise strike deed
benefit: Use precise strike against creatures normally immune

name: Stubborn Curse
prerequisites: Ability to cast a spell or spell-like ability with the
benefit: Creatures roll twice to remove your curses curse descriptor or a special ability with a curse effect

name: Studied Combatant
benefit: Expend inspiration to gain a limited version of studied combat.

name: Studied Expertise
benefit: You can spend one use of inspiration as a swift action to grant allies within 30 feet that can hear you a +4 insight bonus on attack rolls against one type of monster for 1 round, provided you succeeded at a Knowledge check to identify that type of monster’s special powers or vulnerabilities no more than 1 minute earlier.

name: Studied Song (Metasong)
text:
class="page-content">
You use your knowledge about the target to bypass its resistances and damage reduction.
BENEFIT
When performing a studied song, designate one target affected by the song. Attempt an appropriate Knowledge check based on that target’s creature type as you perform the song. The DC for this check is equal to 20 + the creature’s CR based on its race and not including any class levels or template (a creature that is defined by class levels has an effective CR of 0 for this ability). If you succeed, your studied song ignores any elemental resistance or damage reduction the target has because of its race as well as any bonuses on saving throws against the song granted by the target’s race (such as the bonus from a dwarf’s hardy ability). Your studied song doesn’t ignore elemental resistance, damage reduction, or saving throw bonuses granted by other songs and effects. If you fail the Knowledge check, the song still has its normal effects.
MP Increase: +2 (a studied song costs 2 additional MP more than the actual MP cost of the song.) In addition, the perform check DC increases by +2.

name: Studied Spell
benefit: Spell uses Knowledge to bypass racial resistances

name: Stumbling Bash (Combat, Shield Mastery)
prerequisites: Improved Shield Bash, Shield Focus, base attack bonus +6 or fighter level 4th.
benefit: Creatures struck by your shield bash take a –2 penalty to their AC until the end of your next turn.

name: Stunning Assault
benefit: Trade melee attack bonus to stun opponents

name: Stunning Fist
prerequisites: Dex 13, Wis 13, Improved Unarmed Strike, BAB +8
benefit: Stun opponent with an unarmed strike

name: Stunning Fist Adept
benefit: Add +1 to the saving throw DC against your Stunning Fist attacks. This bonus does not stack with feats that grant you bonuses to the DC for saving throws against your Stunning Fist attacks, such as Mantis Style.

name: Stunning Irruption
benefit: When you smash your way into a room, you gain more than just the element of surprise.

name: Stunning Pin
benefit: Use Stunning Fist against pinned opponents

name: Sturmwind
benefit: At 5 TP or more, you may spend all TP to deliver a special axe attack that takes the place of an attack in a full-attack or just a single attack. This attack deals normal damage + 2d6 points of damage. At 10 TP or more, you may spend all TP to deal + 4d6 points of damage. At 15 TP, you may spend all TP to deal + 6d6 damage.
text:
class="page-content">
You can deliver a swift blow, gouging your enemies.
Prerequisite(s): Smash Axe, BAB +7.
BENEFIT
At 5 TP or more, you may spend all TP to deliver a special axe attack that takes the place of an attack in a full-attack or just a single attack. This attack deals normal damage + 2d6 points of damage. At 10 TP or more, you may spend all TP to deal + 4d6 points of damage. At 15 TP, you may spend all TP to deal + 6d6 damage.

name: Stygian Spell
benefit: You can enhance any spell with the water descriptor that targets at least one creature to become a Stygian spell.

name: Stylized Spell
benefit: Spell is difficult to identify and might be mistaken for a similar spell

name: Subconscious Usurpation
benefit: You have trained your subconscious to overpower your conscious mind under dire circumstances.

name: Subjective Mobility
benefit: Move via falling more easily on planes with subjective directional gravity

name: Subjective Slam
prerequisites: Con 13, Wis 13, Subjective Mobility, base attack bonus +4 or monk level 3rd
benefit: Take half falling damage and you can intentionally fall against targets to damage them while on planes with subjective directional gravity

name: Subtle Enchantments
benefit: Victims and observers might not notice your enchantments

name: Summon Elemental
prerequisites: Ability to cast 4th-level spells, Spell Focus (Summoning).
benefit: As long as you have a summoning spell of 4th level or higher in your known spells and have at least 4 MP in your MP pool, you can summon a Small elemental (any element; your choice) within a range of 30 feet. The elemental acts as if summoned by a summon monster spell. The duration of the summoning is equal to 1 round per level of the highest-level summoning spell you can cast. You can have only one summoned elemental from this feat at a time; if you use the ability a second time, the first elemental disappears. Also, you must remain close to the elemental you summon. If at the end of your turn you are more than 30 feet from the elemental, it disappears. If you have a summoning spell of 6th level or higher available to cast, you can summon a Medium elemental instead. If you have a summoning spell of 8th level or higher available to cast, you can summon a Large elemental instead. As a secondary benefit, you gain a +1 competence bonus to your caster level when casting summoning spells.
text:
class="page-content">
You can channel the summoning power you hold to briefly bring forth an elemental servant.
Prerequisite(s): Ability to cast 4th-level spells, Spell Focus (Summoning).
BENEFIT
As long as you have a summoning spell of 4th level or higher in your known spells and have at least 4 MP in your MP pool, you can summon a Small elemental (any element; your choice) within a range of 30 feet. The elemental acts as if summoned by a summon monster spell. The duration of the summoning is equal to 1 round per level of the highest-level summoning spell you can cast. You can have only one summoned elemental from this feat at a time; if you use the ability a second time, the first elemental disappears. Also, you must remain close to the elemental you summon. If at the end of your turn you are more than 30 feet from the elemental, it disappears.
If you have a summoning spell of 6th level or higher available to cast, you can summon a Medium elemental instead. If you have a summoning spell of 8th level or higher available to cast, you can summon a Large elemental instead.
As a secondary benefit, you gain a +1 competence bonus to your caster level when casting summoning spells.

name: Summon Evil Monster
benefit: You can summon the aid of creatures driven their very nature to destroy goodness.

name: Summon Good Monster
benefit: You can summon creatures that, by their very nature, wish to fight evil creatures.

name: Summon Neutral Monster
benefit: You can summon creatures that embody the forces of balance.

name: Summon Undead
prerequisites: Ability to cast 4th-level spells, Spell Focus (Necromancy)
benefit: As long as you have a necromancy spell of 4th level or higher in your known spells and have at least 4 MP in your MP pool, you can summon any CR 2 or less undead creature (your choice) within a range of 30 feet. The undead acts as if summoned by a summon undead spell. The duration of the summoning is equal to 1 round per level of the highest-level necromancy spell you can cast. You can have only one summoned undead from this feat at a time; if you use the ability a second time, the first undead disappears. Also, you must remain close to the undead you summon. If at the end of your turn you are more than 30 feet from the undead, it disappears. If you have a necromancy spell of 6th level or higher available to cast, you can summon any CR 6 or less undead creature (your choice) instead. If you have a necromancy spell of 8th level or higher available to cast, you can summon any CR 8 or less undead creature (your choice) instead. As a secondary benefit, you gain a +1 competence bonus to your caster level when casting necromancy spells.
text:
class="page-content">
You can channel the necromancy power you hold to briefly bring forth an undead servant.
Prerequisite(s): Ability to cast 4th-level spells, Spell Focus (Necromancy).
BENEFIT
As long as you have a necromancy spell of 4th level or higher in your known spells and have at least 4 MP in your MP pool, you can summon any CR 2 or less undead creature (your choice) within a range of 30 feet. The undead acts as if summoned by a summon undead spell. The duration of the summoning is equal to 1 round per level of the highest-level necromancy spell you can cast. You can have only one summoned undead from this feat at a time; if you use the ability a second time, the first undead disappears. Also, you must remain close to the undead you summon. If at the end of your turn you are more than 30 feet from the undead, it disappears.
If you have a necromancy spell of 6th level or higher available to cast, you can summon any CR 6 or less undead creature (your choice) instead. If you have a necromancy spell of 8th level or higher available to cast, you can summon any CR 8 or less undead creature (your choice) instead.
As a secondary benefit, you gain a +1 competence bonus to your caster level when casting necromancy spells.

name: Summon Weapon
benefit: The character may scribe a rune on a weapon. As long as that weapon is unattended, the character can spend 1 MP to call the weapon to his hand as a swift action. The character can prepare as many weapons as he wants, but cannot use this feat if his hands are full. The weapon must be within line of sight.
text:
class="page-content">
Prerequisite: MP pool.
Benefit
The character may scribe a rune on a weapon. As long as that weapon is unattended, the character can spend 1 MP to call the weapon to his hand as a swift action. The character can prepare as many weapons as he wants, but cannot use this feat if his hands are full. The weapon must be within line of sight.

name: Summoner’s Call
benefit: Your eidolon gets a bonus when summoned.

name: Sun Loving (Mandragora)
benefit: You can use photosynthesis one additional time per day.
text:
class="page-content">
You can use photosynthesis more often.
Prerequisite(s): Mandragora, Character level 5.
BENEFIT
You can use photosynthesis one additional time per day.
Special: You can take this feat more than once.

name: Sunder Blessing
benefit: You can attempt to sunder an ongoing divine spell effect or divine spell-like ability by succeeding at a combat maneuver check.

name: Sunder, Greater
benefit: Damage from sunder attempts transfers to your enemy

name: Sunder, Improved
benefit: +2 bonus on sunder attempts, no AOO

name: Sundering Strike
benefit: Attempt a sunder attack on a successful critical hit

name: Sunlight Eyes
prerequisites: Ability to cast 2nd-level spells, Light Focus.
benefit: As long as you have a light spell of 2nd level or higher in your known spells and have at least 2 MP in your MP pool, you can take a swift action to grant yourself the ability to see normally in any conditions of illumination (shadowy illumination, darkness, and magical shadow or darkness). The range of this vision is 10 feet per level of the highest-level light spell you can cast, and the effect lasts for 1 round. As a secondary benefit, you gain a +1 competence bonus to your caster level when casting light spells.
text:
class="page-content">
The bright magic within you allows you to see through the darkest shadow.
Prerequisite(s): Ability to cast 2nd-level spells, Light Focus.
BENEFIT
As long as you have a light spell of 2nd level or higher in your known spells and have at least 2 MP in your MP pool, you can take a swift action to grant yourself the ability to see normally in any conditions of illumination (shadowy illumination, darkness, and magical shadow or darkness). The range of this vision is 10 feet per level of the highest-level light spell you can cast, and the effect lasts for 1 round. As a secondary benefit, you gain a +1 competence bonus to your caster level when casting light spells.

name: Sunlight Resistance
benefit: You are able to withstand direct sunlight longer than normal.

name: Sunlight Summons
prerequisites: Spell Focus (conjuration), ability to cast summon nature’s ally
benefit: Summoned creatures glow and are immune to blinding and dazzling effects.

name: Sunlit Strike
benefit: Whenever you successfully hit an enemy that is vulnerable to light (such as by the light blindness, light sensitivity, or sunlight powerlessness universal monster rules) with a melee weapon you’ve imbued with your Arcane Strike feat, you deal an additional 1d6 points of damage to the target of your attack. The struck creature must also succeed at a Fortitude saving throw (DC 10 + 1/2 your character level + your Strength modifier) or become staggered for 1 round.

name: Sunlit Strike (Forgiven)
prerequisites: Arcane Strike, light II spell-like ability
benefit: Whenever you successfully hit an enemy that is vulnerable to light (such as by the light blindness, light sensitivity, or sunlight powerlessness universal monster rules) with a melee weapon you’ve imbued with your Arcane Strike feat, you deal an additional 1d6 points of holy damage to the target of your attack. The struck creature must also succeed at a Fortitude saving throw (DC 10 + 1/2 your character level + your Strength modifier) or become staggered for 1 round.
text:
class="page-content">
Your melee blows deal extra damage to creatures sensitive to light, making you adept at hunting foul monsters of the Night.
Prerequisite(s): Arcane Strike, daylight spell-like ability.
BENEFIT
Whenever you successfully hit an enemy that is vulnerable to light (such as by the light blindness, light sensitivity, or sunlight powerlessness universal monster rules) with a melee weapon you’ve imbued with your Arcane Strike feat, you deal an additional 1d6 points of holy damage to the target of your attack. The struck creature must also succeed at a Fortitude saving throw (DC 10 + 1/2 your character level + your Strength modifier) or become staggered for 1 round.

name: Superconductivity
prerequisites: Ability to cast 3rd-level spells, Elemental Focus (Lightning)
benefit: While you have an elemental (lightning) spell of 3rd level or higher in your known spells and have at least 3 MP in your MP pool, you can redirect lightning effects with ease, using the original save DC or 10 + half your caster level + your highest mental ability score modifier, whichever is higher. Furthermore, you gain Evasion against Elemental [Lightning] effects. As a secondary benefit, you gain a +1 competence bonus to your caster level when casting elemental (lightning) spells.
text:
class="page-content">
You weave lightning about you, turning other peoples’ lightning spells back at them.
Prerequisite(s): Ability to cast 3rd-level spells, Elemental Focus (Lightning).
BENEFIT
While you have an elemental (lightning) spell of 3rd level or higher in your known spells and have at least 3 MP in your MP pool, as an immediate action, you can redirect one lightning spell or effect with ease, either back at the caster or other targets, using the original save DC or 10 + half your caster level + your highest mental ability score modifier, whichever is higher. Furthermore, you gain Evasion against Elemental [Lightning] effects. As a secondary benefit, you gain a +1 competence bonus to your caster level when casting elemental (lightning) spells.

name: Superior Scryer
prerequisites: Spell Focus (divination), the ability to cast at least one spell of the scrying subschool
benefit: Improve various effects of scrying spells

name: Superior Summoning
benefit: When summoning more than one creature, summon an extra one.

name: Supernal Feast
benefit: Whenever you are adjacent to a good outsider that takes bleed or blood drain damage, you gain 1 temporary hit point as you bathe in the celestial being’s gore. Furthermore, as a full-round action, you can feast on the fallen body of a good outsider that has been dead no longer than 24 hours. When you do, you regain 1 temporary hit point per Hit Die the outsider possessed at a rate of 1 hit point per minute. Temporary hit points gained from this feat last 1d4 hours.

name: Suppress Blight
benefit: You can temporarily suppress afflictions brought on by blight, at a long-term cost.

name: Suppress Regeneration
benefit: When you make a successful attack that causes a creature’s regeneration ability to cease functioning for at least 1 round (such as by hitting a troll with alchemist’s fire), any ally who also has this feat and is currently threatening the creature can make an attack of opportunity against it. This attack of opportunity deals no damage, but instead extends the time that the creature’s regeneration is suppressed by 1 additional round. If multiple allies with this feat hit the creature with this attack of opportunity, the additional rounds of suppression stack.

name: Suppressive Fire
prerequisites: Far Shot, Point-Blank Shot, Precise Shot, keen senses racial trait
benefit: When you damage a target with a ranged attack, it can’t make attacks of opportunity against allies who have this feat

name: Sure and Fleet
prerequisites: Fleet of foot racial trait, halfling
benefit: You gain a +2 racial bonus on Acrobatics and Climb checks

name: Sure Grasp
benefit: When climbing, roll twice and take the highest result.

name: Sure-Footed
benefit: Gain bonuses to Acrobatics, Reflex checks

name: Surge of Success
benefit: When you confirm a crit or roll a 20 on a saving throw, gain a +2 bonus to another roll before your next turn

name: Surprise Follow-Through
benefit: When using Cleave or Great Cleave, the second foe you attack on your turn is denied its Dexterity bonus against you.

name: Surprise Follow-Through (Combat, Galka)
prerequisites: Str 13, Cleave, Power Attack, base attack bonus +1, galka
benefit: When using Cleave or Great Cleave, the second foe you attack on your turn is denied its Dexterity bonus against you.

name: Surprise Follow-Through, Improved
prerequisites: Str 13, Cleave, Great Cleave, Power Attack, Surprise Follow Through, bab +8
benefit: When cleaving, all opponents are denied their Dex bonus

name: Surprise Maneuver
prerequisites: Combat Expertise; sneak attack +3d6 or studied strike +3d6
benefit: Gain a bonus on combat maneuver checks against flanked foes and those denied their Dex bonus to AC.

name: Surprise Strike
prerequisites: Cautious Fighter, Desperate Swing, BAB +6, halfling
benefit: Once per day, when fighting defensively or making an AOO while taking the total defense action with the Desperate Swing feat, you take no penalty on the attack roll.

name: Surprise Strike (Combat, Moogle)
prerequisites: Cautious Fighter, Desperate Swing, base attack bonus +6, moogle
benefit: Once per day, when fighting defensively or making an attack of opportunity while taking the total defense action with the Desperate Swing feat, you take no penalty on the attack roll.

name: Survivor
benefit: +5 bonus on all Constitution checks made to stabilize while dying.

name: Swamper
benefit: +2 bonus on Swim checks, Climb checks, and some Acrobatics checks on slippery surfaces; move at full speed through bogs and see twice as far in fog

name: Swap Places
benefit: Whenever you are adjacent to an ally who also has this feat, you can move into your ally’s square as part of normal movement. At the same time, your ally moves into your previous space as an immediate action. Both you and your ally must be willing and able to move to take advantage of this feat. Your ally must be the same size as you to utilize this feat. Your ally does not provoke an AOO from this movement, but you provoke as normal. This movement does not count against your ally’s movement on his next turn.

name: Sweeping Dodge
benefit: When you make a dueling dodge while wearing a cloak, you gain evasion (as the rogue ability). If a critical hit or sneak attack is scored on you, there is a 25% chance that the critical hit or sneak attack is negated and damage is instead rolled normally. This feat only applies until the attack that triggered the immediate action is resolved. This feat does not stack with the fortification armor special ability or similar effects.

name: Swift Iron Style
prerequisites: Str 13, Dex 13, proficiency with medium armor.
benefit: While using this style, you treat the armor check penalty of your armor as if it were 1 less, and the maximum Dexterity bonus to AC as if it were 1 higher.

name: Swift Kitsune Shapechanger
benefit: You can assume human or kitsune form as a swift action. If you have the Fox Shape feat, you can assume fox form as a swift action as well.

name: Swift Refuge
prerequisites: Str 13, Dex 13, Swift Iron Style, proficiency with medium armor.
benefit: Once per day when using Swift Iron Style, when you’re hit by a weapon, unarmed attack, or natural weapon, you can treat all dice other than the weapon’s base damage dice (including extra dice from sneak attack, critical hit, magic special weapon abilities, and Vital Strike) as having rolled 1s. You can use this ability a second time per day when your BAB reaches +8, and a third time at +16.

name: Swift Sprint
prerequisites: Str 13, Dex 13, Swift Iron Style, Swift Refuge, proficiency with medium armor.
benefit: When you’re charging, running, or taking no action in your turn other than movement, your armor does not reduce your movement.

name: Swing About
benefit: If you have a free hand, as a move action you can grab a willing adjacent ally who also has this feat and place her in any other space adjacent to you. This movement does not provoke attacks of opportunity. You can do this only with allies who are able to move freely (not grappled, held, prone, slowed, or otherwise suffering restricted movement) and who are of your size or smaller.

name: Swipe and Stash
benefit: Plant objects on others

name: Sword And Pistol
benefit: Ranged attacks do not provoke attacks of opportunity

name: Sword Oath
prerequisites: Proficient in longsword, Weapon Focus (longsword), BAB +4
benefit: You may select longsword-related feats as if you were a 4th-level fighter.

name: Swordplay Deflection
prerequisites: Combat Expertise, Improved Feint, Swordplay Style, Swordplay Upset, Weapon Focus with the chosen weapon, base attack bonus +7.
benefit: While using Swordplay Style, when you make one or more melee attacks, you can forgo a single melee attack to prepare an action to attempt to disrupt an opponent’s attack. If you succeed, you gain a +4 shield bonus to your Armor Class against attacks made by your opponent until the start of your next turn.

name: Swordplay Style
prerequisites: Combat Expertise, Weapon Focus with the chosen weapon, base attack bonus +3.
benefit: Gain a +1 shield bonus to your Armor Class when wielding a heavy blade or light blade and fighting defensively or using either the total defense action or the Combat Expertise feat. You do not take the penalty on melee attacks from Combat Expertise on the first attack roll you make each turn.

name: Swordplay Upset
prerequisites: Combat Expertise, Improved Feint, Swordplay Style, Weapon Focus with the chosen weapon, base attack bonus +5.
benefit: While using Swordplay Style, as an immediate action, you can attempt a feint against an opponent that makes a melee attack against you and misses.

name: Sycophant
benefit: You can attempt to use Diplomacy to force an enemy to show you mercy.

name: Sympathetic Rage
benefit: Enter a rage-like state when near an ally who is raging.

name: Symphony of Dark Elf’s Bane (Bardic Masterpiece)
text:
class="page-content">
The complex arpeggios in this piece follow each other so quickly that the music can sound jumbled and disjointed at first. As the piece progresses, however, distinct phrases emerge, creating a wild but harmonious piece that inspires feelings of unfettered freedom.
Prerequisite(s): Perform (keyboard) or Perform (wind) 7 ranks.
BENEFIT
You and up to one ally per bard level within 30 feet who can hear you can move and attack normally for the duration of your performance, even if under the influence of magic that usually impedes movement. This effect is identical to that of freedom of movement, except that this masterpiece does not allow subjects to move and attack normally while underwater unless these creatures would already be able to do so, and only lasts as long as you continue the performance.
Use: 1 bardic performance per round. 
Action: 1 round.

name: Symphony of the Dark Messenger (Bardic Masterpiece)
text:
class="page-content">
You contort your vocal cords to produce an eerie, melodious song about the wonders of the court of Diabolos.
Prerequisite(s): Perform (sing) 15 ranks.
BENEFIT
The sinisterly seductive song bores its way into the target’s flesh, levitating it as per reverse gravity as long as the bard maintains the performance. Although the symphony does have words—and is often sung in Infernal—this is not a language-dependent effect.
Use: 1 round of bardic performance per round. 
Action: 1 standard action.

name: Symphony of the Lunarian’s Ascent (Bardic Masterpiece)
text:
class="page-content">
This elaborate arrangement for traditional Mysidian instruments evokes Cecil Harvey’s climb up the Mount of Ordeals, where it’s said that he fought his dark self to achieve redemption for his past actions.
Prerequisite(s): Perform (percussion) or Perform (wind) 7 ranks.
BENEFIT
All allies within 30 feet become immune to one of the following (your choice) while they can hear your performance: charm effects, the dazed condition, fear effects, magical sleep, paralysis, the staggered condition, or the stunned condition. You must choose the condition before activating the performance and can’t change your choice during the performance. If any affected ally currently has the chosen condition, she can attempt a new saving throw against it each round she can hear your song. Success on this saving throw has its usual benefit, but failure has no effect at all. This performance relies on audible components.
Use: 1 bardic performance round per round. 
Action: 1 full round.

name: Syricta Nobility (Syricta)
prerequisites: Syricta, Dragonhide and Claws racial traits
benefit: Increase your Strength or Intelligence score by 1, up to a maximum of 20. Your scales become more rigid and harden, gain +1 natural armor bonus to AC. Your claws are enlarged, dealing 1d6 points of damage instead.
text:
class="page-content">
Your blood courses with power, granting your claws greater power and your hide tougher.
Prerequisite(s): Syricta, Dragonhide and Claws racial traits.
BENEFIT
• Increase your Strength or Intelligence score by 1, up to a maximum of 20.
• Your scales become more rigid and harden, gain +1 natural armor bonus to AC.
• Your claws are enlarged, dealing 1d6 points of damage instead.

name: Tactical Reposition
benefit: You can reposition a foe into a dangerous space such as a pit or blade barrier.

name: Tail Terror
benefit: You can make a tail slap attack with your tail. This is a secondary natural attack that deals 1d4 points of bludgeoning damage. Furthermore, you can augment your tail slap attack with a kobold tail attachment. For the purpose of weapon feats, you are considered proficient with all kobold tail attachments.

name: Tail Terror (Combat, Bangaa)
prerequisites: Base attack bonus +1, prehensile tail racial trait, bangaa
benefit: You can make a tail slap attack with your tail. This is a secondary natural attack that deals 1d4 points of bludgeoning damage.

name: Take the Hit
benefit: As long as an ally with the Bonded Mind feat is adjacent to you, you can choose to absorb up to half of the hit point damage from any attack that strikes him, as if subject to a shield other spell. Using this ability is an immediate action, and it only applies to one attack, even if the ally is hit by multiple attacks as part of the same action.

name: Talented Magician
prerequisites: Major magic rogue talent, minor magic rogue talent
benefit: Gain additional uses of spell-like abilities.

name: Tales of the Kings’ Shields (Bardic Masterpiece)
text:
class="page-content">
This medley of tales of the Shields of past Lucian Kings inspires listeners to new heights of bravery and self-sacrifice.
Prerequisite(s): Perform (act) or Perform (oratory) 3 ranks.
BENEFIT
When you complete the performance, choose one adjacent creature. You and that creature are affected as if you had cast shield other.
Use: 3 bardic performance rounds. 
Action: 3 rounds.

name: Tandem Evasion
benefit: When adjacent to an ally who also has this feat, you gain evasion against a dragon’s breath weapon and tail sweep special attacks. If you already have evasion, you gain improved evasion instead.

name: Tandem Trip
benefit: When you make a trip against an opponent threatened by any ally, roll twice and take the higher result

name: Tangle Feet
prerequisites: Dodge, Mobility, Underfoot, Goblin, Small size or smaller
benefit: When you successfully make an Acrobatics check to avoid provoking an AOO from a larger opponent when you move through its threatened area or its space, you can make that opponent lose its balance until the end of its next turn as a free action. While that creature’s balance is lost, if it attempts to move, it must make a successful DC 15 Acrobatics check or fall prone, wasting the move action. You can only affect one creature with this effect each round.

name: Tangle Feet (Combat, Goblin, Mandragora, Moogle or Tarutaru)
prerequisites: Dodge, Mobility, Underfoot, Goblin, Mandragora, Moogle or Tarutaru, Small size or smaller
benefit: When you successfully make an Acrobatics check to avoid provoking an attack of opportunity from a larger opponent when you move through its threatened area or its space, you can make that opponent lose its balance until the end of its next turn as a free action. While that creature’s balance is lost, if it attempts to move, it must make a successful DC 15 Acrobatics check or fall prone, wasting the move action. You can only affect one creature with this effect each round.

name: Tantrum
prerequisites: Bluff 1 rank, rage class feature, gnome
benefit: Use the Bluff skill to feint while raging.

name: Target of Opportunity
benefit: When an ally hits with a ranged attack, you may make an attack as an immediate action

name: Taskmaster
benefit: As a standard action, you spur an ally, who must have fewer Hit Dice than yourself, to reckless effort. For 1 minute, the ally gains a +1 morale bonus on attack rolls, weapon damage rolls, and Will saves against mind-affecting effects. However, the ally also takes a –2 penalty to AC and on skill checks. To affect an unwilling ally, you must succeed at an Intimidate check with the same DC used to demoralize your ally.

name: Taste of Blood (Combat, Varg)
prerequisites: Bone-Crushing Jaws, base attack bonus +6, varg
benefit: When you score a hit with your bite attack, you gain a +2 racial bonus to your attack roll for bite attacks during the next round.

name: Taunt
benefit: Demoralize opponents with Bluff instead of Intimidate.

name: Team Pickpocketing
prerequisites: Bluff 1 rank, Sleight of Hand 1 rank
benefit: When ally makes a Bluff check, you can pick opponent’s pocket as an immediate action

name: Team Up
benefit: Aid another as a move action with two adjacent allies

name: Technologist
benefit: You gain a +2 bonus to Knowledge (Technology) and Craft (Electronic). If you have 10 or more ranks in these skills, the bonus increases to +4.
text:
class="page-content">
You are familiar with the basic mechanics of technology.
BENEFIT
You gain a +2 bonus to Knowledge (Technology) and Craft (Electronic). If you have 10 or more ranks in these skills, the bonus increases to +4.
Special: At the GM’s discretion, this feat may be required in order to be considered trained in any skill used against a technology-based subject. In this case, if the skill in question requires training to use even against non-technological subjects, you must still have ranks in that skill in order to gain the benefit of Technologist.

name: Technologist
benefit: Can use skills with technological subjects.

name: Technology Adept
prerequisites: Dex 13, Exotic Weapon Proficiency (firearms), Point-Blank Shot
benefit: Gain a bonus on save DCs to resist the effects of technological firearms

name: Technophobe
benefit: Gain a morale bonus when you destroy a robot or technological item.

name: Telepathic Link
prerequisites: Have a familiar with the speak with master ability
benefit: You and your familiar can communicate with each other telepathically at a range of up to 1 mile.

name: Telepathic Spellcaster (Tonkin)
benefit: You can cast spells as long as the creature you’re targeting is within range of your telepathy.

name: Telepathy Tap
prerequisites: Sense Motive 10 ranks, ability to cast detect thoughts or telepathy as a spell or spell-like ability or telepathy supernatural ability
benefit: Eavesdrop on telepathic communication

name: Teleport Tactician
benefit: Teleporting creatures provoke attacks of opportunity

name: Tempting Bargain
benefit: You can select an eidolon of any alignment, but it tempts class feature you to change alignment over time

name: Tenacious Hunter
benefit: Pinpoint invisible creatures

name: Tenacious Spell
benefit: Spell is difficult to dispel and remains for 1d4 rounds

name: Tenacious Survivor
prerequisites: Con 13, Diehard, Endurance, half-orc or orc
benefit: When you are killed, your soul lingers near your body, allowing you to be healed and brought back to life for a short period of time

name: Tenacious Survivor (Galka)
benefit: When you are killed by hit point damage, your soul lingers in your body for a number of rounds equal to your Constitution bonus. You are still dead, but a creature can make a DC 10 Heal check as a standard action to realize that you can still be saved. You can be healed by magic as if you were alive. If you are healed enough hit points that you would no longer be dead, you are alive again, but you gain one permanent negative level.
text:
class="page-content">
Your spirit lingers long after any other’s would have passed on.
Prerequisite(s): Con 13, Diehard, Endurance, galka.
BENEFIT
When you are killed by hit point damage, your soul lingers in your body for a number of rounds equal to your Constitution bonus. You are still dead, but a creature can make a DC 10 Heal check as a standard action to realize that you can still be saved. You can be healed by magic as if you were alive. If you are healed enough hit points that you would no longer be dead, you are alive again, but you gain one permanent negative level.

name: Tenacious Transmutation
benefit: +2 to DC to dispel your transmutations.

name: Tenebrous Spell
benefit: Spells you cast in dim light or darkness are harder to resist or dispel.

name: Tengu Raven Form
benefit: Take the form of a Large black bird resembling a raven

name: Tengu Wings
benefit: Sprout wings, granting you a fly speed

name: Terrifying Mask
benefit: Anytime you can make a Sense Motive check to get a hunch or detect whether someone is trustworthy or not, you can choose to instead make an Intimidate check at a –2 penalty. This ability only works on creatures of the humanoid type.

name: Terrifying Mask (Kindred)
benefit: Anytime you can make a Sense Motive check to get a hunch or detect whether someone is trustworthy or not, you can choose to instead make an Intimidate check at a –2 penalty. This ability only works on creatures of the humanoid type.
text:
class="page-content">
Your fiendish visage has made you a truly terrifying spectacle to behold, and you can force others to betray their feelings with a single look.
Prerequisite(s): Kindred, Monstrous Mask.
BENEFIT
Anytime you can make a Sense Motive check to get a hunch or detect whether someone is trustworthy or not, you can choose to instead make an Intimidate check at a –2 penalty. This ability only works on creatures of the humanoid type.

name: Terrifying Strike
benefit: Any creature struck by your slam attack must succeed at a Will save at the same DC as your despair ability or be shaken for 1d4 rounds. If the creature is already shaken, frightened, or panicked, it is paralyzed for 1 round instead. This is a mind-affecting fear effect.

name: Terrorizing Display
prerequisites: Dazzling Display, Demoralizing Lash, Taskmaster, Weapon Focus, Intimidate 10 ranks, Hobgoblin, proficiency with selected weapon
benefit: When you use Dazzling Display, in addition to its normal effects, you can use it to spur allies within 30 feet as if you had used the Taskmaster feat. Use the same Intimidate check to determine the effects of Dazzling Display and this feat.

name: Thanatopic Spell
benefit: Affected spell’s death effects, energy drain, and negative levels affect undead

name: The Canticle of Mother’s Reunion (Bardic Masterpiece)
text:
class="page-content">
This alien eulogy gets into a listener’s blood, and bestows on him the phantom sensation of great agonies.
Prerequisite(s): Perform (sing) 7 ranks.
BENEFIT
One target within range is cursed as though affected by bestow curse as long as the bard maintains the performance. Although this lullaby does have words, it is not a language-dependent effect.
Use: 1 bardic performance. 
Special: 1 round.

name: The Cockatrice Gambit (Bardic Masterpiece)
text:
class="page-content">
Your antics can soften even the hardest visage.
Prerequisite(s): Perform (comedy) or Perform (oratory) 7 ranks.
BENEFIT
You tell an old and humorous tale about a woman who refused to smile at anything, no matter how funny. Through a series of increasingly unlikely events involving a cart of horse manure, a king, and a flying carpet, her legendary frown broke at last. When you complete the performance, the target cured of Petrification and Statue status effects.
Use: 2 bardic performance rounds.
Action: 1 minute.

name: The Dance of the Moogle (Bardic Masterpiece)
text:
class="page-content">
This complex dance makes you difficult to strike.
Prerequisite(s): Perform (dance) 4 ranks.
BENEFIT
The shuffling steps, bends, and leaps of this intricate dance make you a difficult target to hit, but also make it more difficult for you to perform other actions. When using this feat, you take a –2 penalty on melee attack rolls and combat maneuver checks, and you must make a concentration check to perform any song (DC 15 + the song’s level), but you gain a +2 dodge bonus to your Armor Class. When you have 8 ranks in Perform (dance), and every 4 ranks thereafter, the penalty increases by –1 and the dodge bonus increases by +1. You can combine this feat with fighting defensively and Combat Expertise, but not total defense. When you use this feat, it lasts until the start of your next turn. Abilities that extend the duration of a bardic performance (such as Lingering Performance) affect this feat; this allows you to get multiple rounds of its benefit (and its penalties) at the cost of only 1 round of bardic performance.
Use: 1 bardic performance round.
Action: 1 free action.

name: The Fire Within
prerequisites: Ability to cast 3rd-level spells, Elemental Focus (Fire)
benefit: As long as you have an elemental (fire) spell of 3rd level or higher in your known spells and have at least 3 MP in your MP pool, while you are subject to a [Fire] effect, you can forfeit your normal Reflex save against the effect (Or lose your Dexterity bonus against the effect if it requires an attack roll instead of allowing a save). Instead, you make a Will save against the effect. If the save is successful, you absorb the effect, recording it’s damage and it’s DC, if any; During this time, you create light as a torch. You can only hold one Fire effect within yourself at a time, and you can only hold it for a number of minutes equal to the highest-level fire spell you can cast. After this duration is up, the absorbed effect dissipates. During this duration, any ice attacks used against you don’t damage you, instead, they siphon away the fire within. However, during this duration, when you create a Fire effect (Such as casting a Fire spell), you may add the damage of the absorbed effect to the damage of the effect you just created, and you may use the DC of the absorbed effect if it was higher than the DC of the effect you just created. As a secondary benefit, you may instead choose to release this fire as an immediate action; Doing so subjects all targets within a 20-ft.-radius of you to the full fire damage, with a Reflex save for half. Once you release the fire within in any manner, your torchlight effect fades.
text:
class="page-content">
You absorb a fire effect and imbue the next fire spell with its effects or burst with flames to creatures near you.
Prerequisite(s): Ability to cast 3rd-level spells, Elemental Focus (Fire).
BENEFIT
As long as you have an elemental (fire) spell of 3rd level or higher in your known spells and have at least 3 MP in your MP pool, while you are subject to a (fire) effect, you can forfeit your normal Reflex save against the effect (Or lose your Dexterity bonus against the effect if it requires an attack roll instead of allowing a save). You cannot absorb extra damage granted by this feat. Instead, you make a Will save against the effect. If the save is successful, you absorb the effect, recording its damage and its DC, if any; During this time, you create light as a torch.
You can only hold one (fire) effect within yourself at a time, and you can only hold it for a number of minutes equal to the highest-level fire spell you can cast. After this duration is up, the absorbed effect dissipates.
During this duration, any ice attacks used against you don’t damage you, instead, they siphon away the fire within. However, during this duration, when you create a (fire) effect (Such as casting a 1st level spell or higher, such as the Fire spell), you may add the damage of the absorbed effect to the damage of the effect you just created, which consumes the effect, and you may use the DC of the absorbed effect if it was higher than the DC of the effect you just created.
As a secondary benefit, you may instead choose to release this fire as an immediate action; Doing so subjects all targets within a 20-ft.-radius of you to the full fire damage, with a Reflex save for half. Once you release the fire within in any manner, your torchlight effect fades.

name: The Foolish Galka (Bardic Masterpiece)
text:
class="page-content">
Your acting conjures hellfire and salt to destroy plants.
Prerequisite(s): Perform (act) or Perform (comedy) 6 ranks.
BENEFIT
This pantomime tells the tale of a foolish galka farmer who failed to control the weeds that grew so quickly upon his land. In desperation, the farmer bargained with a devil, who blasted the earth with salt and withering heat, leaving the fertile land desolate for a century. When you complete the performance, you can create a 30-foot cone or a 60-foot line that is blasted with scorching air and hot salt. Plants and oozes in this area take 1d6 points of damage per bard level (maximum 10d6); half this damage is fire damage, half is piercing damage. A Reflex save reduces the damage by half. Creatures other than plants or oozes take half damage, or no damage on a successful save.
Use: 2 bardic performance rounds.
Action: 1 full round.

name: The Kefka Refrain (Bardic Masterpiece)
text:
class="page-content">
Your strange melody of hacking gasps and pained wheezes draws upon the dark powers of Kefka to fill a witness with debilitating and distracting phlegm.
Prerequisite(s): Perform (sing) 5 ranks.
BENEFIT
Your song emulates the sounds of a terrible illness, causing one creature you are aware of who can hear your song to develop a psychosomatic flu. If the target fails its Will save, whenever it attempts any action other than moving up to its base speed or making a single melee attack (but not both) in a single round, it must succeed at a concentration check (DC 10 + your Charisma modifier) to avoid wasting its action because of a fit of coughing and sneezing.
Use: 1 bardic performance round per round.
Action: 1 standard action.

name: The Mithra Cat-Step (Bardic Masterpiece)
text:
class="page-content">
Your agile dancing allows you and others to fall safely and land gracefully.
Prerequisite(s): Perform (dance) 5 ranks.
BENEFIT
This quick dance is a series of small steps culminating in a series of leaps. When you complete the performance, for the next 10 minutes you treat any distance fallen as if it were a number of feet shorter equal to half your bard level × 5. You may spend the first minute of this effect demonstrating the dance to up to one creature per two bard levels; if these students succeed at a DC 15 Perform (dance) check, they also gain the benefits of this feat for the remainder of its duration.
Use: 4 bardic performance rounds.
Action: 4 full rounds.

name: The Requiem of the Fallen Mage-King (Bardic Masterpiece)
text:
class="page-content">
Your performance reveals ways to cheat time itself.
Prerequisite(s): Perform (oratory) 10 ranks or Perform (sing) 10 ranks.
BENEFIT
This piece tells the story of a mighty mage-king who seemed to defy time by snatching near-victory from an overwhelming number of enemies. When you complete the performance, you gain the ability to accelerate time once, which must be used in the next 10 minutes. When you perform this feat, you gain the ability to spend a swift action to perform a nonmagical action that normally requires a move action or a standard action. For example, you could make a full attack, then spend a swift action to take a normal move, load a light crossbow, or draw a weapon in the same round. You must use this extra action within 10 minutes of performing the feat; otherwise the benefit is lost.
This ability does not stack with other effects that increase your speed (such as haste). Your allies may benefit from this feat, but they must listen to it intently (to the exclusion of all other activities) for the duration of the performance, and you must expend 1 round of bardic performance for each ally other than yourself whom you want to gain the ability to accelerate time (for example, affecting yourself and five others requires expending 11 rounds of bardic performance). This is a language-dependent effect.
Use: 5 bardic performance rounds, +1 round per additional person affected.
Action: 1 minute.

name: The Ruby Price (Au Ra)
prerequisites: Au ra (raen), elemental resistance racial trait.
benefit: Once per day, when damaged by a spell to which your elemental resistance racial trait provides resistance, you may increase your resistance to that spell to equal your Constitution score, and heal for an amount equal to the damage resisted as an immediate action. You still take damage over the amount resisted, and lose the benefit of your elemental resistance trait until you regain use of this ability.
text:
class="page-content">
Some Raen venerate a mythical noble referred to as The Ruby Princess. By beseeching her aid, they may forestall the effects of elemental attacks directed at them, for a price.
Prerequisite(s): Au ra (raen), elemental resistance racial trait.
BENEFIT
Once per day, when damaged by a spell to which your elemental resistance racial trait provides resistance, you may increase your resistance to that spell to equal your Constitution score, and heal for an amount equal to the damage resisted as an immediate action. You still take damage over the amount resisted, and lose the benefit of your elemental resistance trait until you regain use of this ability.

name: The Tragedy of the Final Aeon (Bardic Masterpiece)
text:
class="page-content">
You remind those around you how the Cycle of Death was perpetuated by blind faith in a corrupt church.
Prerequisite(s): Perform (oratory) or Perform (sing) 4 ranks.
BENEFIT
When you activate this performance, one target within 30 feet becomes flat-footed for as long as you maintain the performance (Will negates). If you target a creature that has not yet acted in a surprise round, the creature does not get to act in the surprise round. Any target with the uncanny dodge class feature or an ability with a similar effect is immune to this performance. This is a mind-affecting emotion effect.
Use: 1 bardic performance round per round. 
Action: 1 standard action.

name: Theurgy
prerequisites: Wis 13, Int or Cha 13, ability to cast 1st-level arcane spells, ability to cast 1st-level divine spells
benefit: Augment arcane spells with divine energy and divine spells with arcane energy.

name: Third Eye
prerequisites: Psychic Sensitivity or ability to cast psychic spells
benefit: Use third eye to read auras and see the truth

name: Thorns (Combat, Mandragora)
benefit: Add 1 point of piercing damage when rolling for damage with an unarmed attack. Any creature involved in a grapple with you automatically takes one point of piercing damage once per round at the beginning of your turn.

name: Those Chosen By the Planet (Bardic Masterpiece)
text:
class="page-content">
Your driving notes cause unnatural heart rates in your opponents as images of the fallen SOLDIER and a Black Meteor flash through their minds.
Prerequisite(s): Perform (percussion) or Perform (wind) 7 ranks.
BENEFIT
You create a musical tempo that first mirrors your enemies’ heartbeats, and then quickens them to dangerous levels. When you complete the performance, all enemies within 30 feet who can hear your performance must save or take 1d6 points of damage as their pounding heart causes them to sweat blood. Creatures that are immune to critical hits are unaffected by this ability.
Each round that you continue the performance adds another round to the bleed effect. Abilities that extend the duration of a bardic performance (such as Lingering Performance) affect this masterpiece.
Use: 1 bardic performance round per round of bleed. 
Action: 1 standard action.

name: Thoughtful Discernment
benefit: Detect lies in a statement you heard, even hours after it has been uttered.

name: Thread of Fate
prerequisites: Ability to cast 4th-level spells, Spell Focus (Chronomancy)
benefit: As long as you have a chronomancy spell of 4th level or higher in your known spells and have at least 4 MP in your MP pool, you gain the ability to alter the threads of fate. As a free action usable outside of your turn, you may take 1 point of Ability Burn to your casting ability score, upon doing so you may have any d20 re-rolled. You may use this ability multiple times but never more than once per roll. As a secondary benefit, you gain a +1 competence bonus to your caster level when casting chronomancy spells.
text:
class="page-content">
You alter the events of fate for one roll.
Prerequisite(s): Ability to cast 4th-level spells, Spell Focus (Chronomancy).
BENEFIT
As long as you have a chronomancy spell of 4th level or higher in your known spells and have at least 4 MP in your MP pool, you gain the ability to alter the threads of fate. As a free action usable outside of your turn, you may take 1 point of Ability Burn to your casting ability score, upon doing so you may have any d20 re-rolled. You may use this ability multiple times but never more than once per roll. As a secondary benefit, you gain a +1 competence bonus to your caster level when casting chronomancy spells.
Ability Burn: Take 1 point of ability damage to your casting attribute for your primary spellcasting class. This ability damage cannot be healed by magical means or supernatural means. It may only be healed with time and rest.

name: Threatening Illusion
benefit: Cause a target to believe your illusion is a threat.

name: Threatening Negotiator
benefit: Increases Intimidate’s duration to 2d6 hours

name: Threnodic Song (Metasong)
text:
class="page-content">
Your mind-affecting songs can influence the undead.
Prerequisite: Knowledge (religion) 6 ranks.
BENEFIT
This feat only works on mind-affecting songs. A threnodic song affects undead creatures (even mindless undead) as if they weren’t immune to mind-affecting effects, but has no effect on living creatures.
MP Increase: +2 (a threnodic song costs 2 additional MP more than the actual MP cost of the song.) In addition, the perform check DC increases by +2.
Normal: Undead are immune to mind-affecting effects.

name: Threnodic Spell
benefit: Change a mind-affecting spell so it can affect undead, but not living creatures.

name: Thrill of the Hunt
prerequisites: Survival 1 rank; BAB +4 or track class feature
benefit: Designate a creature you are tracking as your prize to gain bonuses against it

name: Thrill of the Kill
prerequisites: Half-orc or orc, rage class feature
benefit: Regain rage rounds when you knock out an enemy

name: Throat Slicer
benefit: When using a 1-handed, light, or natural weapon, you can deliver a coup de grace to an unconscious, bound, or pinned target (though not other kinds of helpless targets) as a standard action.

name: Throw Anything
benefit: No penalties for improvised ranged weapons

name: Throw Back Arrows
prerequisites: Dex 17, Deflect Arrows, Improved Unarmed Strike, Snatch Arrows
benefit: When using the Snatch Arrows feat, you can throw a caught piece of ranged ammunition (such as an arrow, bolt, or sling bullet, but not a firearm bullet) as though it were a thrown weapon.

name: Throw Moogle
benefit: When you make a successful grapple check on an opponent at least one size smaller than yourself that you are already grappling, you may throw your opponent like a thrown splash weapon. Make an attack roll at your full BAB, treating the opponent as a two-handed improvised weapon of the same size as the grappled opponent. On a hit, any damage you deal to the target is also dealt to the grappled opponent.
text:
class="page-content">
You may toss your enemies about like javelins.
Prerequisite(s): Wield Moogle.
BENEFIT
When you make a successful grapple check on an opponent at least one size smaller than yourself that you are already grappling, you may throw your opponent like a thrown splash weapon. Make an attack roll at your full BAB, treating the opponent as a two-handed improvised weapon of the same size as the grappled opponent. On a hit, any damage you deal to the target is also dealt to the grappled opponent.

name: Throwdown Trip (Combat, Varg)
prerequisites: Tripping Bite, (or Int 13, Combat Expertise, Improved Trip), varg
benefit: If you successfully trip an opponent, you force your foe to succeed at a Fortitude save (DC equal to CMB result) or become staggered until the end of his next turn.

name: Thunder and Fang
prerequisites: Str 15, Two-Weapon Fighting, Weapon Focus (earth breaker), Weapon Focus (klar)
benefit: Learn the Thunder and Fang fighting style.

name: Thundering Song (Metasong)
text:
class="page-content">
Your songs are loud enough to deafen creatures damaged by their effects.
BENEFIT
You can modify a song to deafen a creature damaged by the song. When a creature takes damage from this song, it becomes deafened for a number of rounds equal to the original level of the song. If the song allows a saving throw, a successful save negates the deafening effect. If the song does not allow a save, the target can make a Fortitude save to negate the deafening effect. If the song effect also causes the creature to become deafened, the duration of this metasong effect is added to the duration of the song. Songs that do not inflict damage do not benefit from this feat.
MP Increase: +2 (a thundering song costs 2 additional MP more than the actual MP cost of the song.) In addition, the perform check DC increases by +2.

name: Thundering Spell
benefit: Deafen creature with spell damage

name: Timely Coordination
benefit: +1 bonus on attack rolls and skill checks for readied actions triggered by allies

name: Toccata and Fugue of the Phantom Train (Bardic Masterpiece)
text:
class="page-content">
Your spooky music blurs the boundaries between life and death, confusing the senses of undead creatures.
Prerequisite(s): Perform (keyboard) or Perform (wind) 4 ranks.
BENEFIT
Upon completing the performance, you and up to one ally per level within listening range become hidden from undead, as if under the effects of a dead silence spell.
As with dead silence, one creature breaking the effect ends the benefit of the performance for all recipients. But by spending an additional round of bardic performance when you perform or maintain the masterpiece, you can dedicate a refrain to a particular ally; even if one ally breaks the dead silence effect, the ally receiving the dedication remains hidden so long as he does not break the effect himself. You can dedicate a refrain multiple times in the performance (up to once per round) as long as you spend 1 round of bardic performance each time for the ally receiving a dedication.
Use: 1 bardic performance round per round of the performance, +1 round per ally affected, +1 round per dedicated refrain. 
Action: If the feat can be taken more than once, or if it relies on an optional system, or otherwise needs to be noted.

name: Tonberry Nobility (Tonkin)
prerequisites: Able to use tonkin spell-like abilities, tonkin
benefit: You may use daylight as a spell-like ability, three times per day. Your caster level is equal to your character level.
